Excited to work with you!



Cheers,

Louie

title: Full-Time High-Volume Short-Form Video Editor — $2,200/Month — Long-Term Growth Role
description:
# Full-Time High-Volume Short-Form Video Editor — $2,200/Month — Long-Term Growth Role



## READ THIS FIRST — BOTH PAID TEST VIDEOS ARE REQUIRED



**You must complete BOTH paid test videos to be considered for this position.**



There are **two required test videos**, and both must be completed. If you complete only one, your application will not be considered.



Both test videos are paid whether or not you are ultimately hired.



The tests are designed to evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Editing speed

* English comprehension

* Attention to detail

* Ability to source your own assets

* Understanding of American culture and internet references

* Knowledge of current trends

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to make strong editing decisions independently



If you are not willing to complete both test videos, please do not apply.



I review completed tests as they arrive and interview strong applicants quickly. There is no fixed closing date. Once I find the right person, the position will be filled.



---



## POSITION



**Full-Time High-Volume Short-Form Video Editor**



TikTok / Reels / Shorts



---



## TYPE / SALARY



**Full Time**



**Starting salary: $2,200 USD/month**



Paid through Wise.



This is the starting position, not the ceiling.



There are several opportunities to move into **higher-paying and higher-responsibility positions** for people who consistently perform well.



Raises and advancement are based on:



* Editing quality

* Speed

* Output

* Reliability

* Communication

* Understanding of the content

* Ability to operate independently

* Trend awareness

* Ability to contribute ideas

* Ability to take ownership of larger parts of the content operation

* Leadership and management ability



I am looking for someone who wants to grow with the business over the long term.



---



## SCHEDULE AND WORKLOAD



This position requires **6–7 days of availability per week**.



Normal working days are approximately **10 hours per day**.



You must also be comfortable working **late-night hours in the Philippines and regularly working until approximately 3:00 AM PH time or later when needed**.



This is necessary because the role requires significant overlap with U.S. working hours and because content needs to move quickly.



Some days will be substantially heavier than others.



During major content pushes, launches, high-performing trends, urgent projects, or other time-sensitive periods, you must be comfortable occasionally working **14–16 hour days** when necessary.



This is a **high-volume operation**.



You must be capable of completing **up to approximately 30–40 short-form videos in a day** when the format and workload require it.



Not every day will require maximum output, and different video formats take different amounts of time, but you must have the speed, organization, and stamina necessary to handle extremely high-volume days without sacrificing quality.



If you are looking for:



* A strict 40-hour-per-week position

* A Monday–Friday-only schedule

* A fixed daytime schedule in the Philippines

* A role where you completely disconnect after your scheduled shift



this is probably **not the right position for you**.



---



## JOB DESCRIPTION



I run TikTok pages that consistently reach millions of views and produce content at significant scale.



I am looking for an editor who can eventually operate as much more than someone who simply follows instructions.



You should understand what makes short-form content perform, recognize trends quickly, understand American internet culture, and develop strong instincts for what belongs on screen without needing every decision explained to you.



Success in this role comes down to five things above everything else:



**Editing quality.

Speed.

English comprehension.

Cultural awareness.

Responsiveness.**



All five are extremely important.



---



## THE WORK



You will primarily edit short-form vertical content including:



* Talking-head videos

* Voiceover/b-roll videos

* Product-focused content

* Commentary videos

* Trend-driven videos

* TikTok Shop content

* Other fast-moving vertical formats



Typical responsibilities include:



* Cutting dead space so videos stay fast-paced

* Stitching the strongest takes together seamlessly

* Identifying which takes should be used without needing every selection made for you

* Adding image overlays that support what is being said

* Adding screenshots, comments, posts, website images, memes, and other visual assets

* Using zooms, crops, reframes, and movement to keep the frame dynamic

* Building b-roll sequences around voiceovers

* Matching visuals to individual lines of a script

* Finding your own visual assets when they are not provided

* Knowing when an image, meme, celebrity photo, reaction, screenshot, or cultural reference makes sense

* Reviewing your own exports before submission

* Fixing obvious issues before sending work

* Learning the brands, people, products, and content styles we work with

* Following trends and identifying opportunities before they become outdated



---



## AMERICAN CULTURE, TRENDS, AND ENGLISH



This is one of the most important requirements of the entire position.



You must have **excellent English comprehension**.



You need to understand not only the literal meaning of a sentence, but also:



* Humor

* Sarcasm

* Tone

* Slang

* References

* Internet terminology

* American social-media culture

* Celebrity culture

* Influencer culture

* College culture

* Reality television references

* TikTok trends

* Memes

* Viral moments

* Current online conversations



If a script references an American celebrity, viral TikTok moment, reality show, meme, brand, influencer controversy, cultural moment, or popular internet reference, I cannot stop production every time to explain what it means.



You should either already understand it or be capable of researching it immediately.



You must also be **extremely knowledgeable about current TikTok trends and American internet culture**.



Following trends is part of the job.



I want someone who naturally spends enough time online to understand:



* What people are currently talking about

* Which sounds are trending

* Which creators are relevant

* Which memes are circulating

* Which stories are going viral

* What visual styles are performing

* Why certain content is gaining attention



You should not need me to introduce you to every trend.



---



## SOURCING YOUR OWN ASSETS



You must be highly self-sufficient.



I will provide direction, scripts, footage, and context depending on the video, but I should not need to create a complete asset folder for every edit.



You should be capable of:



* Reading or listening to a script and determining what visual belongs with each line

* Finding high-quality images of celebrities, influencers, products, brands, locations, and other subjects

* Choosing visually strong images rather than simply using the first search result

* Finding TikTok comments, Reddit posts, social posts, screenshots, articles, and other supporting material

* Navigating brand websites and identifying which areas are worth showing

* Taking clean screenshots

* Finding relevant b-roll

* Understanding which assets strengthen the story

* Knowing when an asset is unnecessary

* Placing every asset at the correct moment in the video



You should be able to receive a script, voiceover, or raw video and independently determine what additional material is needed to make the finished edit engaging.



---



## COMMUNICATION AND RESPONSIVENESS



Communication speed is **extremely important**.



Short-form content moves quickly, and delays in communication can delay an entire content schedule.



During your scheduled working hours, I expect responses to messages within approximately **30 minutes**.



Outside of your scheduled working hours, while you are awake, I generally expect responses within approximately **one hour** when something comes up.



You are not expected to wake up during normal sleeping hours specifically to respond.



However, **once you wake up, you should check your messages immediately and respond to anything outstanding**.



You should remain highly responsive throughout the day.



This position is best suited for someone who naturally checks communications frequently and does not disappear for many hours without notice.



If something prevents you from responding or working normally, communicate that immediately.



---



## WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



I am looking for someone who is:



### Extremely detail-oriented



You notice when:



* A clip is held too long

* An overlay is slightly misplaced

* Subtitles are wrong

* A crop looks awkward

* An image does not match the sentence

* A video feels slower than it should

* Something simply does not look polished



### Fast



Quality matters, but you must also be able to produce content at significant volume.



### Reliable



If you say something will be completed, I should not have to repeatedly ask about it.



### Highly responsive



You communicate quickly and clearly.



### Self-sufficient



You solve normal editing and sourcing problems independently rather than waiting for detailed instructions.



### Extremely familiar with TikTok



You understand:



* Trends

* Hooks

* Pacing

* Memes

* Creators

* Sounds

* Visual styles

* Viral formats

* What currently performs



### Familiar with American culture



You understand the references being made in the content without needing constant explanation.



### Strong in English



You understand speech naturally enough to catch nuance, humor, sarcasm, tone, and context.



### Comfortable with direct feedback



I give direct feedback.



You must be able to apply it quickly and avoid repeatedly making the same mistake.



### Hard-working



Some days are normal.



Some days are extremely busy.



You need to be comfortable with both.



### Interested in advancement



I want someone who eventually wants more responsibility and significantly higher compensation.



### Long-term focused



I am hiring someone I can build with over years, not someone looking for a short-term freelance project.



---



## EXCLUSIVITY



This is a full-time position and should be treated as your primary professional commitment.



Because of the workload and responsiveness required, you should **not be simultaneously managing multiple full-time clients, operating an editing agency, or subcontracting your assigned work to other editors**.



I want the person hired to personally do the work and become deeply familiar with the pages.



In exchange, you receive:



* Stable monthly compensation

* Consistent workload

* Direct access to the person running the pages

* Performance-based advancement

* Opportunities for substantially higher-paying positions

* Increased responsibility as you prove yourself

* The ability to grow as the business grows



---



## REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



* Proven short-form editing experience

* Experience editing TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or similar vertical content

* CapCut or another editing program you can work extremely quickly in

* Strong English comprehension

* Strong understanding of American internet and pop culture

* Strong knowledge of current TikTok trends

* Ability to independently source images, screenshots, b-roll, comments, posts, and other assets

* Strong visual judgment

* Reliable high-speed internet

* A computer capable of handling high-volume editing

* Availability **6–7 days per week**

* Ability to work approximately **10 hours per normal working day**

* Ability and willingness to **regularly work until approximately 3:00 AM PH time or later when required**

* Ability to occasionally work **14–16 hour days**

* Ability to complete **up to approximately 30–40 videos in a high-volume day**, depending on video complexity

* Ability to respond within approximately **30 minutes during working hours**

* Ability to respond within approximately **one hour outside working hours while awake**

* Ability to check and respond to outstanding communications promptly after waking up

* Ability to receive payment through Wise

* Ability to take direct feedback and apply it immediately

* Ability to work independently without constant supervision

* Long-term availability



---



## PAY AND GROWTH



**Starting compensation: $2,200 USD/month.**



This is **not the ceiling**.



There are multiple opportunities to advance into substantially higher-paying positions for someone who consistently performs.



I care much more about what you become capable of than how long you have worked here.



Someone who demonstrates exceptional:



* Editing ability

* Speed

* Reliability

* Judgment

* Leadership

* Trend awareness

* Communication

* Understanding of the pages

* Ability to manage responsibility



can move into larger roles within the operation.



The goal is to develop someone who eventually understands the content operation extremely well and contributes far beyond basic editing.



---



## HOW TO APPLY



**Subject line:**



**EDITOR — [number of the example video you think is hardest to edit]**



Example:



**EDITOR — 2**



Applications that do not follow the subject-line instruction may not be reviewed.



Please include:



### 1. Portfolio



Send links to **2–3 short-form videos you personally edited**.



For each video, explain exactly what you handled.



If you edited only part of a video, say so.



Accuracy matters more than trying to make your experience sound larger than it was.



### 2. Editing Evaluation



In your own words and **without AI assistance**, watch example #3 and write **3–5 sentences** explaining:



* One editing choice you think worked particularly well

* One thing you would have approached differently

* Why



There is no predetermined correct answer.



I want to understand how you evaluate content.



### 3. Background



Tell me:



* What editing software you use

* How long you have used it

* Your internet speed

* Your typical available hours in Philippine time

* Whether you currently have another job

* Whether you currently have freelance clients

* Why you are looking to leave your current work

* How familiar you are with American TikTok and internet culture

* Whether you are comfortable regularly working until **3:00 AM PH time or later**

* Whether you are comfortable working **6–7 days per week**

* Whether you are comfortable with occasional **14–16 hour workdays**



### 4. Trend Question



Answer:



**What American TikTok trend, meme, creator, celebrity story, or internet topic have you seen repeatedly in the last seven days? Explain it briefly and tell me why you think it became popular.**



Do not research an answer specifically for this application.



I want to see whether you naturally follow the same internet culture the content depends on.



---



## PAID TEST — YOU MUST COMPLETE BOTH VIDEOS



To move forward in the hiring process, you must complete **BOTH paid test videos**.



Completing only one test video will **not** qualify you for consideration.



You will receive source material including:



* Reference videos

* Raw footage

* Voiceovers

* Editing instructions



The test folders will intentionally **not contain every visual asset required**.



Part of the test is determining what additional visuals are needed, finding those assets yourself, and placing them correctly.



The two tests are designed to evaluate different aspects of the position.



Together, they will be used to determine whether you move forward to an interview.



The tests evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Editing speed

* Attention to detail

* English comprehension

* Understanding of context

* American cultural awareness

* Trend knowledge

* Visual judgment

* Asset sourcing

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to make good decisions without being told exactly what to do



**Both test videos are paid regardless of whether you are ultimately hired.**



A strong performance on both test videos will be followed by a short interview and then a potential start date.

title: Creative Quality Lead for AI Video Agency (Full Time, Long Term)
description:
We make AI generated video ads for international brands, mostly US telehealth and health.



I am looking for someone to own the creative from both ends. You write the briefs that go to the team, and you are the last set of eyes before the work ships.



What you would actually do



The front end. A client tells me they want 10 UGC and 10 animated ads testing new angles. I give you the direction, the product and the reference material. You turn that into actual briefs for the team. What the scene is, who the character is, what the script says, what the reference looks like, what the specs are. Clear enough that a generator or an editor can pick it up and run without asking questions.



You will use AI heavily to do this. Brainstorming scene ideas, drafting scripts, and building generation prompts with ChatGPT or Claude is part of the daily workflow, not a shortcut. I will show you how we do it.



Writing a brief that produces the right video first time is a skill. Most people write briefs that are too vague and then spend three rounds fixing the output.



The back end. Every video that comes off my team passes through you before it reaches me or a client. Your job is to know whether it holds up. Did the character change between scene one and scene three. Is the lighting inconsistent. Is the product name mispronounced. Does the pacing kill the hook. Does it actually match the brief you wrote.



When it does not, you send it back with specific notes.



The middle. Assigning the work to the right person, chasing whatever assets we are missing, and holding the deadlines across several clients at once.



You will not be generating or editing yourself. You own the brief and the standard.



Who this is for

-You can write a brief that someone else can execute without coming back with questions

-You are comfortable using AI as a working tool, brainstorming scenes and drafting prompts with it rather than just asking it for answers

-You have a real eye. You can watch an ad and say exactly what is wrong with it, not just that it feels off

-You have worked in video, creative, or content and you care about the craft

-Small errors bother you. Inconsistent captions, a face that changes, a cut in the wrong place

-You are organised enough to track work across several projects

-You are comfortable telling someone their work needs redoing, and doing it in a way that does not make them defensive

-You want to grow into creative direction rather than stay an individual contributor



You do not need to have been a manager before. If you can write a good brief and judge good work, I will teach you the coordination side.



Who this is not for

-You want to be the one making the videos

-You avoid difficult conversations

-You are looking for a stepping stone into your own agency

-You would treat this as one of several clients



What you get

-Direct training from me on our standards, our process, and how performance creative actually works

-Real ownership of the creative from brief to delivery

-A business growing quickly with international clients, and a role that grows with it

-A path into creative direction as the team scales

-Paid on time, every time



Hours



Full time, 40 hours a week, Philippine business hours. Fully remote.



Requirements

-Background in video, creative, content, or production

-Strong written English. Most of this job is writing clear briefs and clear notes

-Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude as part of your daily process

-Comfortable learning project tools like Trello, Notion, ClickUp

-Reliable internet and a computer that handles video review

-Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement



Experience with AI video tools is a plus but not required. I will teach you the stack.



How to apply



Read this properly. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.



1. Start your application with the word ANCHOR so I know you read the whole post.

2. Here is a rough direction, the kind of thing I would hand you: a telehealth brand sells a weight loss medication online for ninety nine dollars a month. They want short vertical ads aimed at women in their forties who have tried and failed at dieting. 3. Write me one brief for one video, exactly as you would hand it to someone on the team.

3. Send me a link to a video ad you think is badly made and tell me exactly what is wrong with it. Be specific about that ad, not ads in general.

4. How do you use AI in your work day to day?

5. Your background, when you can start, and your salary expectations.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test on real work, paid whether or not I hire you.

title: Onboarding and Listing Manager (Short Term Rental)
description:
We are a short-term rental co-hosting company managing roughly 56 properties across 15 states. We operate under a co-hosting model — property owners retain their listings, reviews, and branding while we handle operations, guest experience, pricing, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting. We compete on quality, not quantity, and we onboard 1–2 new properties per month with a target of scaling to 200 properties by 2028.



Onboarding is the foundation of every client relationship. A property that is onboarded correctly generates clean, stable operations for years. A property that is onboarded poorly generates ongoing friction that drains the entire operations team. We are hiring for an Onboarding & Listing Specialist who owns this function end-to-end.



Role Mission

Take every new property from signed contract to first booking in a defined, repeatable, high-quality process. You are the first operational touchpoint for every new owner and the architect of the conditions under which every other tea
mber succeeds or struggles.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like in 90 Days)

• Time from signed contract to first live booking: under 21 days on 90%+ of new properties.

• Owner satisfaction score on onboarding: 9/10 or higher measured via post-onboarding survey.

• Zero listing errors at go-live — amenities, photos, pricing, house rules, and descriptions verified and correct.

• Pricing strategy configured correctly on day one — dynamic pricing tools set up with appropriate base rates, seasonality, and event-based adjustments.

• Full operational handoff document complete for every new property before go-live — cleaning, maintenance, guest experience, and pricing teams receive complete information.

• Onboarding SOP maintained and improved quarterly based on what worked and what broke.



Core Responsibilities



Owner-Facing Onboarding

• Conduct the kickoff call with every new owner — welcome, process walkthrough, expectations, timeline.

• Collect all property-specific information: access, utilities, insurance, HOA rules, owner preferences, existing bookings to honor.

• Set and manage owner expectations on timeline, pricing strategy, and what they can expect from Divergent through onboarding and beyond.

• Serve as the primary contact for the owner during the onboarding period, then warm-handoff to ongoing management.

Listing Build & Optimization

• Build new listings on Airbnb, VRBO, and direct booking platforms (owner retains listing ownership in the co-hosting model).

• Coordinate professional photography when needed; optimize photo order for conversion.

• Write compelling listing titles, descriptions, house rules, and amenity tagging.

• Verify all listing details against the actual property — amenities present, safety items in place, access instructions accurate.



Pricing Setup

• Configure dynamic pricing tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, or equivalent) with correct base rates, minimum stays, and seasonality curves.

• Identify local events and demand patterns; configure event-based pricing rules.

• Partner with the pricing lead on mid-term rental (MTR) strategy when applicable.

• Set and document pricing assumptions so ongoing management can adjust as data comes in.

Operational Handoff

• Document everything the cleaning, maintenance, and guest experience teams need: supply PAR levels, cleaner assignment, maintenance vendors, guest communication templates, property-specific quirks.

• Ensure the first cleaning, first inspection, and first supply order are complete before the first guest arrives.

• Walk the ongoing management team through the property in a formal handoff meeting within the first 14 days.

Process Improvement

• Maintain and improve the onboarding SOP — what worked, what broke, what changed.

• Build reusable templates, checklists, and automations that reduce onboarding time without reducing quality.

• Report monthly on onboarding pipeline, time-in-process, and any bottlenecks.



Required Experience & Skills

• 2+ years of short-term rental operations experience — hands-on, not adjacent.

• Demonstrated experience building or launching Airbnb, VRBO, or 
 listings from scratch.

• Working knowledge of a PMS (Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, or OwnerRez).

• Hands-on experience with a dynamic pricing tool (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond).

• Strong written English and excellent spoken English — you will be on owner-facing calls.

• Project management discipline — you can manage 3–5 simultaneous onboardings without dropping details.

• Comfort with checklists, SOPs, and repeatable processes.



Preferred (Not Required)

• Prior experience in hospitality, property management, or client onboarding.

• Experience with Breezeway, Slack, Salesmsg, and GetClearing.

• Design eye for listing photos and descriptions.

• SEO or listing optimization experience on major OTA platforms.



Non-Negotiable Traits

• Organizational discipline. You manage multiple onboardings without letting any slip.

• Owner-facing confidence. You can hold a call with a $500K+ property owner and make them feel informed, respected, and confident in Divergent.

• Process thinker. You build systems, not one-offs.

• Ownership mindset. When onboarding breaks, your reflex is "how do I fix this and prevent it," not "who told me to do this."

• Professionalism under owner pressure. Owners can be anxious during onboarding. You stay steady, clear, and solution-oriented.



What We Offer

• Competitive hourly rate for a qualified STR operator.

• One of the most strategically important roles in the company — onboarding directly drives growth and retention.

• Quarterly performance reviews with bonus opportunities.

• Direct access to the owner (Nick) for strategic decisions.

• Long-term role with growth potential as we scale to 200+ properties.

• Professional development, coaching, and 1:1 time with leadership.



Hiring Process

1. Resume and written application — confirm STR onboarding experience.

2. 2-minute Loom video introduction — walk us through a property you onboarded from scratch.

3. First interview (30 minutes) with Divergent leadership.

4. Paid trial project ($75–100): Draft a 5-step onboarding plan with timelines for a sample property, write the owner welcome
, and identify the top 3 risks for this specific property.

5. Reference checks — minimum 2 written references with specific questions.

6. Owner call with Nick — cultural fit and final decision.

7. 30-day paid trial starts.

title: Short-Term Rental Property Operations Manager - Full-Time US Hours
description:
HOURS PER WEEK

40



MONTHLY SALARY

USD $1,300-$2,000 per month



JOB OVERVIEW



ABOUT DIVERGENT ESTATES



Divergent Estates is a growing U.S.-based short-term rental management company. We help property owners operate professional, guest-ready vacation rentals across multiple U.S. markets.



We are hiring a long-term, full-time Short-Term Rental Property Operations Manager. Internally, we call this role a Pod Manager.



This is not a general virtual assistant or customer-service-only position. It is an ownership role for someone who can build the operating team around a small group of properties and then manage those properties from A to Z.



HOW THE ROLE STARTS



You will be assigned a small number of target properties before they are fully transitioned to you.



For each property, you will:



- Validate and organize the property information

- Build the primary and backup cleaning team

- Build the local maintenance and specialty-vendor bench

- Document contacts, procedures and escalation paths in Notion

- Configure HostBuddy AI so it can answer routine guest questions

- Review the PriceLabs setup and learn the approved pricing guardrails

- Identify open problems and create a stabilization plan

- Pass a property-readiness review



Once the property passes the readiness review, you will formally accept responsibility for it. Properties will transfer to you one at a time, so you will own the team and operating system you helped build.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Cleaner scheduling, performance, inspections and backup coverage

- Maintenance intake, troubleshooting, vendor dispatch and completion follow-through

- Daytime guest issues that HostBuddy AI cannot resolve

- Proactive owner communication and documented decisions

- Property supplies, recurring services and operational readiness

- Accurate property and vendor information in Notion

- PriceLabs execution within approved company guardrails

- Open tasks from the first report through verified completion

- Operational onboarding for additional properties assigned to your pod



PriceLabs ownership includes monitoring calendar health, minimum-stay rules, orphan gaps, local events and approved overrides. Major pricing strategy and changes outside the approved guardrails require company approval until you complete our internal certification.



✅ REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Excellent spoken and written English

- Confidence making phone calls to U.S.-based cleaners, handymen and vendors

- Experience in short-term rentals, property management, hospitality operations or a comparable operations role

- Strong problem-solving and prioritization under time pressure

- Ability to troubleshoot maintenance issues before sending a vendor

- Clear documentation and disciplined follow-through

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and a professional call setup

- Ability to work full time without overlapping full-time employment

- Comfort accepting responsibility for results, not only completing assigned tasks



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



- Hostaway or another property management system

- Breezeway or another cleaning and maintenance platform

- PriceLabs or another revenue-management tool

- Notion, Slack or remote documentation systems

- HostBuddy or another AI guest-messaging system

- Cleaner, handyman or vendor sourcing in unfamiliar markets

- Owner-facing communication



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



This is a full-time remote position with primary coverage during U.S. Central Time business hours. There will be a scheduled weekend rotation. Overnight on-call coverage is handled separately.



The exact working schedule will be confirmed before an offer.



Base compensation is USD $1,300-$2,000 per month from day one, including the initial build-to-own ramp. Placement within the range depends on demonstrated experience, spoken communication, maintenance judgment and ability to operate independently.



We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term role with the opportunity to manage a larger portfolio and grow in compensation as performance and responsibility increase.



HOW TO APPLY



Start the first line of your application with the word OWNERSHIP. Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.



Please include:



1. Your resume or a summary of your relevant work history

2. A 60-90 second audio or video introduction explaining your relevant experience

3. Your answers to the five questions below



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. How many properties, units or active clients have you directly supported? What work did you personally own?



2. Describe a time you sourced a cleaner or maintenance vendor in a market where you had no existing contacts. What did you do and what was the result?



3. A cleaner cancels three hours before a same-day guest check-in. Walk us through your first 15 minutes and your next steps.

title: Social Media Virtual Assistant — Content Repurposing & Cross-Platform Posting
description:
Type: Contract, flexible hours 

Reports to: BLISS THE MOMENT 

Focus: High-volume content repurposing and trial-reel posting across Instagram and TikTok for BLISS THE MOMENT

The Role



We have an existing content bank (in Canva) of every Reel we've posted to Instagram — each entry includes the video, a one-screen text hook, and a multi-paragraph caption with hashtags. We're looking for a VA to take ownership of turning that bank into a constant stream of fresh trial content across both Instagram and TikTok.



This is repurposing work, not original production — you're not shooting new footage. For each video already in the bank, you'll create a new iteration (different cut/length, new hook, new caption) and post it as a trial reel on both platforms. Well-performing trials get pushed to our public feed by us — that decision stays on our end.



Longer-term, this role also grows into sourcing new content from outside our bank to keep the pipeline fed.

What You'll Own



Content refresh & re-editing — Pull from our existing Canva content bank and re-cut/re-edit each video (trim length, adjust pacing, resequence clips) to create a genuinely distinct new version. All editing happens in Canva.

Hook & caption generation — Using your own AI writing tool/workflow, generate a new one-screen hook and a new multi-paragraph caption (with hashtags) for each iteration. Needs to read as fresh content, not a copy-paste of the original, while staying on-brand.

Cross-platform trial posting — Publish each new iteration as a trial reel on both Instagram and TikTok. You'll have full login access to both accounts.

High-volume daily cadence — Target ~30 posts/day on each platform (60 total/day). Hours are flexible — post throughout the day however works for you, as long as the full daily volume goes out on schedule.

Content sourcing (ongoing) — As the bank gets worked through, identify and curate trending or relevant external clips to expand it, following the same repost flow.



Required Skills

Proficient in Canva, specifically for video editing/re-cutting

Comfortable using an AI writing tool (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to generate on-brand hooks and captions at volume, independently

Experience posting to Instagram Reels and TikTok natively — comfortable in both apps

Reliable — able to hit a daily volume target without reminders, and to communicate proactively if something's off track

Comfortable working with direct account access (you'll be trusted with full login credentials to both accounts)



Nice to Have

Experience with content calendars or scheduling tools

A good eye for short-form trends (what's currently working on Reels/TikTok)

Understanding of why re-edits need to be genuinely distinct (not just re-uploads) for platform performance



How to Apply

 
 with the subject line "Social Media VA — [Your Name]" and include:

A sample edit — a before/after or two showing how you'd re-cut an existing video into a distinct new version

A sample hook + caption pair — for any short-form video, to show your writing style

Shortlisted candidates will be given a short paid test task (one full cycle: re-edit, hook, caption, post to both platforms) before final selection.

title: Stand up comedy editor and content manager
description:
I’m a professional stand-up comedian looking for someone to help me grow my audience on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.



I have over 100 million views but want to take things to the next level. 



This is NOT just a video editing job.



I’m looking for someone who wants to become obsessed with figuring out how to make my comedy go viral.



And there is one requirement that is more important than anything else:



You MUST genuinely love stand-up comedy.



I don’t mean you’ve seen a few Kevin Hart clips on TikTok.



I want someone who actually watches American stand-up comedy in their free time.



You should have favorite comedians.



You should watch comedy specials.



You should understand why a joke is funny, where the punchline is, and why the setup matters.



You should understand sarcasm, irony, wordplay, crowd work, cultural references, and comedic timing.



This also means your English comprehension needs to be EXCELLENT.



You don’t have to speak perfect English. But you need to understand it at a very high level.



If you don’t genuinely love stand-up comedy, please don’t apply.



WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



I have a large amount of stand-up footage, podcasts, and other long-form content.



Your job will be to find the best moments and turn them into short-form videos that people want to watch and share.



You’ll primarily be creating content for:



* Instagram Reels

* Instagram Trial Reels

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts



We’ll be posting a LOT.



On Instagram alone, I want to test at least 5 Trial Reels per day.



The goal isn’t just to pump out 5 random videos.



We’re going to test constantly and figure out what works.



Which jokes get the most views?



Which opening lines stop people from scrolling?



Which topics perform best?



Which clips generate followers?



Which lengths perform best?



What makes someone watch until the punchline?



What makes someone share a clip with their friend?



I want you paying attention to all of this.



I DON’T WANT SOMEONE WHO JUST FOLLOWS INSTRUCTIONS



At the beginning, I’ll give you a lot of direction.



I’ll show you what I like.



I’ll show you my best-performing content.



I’ll explain my comedy and how I think about clips.



But eventually I want YOU finding the clips.



I want to be able to give you a 60-minute stand-up performance or a 90-minute podcast and have you identify the moments that have the best chance of performing online.



I want you to get to know my comedy so well that you can watch something and immediately think:



“That’s the clip.”



That’s much more valuable to me than someone who is simply good at using editing software.



YOUR REAL JOB IS GROWTH



I don’t care about posting content just so we can say we posted something.



I want views. I want followers. I want fans.



I want someone who gets genuinely excited when a video takes off.



If one video gets 20,000 views and another gets 2,000,000 views, I want you asking WHY.



Was it the joke?



The first three seconds?



The caption?



The length?



The topic?



The editing?



Could we take another clip and package it the same way?



Could we edit the same joke differently and test it again?



You should constantly be looking for patterns and trying to beat our previous results.



YOU’LL GET PAID MORE WHEN WE WIN



In addition to your normal pay, you’ll have the opportunity to earn significant monthly performance bonuses.



The more views and growth our content generates, the more money you can make.



There will be bonuses based on things like:



* Total monthly organic views

* Follower growth

* Individual videos that become breakout hits



I want your incentives aligned with mine.



If you help me build a massive comedy audience, I want this to become a VERY good job for you.



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR



You’ll probably be a great fit if:



* You genuinely love American stand-up comedy

* You regularly watch stand-up specials and comedy clips

* Your English comprehension is excellent

* You understand American humor and cultural references

* You’re good at identifying the funniest/most interesting moment in a longer video

* You have experience editing short-form vertical video

* You understand hooks, retention, pacing, captions, and short-form storytelling

* You understand Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

* You’re comfortable producing and posting a high volume of content

* You like looking at analytics

* You’re competitive

* You experiment instead of doing the same thing over and over

* You’re proactive

* You can work independently

* You want to get REALLY fucking good at social media growth



HOURS



We’ll start at approximately 4 hours per day / 20 hours per week.



The first month will essentially be a paid trial.



If you’re great at this, I would love to turn it into a full-time position.



I’m not looking for someone to edit videos for me for three months.



I’m looking for someone who could potentially work with me for YEARS and become an important part of growing my comedy career.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of these questions:



1. Who are your 5 favorite stand-up comedians?



Do not Google “popular American comedians.” I will be able to tell 😂



2. What is your favorite stand-up special you’ve watched recently and why did you like it?



3. Send me links to 3 short-form videos you’ve personally edited.



4. Tell me about the most successful short-form video you’ve edited. How many views did it get?



5. Why do you think that video performed well?



6. If I gave you a 60-minute stand-up show, how would you d
 which 5 moments should become clips?



7. What editing software do you use?



8. What is your current availability?



And finally:



Start your application with the words “THAT’S THE CLIP” so I know you actually read this entire post.



If you don’t include those words, I won’t read your application.



I’m excited to find someone who loves comedy and wants to build something big with me.

- At least one example of a deliverability problem you diagnosed and recovered from



---



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY — generic applications will be rejected)



In your application, answer all five of these questions. Skip any of them and we won't review your application.



1. Explain the difference between SPF *pass* and SPF *alignment*, and why DMARC cares about alignment.

2. Walk me through a 30-day warmup ramp for a brand-new subdomain that needs to handle 50,000
s per week. Tell me Day 1 volumes, Day 30 volumes, who you send to during warmup, and what you monitor daily.

3. What's your exact process for checking sender reputation across Gmail and Outlook? Name the tools and the metrics you track.

4. Have you registered an A2P 10DLC campaign before? Walk me through the brand and campaign registration process. If you haven't done one, say so honestly — but know that this is required for the role.

5. Tell me about a specific time a domain you managed got blocked, blacklisted, or sent to spam. What was the root cause, how did you diagnose it, and what specific steps did you take to recover? "I checked the settings" is not an answer.

---

We pay fairly, we move quickly, and we promote people who deliver. We do not waste time on applicants who exaggerate experience — your work-sample test will expose that fast, so please apply only if you have the actual skill.

title: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist
description:
About the Role



I’m looking for a highly experienced Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist to join my content creation business on a full-time, long-term basis.



I am a medical doctor and content creator producing educational, skincare, beauty and lifestyle content across TikTok and Instagram.



This is not a junior editing role. I am looking for someone with significant professional short-form editing experience, exceptional creative judgement and a strong understanding of what drives performance across TikTok, Instagram and the wider social media landscape.



The role combines senior-level short-form video editing, creative direction, content ideation and social media trend awareness.



A core part of this position will be proactively helping to develop and evolve the editing style of the content. The successful candidate should not simply replicate the existing editing style. They should continuously assess how short-form content is changing and use those insights to introduce new editing techniques, formats and creative approaches that make the content more dynamic, current and engaging.



The role also includes proactive content ideation. I am looking for someone who is genuinely immersed in social media and naturally identifies emerging audios, trends, formats, memes, conversations and cultural moments that could be developed into relevant content ideas.



This is a permanent, full-time position within a fast-paced content business where daily posting is a core priority. Reliability, flexibility, creative initiative, responsiveness and consistently meeting deadlines are essential.



Core Responsibilities



Senior Short-Form Editing & Creative Direction



* Edit high-performing short-form content for TikTok and Instagram, across both organic content and paid brand partnerships

* Optimise content for viewer retention, watch time, engagement and overall platform performance

* Use strong creative judgement to strengthen hooks, pacing, structure, storytelling and overall execution

* Proactively identify opportunities within content to improve performance rather than relying on detailed instructions for every creative decision

* Understand the differences between what performs on TikTok and Instagram and adapt editing styles, pacing, formats and creative choices accordingly

* Identify opportunities to strengthen content through relevant visual assets, memes, cultural references, trends, audio and platform-native creative techniques

* Maintain an exceptionally high standard of quality, accuracy and attention to detail

* Take ownership of edits from raw footage through to final approval



Evolving the Editing Style



A major responsibility of this role is to actively help shape and evolve the creative editing direction of the content.



The successful candidate will be expected to:



* Continuously assess how high-performing short-form content is evolving across TikTok and Instagram

* Proactively introduce new editing styles, techniques and creative approaches that can make the content more dynamic and engaging

* Identify elements of the existing editing style that could be refreshed, improved or replaced

* Suggest and experiment with new approaches to hooks, pacing, visual storytelling, text treatments, graphics, audio and overall content structure

* Recognise emerging editing trends early and assess whether they are genuinely relevant to the creator’s content and audience

* Help ensure the content remains current, competitive and platform-native, rather than relying on an editing formula that becomes dated over time

* Balance creative evolution with consistency so that the content continues to feel recognisably aligned with the creator’s personal brand



The expectation is not simply to follow an established editing template. The editor should bring the experience and creative judgement required to help determine what the editing style should become next.



Content Ideation & Trend Spotting



This role extends beyond editing and includes an important content ideation component.



The successful candidate will be expected to:



* Proactively bring forward content ideas rather than waiting solely for content to be assigned

* Regularly identify trending audios, formats, memes, conversations, cultural moments and emerging social media trends that could be relevant to the creator’s content

* Suggest specific ways those trends could be adapted into original TikTok or Instagram content

* Identify emerging or high-performing content formats and suggest how they could be applied to educational, skincare, beauty, lifestyle or personality-led content

* Bring forward ideas for new hooks, video structures, recurring formats and creative concepts

* Proactively share useful creative references and examples

* Understand the difference between blindly following a trend and identifying trends that can be adapted naturally and strategically to the creator’s audience and personal brand

* Remain sufficiently immersed in TikTok, Instagram and wider social media culture to identify opportunities while they are relevant, rather than once a trend has already passed



For example, if an audio, meme or format begins trending and there is a strong way to adapt it to the creator’s content, the expectation is that the editor would identify that opportunity and proactively suggest the content idea.



Picture Carousels & Canva



* Create high-quality picture carousel content for TikTok and Instagram using Canva

* Turn supplied copy, information and concepts into polished, engaging and platform-appropriate carousel content

* Contribute creative ideas around carousel formats, layouts, hooks and visual treatments

* Maintain a strong and consistent visual identity

* Source relevant imagery, graphics, screenshots and visual references where required

* Keep up to date with evolving carousel styles and formats across TikTok and Instagram

* Help evolve carousel design alongside the broader creative direction of the social channels



Paid Brand Partnerships



* Edit paid brand partnerships to a consistently high standard while maintaining the creator’s organic content style

* Understand and accurately execute campaign briefs and brand requirements

* Balance mandatory brand messaging with the need for content to remain engaging and native to the platform

* Identify creative ways to integrate brand requirements without making the content feel unnecessarily commercial

* Handle brand revisions accurately and efficiently



Seniority & Experience



This is explicitly a senior-level position.



Applicants should have significant professional experience editing short-form social media content and be able to demonstrate a strong portfolio of high-quality work.



The successful candidate must already have the technical foundations expected of an experienced professional editor. This role is focused on a higher level of contribution: creative judgement, strategic thinking, platform knowledge, content performance, creative direction and proactive ideation.



Applicants should be able to demonstrate:



* Significant professional short-form video editing experience

* A strong portfolio of TikTok, Instagram Reels or comparable vertical content

* Experience editing content designed to achieve strong social media performance

* Advanced proficiency in CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro

* Strong proficiency in Canva

* Excellent knowledge of TikTok and Instagram

* A sophisticated understanding of viewer psychology, retention, hooks and short-form storytelling

* Strong awareness of social media culture, emerging trends and platform behaviour

* The ability to distinguish between a fleeting trend and a genuinely valuable creative opportunity

* Strong independent creative judgement

* The confidence to suggest improvements or challenge an existing creative approach where appropriate

* The ability to take ownership of an edit without requiring detailed step-by-step direction

* Strong English comprehension and excellent attention to detail

* Clear and proactive communication

* Strong organisation and time-management skills

* The ability to manage multiple priorities within a fast-moving content environment



What I’m Looking For



The ideal editor is someone who:



* Takes genuine pride in producing exceptionally high-quality work

* Is highly experienced and confident in their creative judgement

* Understands what makes content perform across both TikTok and Instagram and can adapt editing styles, pacing and formats accordingly

* Understands the psychology behind high-performing short-form content

* Knows how to strengthen hooks and improve viewer retention through editing

* Can identify moments where pacing, captions, visuals, memes, cultural references or structure can be improved to maximise performance

* Keeps up to date with TikTok and Instagram trends, formats, platform updates and changes in audience behaviour

* Understands how to incorporate relevant trends naturally into content where appropriate to maximise engagement and performance

* Proactively helps evolve the editing style rather than simply reproducing the existing one

* Is excited by the opportunity to develop new and more dynamic creative approaches as social media evolves

* Regularly brings forward content ideas, trending audios, formats and creative references without needing to be asked

* Thinks beyond the individual edit and contributes to the broader creative direction and performance of the content

* Can follow a creator’s style while also bringing strong creative ideas and suggestions

* Understands when innovation will strengthen a piece of content and when a simpler approach is more effective

* Learns from feedback and consistently applies it to future work

* Communicates clearly and proactively

* Is highly dependable and consistent

* Takes ownership of deliverables and deadlines

* Does not need to be repeatedly chased or micromanaged

* Is comfortable operating at the pace required by a creator publishing content daily



This role supports a creator who is looking to post daily content. Reliability and meeting deadlines are therefore essential.



Turnaround Expectations



This is a fast-paced full-time role, and applicants must be comfortable working to consistently short turnaround times.



First Draft Turnaround



Once raw footage has been received, a fully edited first draft must be delivered within approximately 4–6 hours, depending on the length and complexity of the video.



For particularly complex or editing-intensive videos, turnaround may extend to up to 12 hours.



The expectation is that newly received footage is prioritised and editing begins promptly. This is not a role operating on a traditional freelance editing turnaround of 24–48 hours.



Applicants should only apply if they are genuinely comfortable maintaining this level of turnaround consistently.



Revisions



* Straightforward revisions must be actioned urgently upon receipt of feedback

* More substantial revisions must also be prioritised and completed as quickly as possible

* The editor must remain highly responsive to feedback and revision requests

* Previous feedback must be retained and applied to future edits to minimise unnecessary repeat revision rounds



Flexibility & Availability



This is a full-time role with flexible working hours.



There are no fixed or pre-agreed daily working hours. Instead, the successful candidate must be flexible around the requirements of a fast-moving content schedule.



* The successful candidate must have the flexibility to adapt their working pattern around when footage, feedback and content requirements arise

* Capacity to edit content consistently throughout the week is essential

* Weekend availability is a non-negotiable requirement of the role

* Urgent edits may occasionally require a faster turnaround

* The editor must be highly responsive and able to adapt where necessary to meet content and campaign deadlines

* Any known periods of unavailability must be communicated in advance



Communication, Reliability & Ownership



The successful candidate must:



* Communicate clearly and proactively

* Be highly responsive to new content, feedback and changing priorities

* Keep the creator/team updated on the status of edits where necessary

* Flag potential issues or delays before they affect a deadline

* Take ownership of assigned work rather than requiring repeated follow-up

* Manage priorities independently

* Maintain high standards even when working to fast turnaround times

* Be dependable and consistent



Typical Deliverables



Typical workload includes:



* Approximately 7 short-form videos per week

* Picture carousel content for TikTok and Instagram as required

* A mix of organic content and paid brand partnerships

* Videos generally between 30–90 seconds

* Revisions and alternative versions where required

* Proactive content ideas, trend recommendations and creative references



Workload may fluctuate depending on the content calendar, brand campaigns and wider business requirements.



Confidentiality & Content Ownership



The editor may have access to unreleased content, brand campaign information and other confidential business material.



All footage, content, campaign materials and other confidential information must be treated accordingly and may not be shared, uploaded or repurposed externally without permission.



All final content, project files and creative assets produced as part of the role will remain the property of the business.



Role Details



Position: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist

Employment: Full-time, permanent / long-term

Location: Remote

Hours: Full-time with flexible working hours based around content requirements and deadlines

Weekend availability: Required and non-negotiable

Start Date: As soon as possible



Application Requirements



Please include:



* A portfolio of short-form content within the following niches ONLY 



skincare, 

beauty,

Haircare

 lifestyle



* At least 7–10 examples of TikTok, Instagram Reels or comparable short-form content that you have personally edited

* Examples that demonstrate a range of editing styles, formats and creative approaches where possible

* Examples of TikTok or Instagram picture carousels you have created



Please *only* apply if you have experience editing high-performing short-form content within the above niches, are comfortable contributing proactively to content ideation and creative direction, and can consistently work to the fast turnaround times outlined above.



Applications will be immediately disqualified if you are unable to demonstrate previous video editing experience within the beauty/skincare/haircare/lifestyle niche

title: SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT & GROWTH PARTNER
description:
SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT & GROWTH PARTNER



Part-Time | Remote | USD $300 Per Month



ABOUT MAISON MNANDI AFRICA



Maison Mnandi Africa is an African lifestyle brand celebrating craftsmanship, heritage and contemporary living through thoughtfully curated fashion, accessories and home décor.



We are building a storytelling-led e-commerce brand that brings authentic African artistry into modern lifestyles through elevated imagery, meaningful narratives and a refined editorial aesthetic.



Our products are chosen for their beauty, character and cultural significance. Every visual should invite discovery, every caption should add meaning and every brand touchpoint should feel considered, respectful and beautifully executed.



Website: 





ABOUT THE ROLE



We are seeking a creative, organised and commercially aware Social Media Content & Growth Coordinator to help shape Maison Mnandi Africa’s digital presence and grow an engaged community around the brand.



Working closely with the Founder, you will transform our existing library of professional photographs, videos and product stories into thoughtful, consistent and compelling social media content. You will play an important role in ensuring that our online presence reflects the quality, warmth and cultural richness of the Maison Mnandi Africa experience.



Instagram will be our primary platform. Selected Instagram content will be adapted for
 and 
 rather than created separately for these platforms. Where appropriate, suitable ready-made Instagram videos may also be repurposed for TikTok.



This is not simply a scheduling or posting position. We are looking for someone who can understand a brand’s visual language, make discerning content choices, write with warmth and clarity, and use performance insights to strengthen future content.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



* Develop and manage a monthly social media content calendar.

* Select, organise and prepare content from our existing professional asset library.

* Create and deliver an average of 16 fully prepared Instagram feed content pieces per month, featuring an agreed mix of Reels, carousels and static posts.

* Create approximately two Instagram Story updates per week using existing brand photos, videos and other approved content. Each update will usually include 2–4 separate Story slides, such as product details, behind-the-scenes images, reminders, polls or links.

* Write engaging, brand-aligned captions and calls to action.

* Complete light graphic design in Canva and video editing in CapCut, or use comparable creative tools.

* Adapt and 
 selected Instagram content for
 and 
 rather than creating separate original content for these platforms.

* Repurpose suitable ready-made Instagram video content for TikTok where appropriate.

* Submit the monthly content calendar and completed content for the Founder’s review and approval before scheduling and publication.

* Schedule and publish approved content according to the agreed content calendar.

* Conduct relevant keyword, hashtag and trend research.

* Track key performance indicators and prepare a concise monthly report.

* Recommend practical content and performance improvements based on insights from the monthly report.



Organic growth is a shared objective. You will contribute through consistent execution, thoughtful content and informed recommendations, but you will not be solely responsible for guaranteeing follower growth, website traffic or sales.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



* Previous social media experience with an e-commerce, fashion, lifestyle, home décor, cultural or premium consumer brand.

* Strong visual judgement and an instinct for clean, refined and editorial content.

* Excellent English copywriting, storytelling and proofreading skills.

* Experience creating Reels, carousels, Stories and short-form video content.

* Proficiency with Canva and CapCut, or comparable creative tools.

* Working knowledge of current content formats and best practices across Instagram,
, Pinterest and TikTok.

* A practical understanding of organic growth, content strategy and social media analytics.

* Strong organisation, communication and attention to detail.

* A genuine appreciation for African craftsmanship, culture and storytelling.

* The ability to work independently, take initiative, follow direction and meet deadlines.

* A thoughtful, collaborative approach and the confidence to bring forward creative ideas.



Experience with a premium, design-led or culturally focused brand will be highly valued.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



* Position: Part-Time Freelance Contractor

* Location: Remote

* Working Structure: Flexible and deliverables-based

* Remuneration: USD $300 per month as a flat-rate retainer

* Initial Contract: Three months, subject to performance review



Content may be created in batches and scheduled in advance. Daily availability is not required, provided all agreed deliverables, deadlines, publishing schedules and quality standards are met.



The successful candidate will be evaluated according to the quality, consistency and timely delivery of the agreed work rather than fixed daily working hours.



There is potential for a longer-term engagement and remuneration review based on performance, reliability, business requirements and brand growth.



Please note that paid advertising, influencer management, professional photography, advanced video production, community management, customer service, Shopify administration and
 marketing are not included in this role.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a short paid practical trial using supplied Maison Mnandi Africa content.



The trial will require the candidate to:



* Create one completed 5–7-slide Instagram carousel using the supplied brand assets.

* Write one accompanying caption with a clear call to action.



A fixed payment of USD $20 will be provided upon submission of the complete trial task, regardless of whether the candidate is invited to the final interview or selected for the position.



Candidates who demonstrate strong visual judgement, storytelling ability, brand understanding and practical thinking will be invited to a final online interview with the Founder.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin the first line of your application with the word CULTURE in capital letters.



Please include the following:



1. A brief introduction explaining why Maison Mnandi Africa and this role interest you.

2. Links to social media accounts you currently manage or have previously managed.

3. Examples of Reels, carousels or other content you personally created.

4. Specific organic growth or engagement results you have achieved.

5. The tools you use for content creation, scheduling and analytics.

6. One content idea you would test for Maison Mnandi Africa.

7. Confirmation that you accept the core terms: part-time, deliverables-based, USD $300 per month and an initial three-month contract.



We are looking for someone who can bring both creative sensitivity and dependable execution to a growing African lifestyle brand. Generic or incomplete applications will not be considered.

description:
Full-time · 1099 contractor · Remote



A growing U.S.-based short-term rental management company is hiring a Cleaning Operations Manager to own cleaning, inspections, and supplies across a multi-state vacation-rental portfolio. This is a senior, hands-on leadership seat: you build and run the system, and a Cleaning Coordinator executes the day-to-day against it.



This is not an entry-level coordinator role. We want someone who has run cleaners at scale, can run the operation independently, and owns the results.



What you'll own



Cleaner & inspector team (hands-on)





Source, hire, and fire cleaners and inspectors across the entire portfolio — phone-first outreach and local referral networks (realtors, handymen, pool services), not job-board scraping

Negotiate rates, set up contracts, run software training, shadow first cleans/inspections, set up payments

Maintain a primary + backup cleaner for every property; stand up a one-time clean within hours when both fall through

Handle terminations directly under a clear three-warning policy — no delegating the hard call





Cleaning, inspection & supplies systems





Author and maintain SOPs at property and portfolio level for cleaning, inspections, and supplies

Set the quality standard — photo-verification rules, what cleaners capture, in what order, to what standard

Define and track KPIs: on-time clean rate, missed-clean rate, photo-upload compliance, cleanliness review scores, inspection cadence, finding-resolution time, and supplies cost ratio

Review your Coordinator's execution data weekly; flag drift and step in when standards slip

Design and run a performance-incentive program for top cleaners (recurring contracts, bonus rates, zero-claim premiums)





Claims (cleaning-side)





Oversee cleaner-related claims — documentation review, cleaner accountability, and damage evidence (photos, timestamps, severity) before claims are filed





Systems & process build





Help convert improvised processes into a repeatable SOP and property-data library the whole team operates against

Contribute to ops-level decisions on team structure, hiring sequence, and tooling





What you bring





Multiple years managing short-term-rental cleaning operations at scale — a portfolio of properties, not a single home

Hands-on experience with an STR turnover/cleaning-management platform (e.g., Breezeway, Turno, ResortCleaning, or similar) and a vacation-rental PMS

A full-lifecycle hiring track record — you've recruited and, when necessary, terminated cleaners

Experience designing cleaner incentive or performance programs

A strong systems instinct — you turn chaos into documented, repeatable SOPs

Reliable high-speed internet, a capable computer, and a quiet remote work setup



Logistics





Type: Full-time, 1099 independent contractor

Hours: Must overlap U.S. business hours (Central time zone preferred), Monday–Friday; longer hours during peak turnover periods or active onboardings

Pay: $1,200–$2,200/month USD, depending on experience; paid weekly via Wise/PayPal

Tools: STR cleaning platform, PMS, docs/knowledge base, Slack, and time-tracking software with activity/screen monitoring (standard for this role)

Standards: Daily standups, end-of-day summaries, weekly 1:1s, and a 30-day probation period





To apply



Send your resume and a short note (3–5 sentences) covering your STR cleaning-operations experience — portfolio size, platforms used, and one cleaner-performance problem you solved. Put the word TURNOVER in the subject line so we know you read the full post.

title: Client Intake Specialist & Case Manager - US Personal Injury Law Firm (Medical or PI Experience REQUIRED)
description:
*** PRIOR MEDICAL OR PERSONAL INJURY EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED ***

Applications without it will not be read. See "REQUIRED BACKGROUND" below.



US personal injury law firm hiring ONE full-time Client Intake Specialist & Case Manager. This is a long-term, career position - not a short project.



WHO WE ARE

Big Bubba Injury Law is a personal injury law firm in West Virginia, USA. We represent people who were hurt in car crashes. We do not charge our clients anything up front - we only get paid when we win. Our clients are ordinary working people, and many of them are scared, in pain, and have never spoken to a lawyer before.



===========================================

REQUIRED BACKGROUND - READ THIS FIRST

===========================================



You must have real, verifiable experience in ONE of the following. This is not negotiable and it is not a "nice to have."



MEDICAL:

- Nurse, nursing graduate, or medical assistant

- Medical records, medical billing, or medical coding

- Health insurance claims processing or utilization review

- Medical transcription or medical scribe work

- Medical VA work for a US clinic, hospital, or provider



OR PERSONAL INJURY / LEGAL:

- Intake, case management, or paralegal work for a US personal injury law firm

- Demand package preparation, medical records summarization, or lien resolution

- Auto insurance claims handling or bodily injury adjusting

- Legal VA work for a US plaintiff-side firm



You will be reading medical records every single day. You need to already know what an MRI report says, what a chiropractor's SOAP note looks like, what "MMI" means, and why a 30-day gap in treatment matters. We will train you on our systems and our law. We will not train you on medicine.



In your application, state exactly where you got this experience, how long, and what you handled. Vague claims will be rejected.



===========================================



THE ROLE

You are the voice of this firm. An AI answering service takes the first call and passes qualified callers to you. From that moment, you own the client.



Two jobs in one:



1. INTAKE AND CLOSING (the first hour of the case)

- Take the handoff from our answering service and call the injured person immediately

- Build trust fast, get the facts of the crash and their injuries, and confirm we can help

- CLOSE. Persuade them to hire us, send the e-signature link, and stay on them until it is signed. Most people call more than one law firm. The firm that answers with a real human who cares is the firm that gets hired. That is you.

- Follow up relentlessly on unsigned links - same day, next day, day three



2. CASE MANAGEMENT (the next 6-12 months)

- Be the client's single point of contact for the life of their case

- Weekly calls while they are actively treating; biweekly at every other stage. We do not let clients wonder what is happening.

- Collect, review, and organize medical records and bills as treatment progresses

- Track the client's treatment trajectory and flag gaps, pre-existing conditions, and missing providers

- Chase down records from doctors' offices, hospitals, and imaging centers

- Coordinate with insurance adjusters within the scope the attorney sets

- Keep every case file complete and current in our case management software

- Prepare the file for the attorney at each stage



You are not giving legal advice. The attorney makes every legal decision. You run the relationship and the file.



ALSO REQUIRED



- NEUTRAL, EASILY UNDERSTOOD AMERICAN ENGLISH ON THE PHONE. This is a hard requirement. Our clients are in rural West Virginia. Many are elderly, many are in pain, and many will hang up if they have to ask you to repeat yourself. You must be understood effortlessly on the first call. Excellent written English as well - you will be sending client
s and texts under our firm's name.

- Real experience persuading people on the phone. Sales, appointment setting, closing, retention, collections, or high-end customer service. Tell us specifically what you sold or closed and what your numbers were.

- Full-time availability on US Eastern Time, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM ET (9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine Time). This is a night shift in the Philippines. Do not apply if you cannot commit to it long term.

- Reliable computer, noise-free work environment, headset, and backup internet AND backup power. Our clients cannot hear roosters, tricycles, or family in the background.

- Empathy that is real. You will talk to people on the worst week of their life. If you cannot sit with someone who is crying and still get the information we need, this is not your job.

- Organized to the point of being obsessive. You will be managing 30-60 open cases at once.



BONUS

- Both medical AND personal injury experience

- Experience with case management software (Filevine, Litify, Smart Advocate, Clio, CasePeer, or similar)

- Experience with US health insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, or ERISA subrogation



WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive salary paid twice monthly, on time, every time

- 13th month pay

- Paid US holidays after 90 days

- Performance bonus tied to signed clients after 90 days

- Direct daily work with the firm's owner-attorney. No layers, no bureaucracy.

- Genuine growth. You are our first hire. As we grow, you lead the team.

- Full training on our systems and our process



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip any step will be deleted unread)



1. Put the word CHARLESTON in the first line of your application. This is how we know you read the post.



2. State your medical or personal injury experience in specific detail: employer, dates, and exactly what you handled.



3. Record a 90-second audio or video clip (Loom, Google Drive, or Vocaroo link) in which you:

   a. Introduce yourself and say why you want this job

   b. Then role-play this: you are calling Mary, 62 years old, rear-ended three days ago, neck and lower back pain, has not seen a doctor yet, and she is nervous about hiring a lawyer because she thinks it costs money. Get her comfortable, get her to see a doctor, and get her to say yes to signing with us. Improvise. We are listening to your voice, your warmth, and your ability to close.



4. In writing, tell us:

   - Your experience persuading people by phone, with specific numbers

   - Your exact home internet speed and whether you have backup internet and backup power

   - Confirm in one sentence that you can work 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM Philippine Time long term

   - Your expected monthly salary in USD



We read every application that follows these instructions. We hire one person and we intend to keep them for years.

description:

This person will be responsible for recruiting qualified graphic artists, assigning projects, reviewing artwork, managing deadlines, maintaining production standards, and communicating with our U.S.-based management team.
