title: Influencer Outreach VA - Dutch Food & Kitchen Creators (Instagram + Email, Pay Per Message)
description:
ABOUT US

 

We are No Layer Kitchen, a Dutch kitchenware brand. We make titanium cutting boards - a replacement for plastic and wooden boards that does not scratch into your food, does not soak up bacteria, and lasts a lifetime. Our customers are people in the Netherlands who cook almost every day and care about what ends up in their food.

 

We grow by getting our boards into the hands of real Dutch home cooks and food creators, not by shouting at strangers with ads. That is your job.

 

 

THE ROLE IN ONE LINE

 

Find the right Dutch food and kitchen creators on Instagram, send each one a short, genuinely personal Dutch message offering a free titanium cutting board, and keep a simple record of everyone you contacted.

 

Personal beats perfect. One real message to the right person is worth fifty copy-pasted ones. That is the whole philosophy of this job and it is exactly how we score your work.

 

 

IMPORTANT - ABOUT THE DUTCH LANGUAGE

 

You do NOT need to speak Dutch.

 

We give you a complete Dutch message system: a fixed message template, plus a library of ready-made Dutch opening lines sorted by situation (a recipe they posted, a dish, their kitchen, their kids, a holiday). Your job is to pick the right building block for that specific creator and fill in the real detail you saw on their account.

 

You will be trained on this in your first week. If you can follow a system carefully and pay attention to detail, you can do this job without a word of Dutch.

 

What you DO need is good written English, because that is how you and I will talk to each other every day.

 

 

WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO, EVERY DAY

 

1. FIND CREATORS

Search Instagram by Dutch hashtag and keyword. Starting terms we use: koken, recept, receptvandedag, foodbloggernl, kokenmetliefde, gezondkoken, mealprepnl, foodienl, keukeninspiratie, hollandsepot, avondeten, watetenwevandaag, bakkenmetliefde. Like and save relevant posts so the algorithm keeps feeding you the right accounts. We also give you access to a creator search tool.

 

2. CHECK EVERY ACCOUNT AGAINST THE CHECKLIST

Six points, below. If one fails, you skip the account and move on. No exceptions. This protects our account and your time.

 

3. SEND THE MESSAGE

Instagram DM using our Dutch system, about 2 minutes per message. If the creator has a business
 in their bio, you send the
 version instead - those get read more often and are worth more to us.

 

4. RUN THE FOLLOW-UPS

Up to 3 follow-ups per creator, spaced out, each one adding something new. Then you stop, politely. A closed door is better than a burnt bridge. We give you the exact follow-up messages.

 

5. LOG EVERYTHING

A simple sheet: 
 date contacted, channel (DM or
), follow-up stage, replied yes/no, outcome.

 

6. HAND OVER THE WARM ONES

As soon as someone replies with interest, you send them our Dutch brand PDF and pass the account to me so I can ship the board.

 

 

THE CHECKLIST - EVERY ACCOUNT MUST PASS ALL SIX

 

1. FOLLOWERS - between 1,000 and 50,000. Not below 1k, not above 50k.

 

2. LOCATION - based in the Netherlands and clearly posting to a Dutch audience. You can tell from Dutch captions, Dutch place names, and prices in euros. Belgium (Flemish) also counts.

 

3. ACTIVE STORIES - they have a story up right now, or they post stories regularly.

 

4. ACTIVE POSTS - they post almost daily. Their most recent post is no older than 2 to 3 days.

 

5. REAL ENGAGEMENT - a quick eye test, no maths needed. Likes and comments should look right for the follower count, and the comments should look like real people, not bots or single emojis.

 

6. THEY ACTUALLY COOK ON CAMERA - the account shows real cooking, real food prep, a real kitchen. They need to be able to show a cutting board in use. A food photography account that never shows the cooking does not pass.

 

 

THE KIND OF ACCOUNTS WE WANT

 

Go broad across all of these:

- Dutch recipe and home cooking accounts (our core)

- Meal prep and healthy eating accounts

- Dutch mum and family accounts where cooking is a real part of the content

- Kitchen and interior accounts where the kitchen is the focus

- BBQ, grilling and butchery accounts

- Bakers, if they also do savoury cooking

 

 

THE MESSAGE - THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THE JOB

 

Creators get dozens of identical "hi, we love your content!" messages every week and ignore every single one. The only thing that works is proving you actually looked at their account.

 

Every message must open with one specific, real detail about them, their cooking, or their kitchen. That one line is the difference between a real message and a bot.

 

THE FOUR PARTS OF EVERY MESSAGE

1. A unique, specific opening line about their account. Always. Never skip it.

2. Who we are - one warm sentence.

3. The offer - a free titanium cutting board, no obligation to post.

4. A soft, low-pressure question to reply.

 

GOOD OPENINGS - specific, clearly real

- "Die ovenschotel met prei die je gisteren postte staat vanavond bij ons op tafel."

- "Je keuken met dat groene tegelwerk is echt prachtig."

- "Ik zag dat je bijna elke week iets met vis doet - daar zijn er te weinig van."

 

BAD OPENINGS - generic, sounds like a bot

- "Hoi, we vinden je content geweldig!"

- "Je recepten zien er heerlijk uit, zin in een samenwerking?"

 

If a message could have been sent to anyone, it is wrong.

 

This is a quick scan, not deep research. You have about 2 minutes per message. Open the account, glance at the last few posts, grab one real detail, pick the matching Dutch building block, fill it in. Being quick is fine. Skipping the personal detail is not.

 

 

KPIs - HOW YOUR WORK IS MEASURED

 

We measure three things: volume, quality and outcomes. Volume on its own is worth nothing to us. A generic blast does not get paid and it hurts our account.

 

DAILY

- Qualified contacts sent: 150 target, 120 minimum (roughly 130 Instagram DMs + 20
s)

- Pace: about 30 per hour, around 2 minutes each

- Working hours: 5 to 6 hours

- Personal opening line present: 100 percent, always

- Checklist compliance: 100 percent, always

 

WEEKLY

- Qualified contacts sent: 750 target, 600 minimum

- Follow-ups sent on schedule: 100 percent of accounts that are due

- Tracker updated: every day

- One short summary message to me: every Friday

 

MONTHLY

- Qualified contacts sent: 3,000 target, 2,400 minimum (about 22 working days)

- Reply rate: 8 percent target (roughly 240 replies), 6 percent minimum. This is our main quality signal - generic messages destroy it

- Interested creators handed to me: 90 target, 60 minimum

- Duplicate or off-checklist messages: zero. No tolerance, this risks our account

- Spam flags or account restrictions: zero. No tolerance

 

MONTH 1 IS A RAMP MONTH

We expect roughly 60 percent of these numbers in your first month while you learn the niche and the Dutch system. We review together on day 14 and day 30.

 

WEEKLY QUALITY AUDIT

Every week I check 20 random messages from your log. Each one must have a genuinely personal opening line tied to that specific account. Messages that fail the audit do not count toward your paid total.

 

 

PAY

 

This is a performance-based role. There is no fixed monthly salary. You are paid for the work you actually produce and you control your own volume.

 

- $0.10 per qualified Instagram DM

- $0.15 per qualified
 (these take longer and convert better)

- +$50 monthly bonus if you hit 3,000 contacts AND an 8 percent reply rate

- +$50 monthly bonus if you hand over 90 or more interested creators

- $1.00 for every creator who receives a board and actually posts about it

 

WHAT THAT LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTICE

- Part-time, around 75 per day: roughly 1,650 a month, about $180 to $230

- Full pace, around 150 per day: roughly 3,300 a month, about $450 to $520

- Strong performer with a high reply rate: $520 and up

 

Paid twice a month, on the 1st and the 16th, via Wise or PayPal, based on your logged and audited contact count.

 

LONGER TERM

If you perform for three months straight, we move you onto a fixed monthly retainer plus bonus, and we grow the role into managing creator relationships from start to finish - onboarding, discount codes, and tracking which creators actually drive sales.

 

 

WHAT WE PROVIDE

 

- Access to the No Layer Kitchen Instagram account

- A VPN set to a Dutch location, which must be on before you ever open the account. This is not optional

- Access to a creator search tool

- The complete Dutch message system: template, opening line library, follow-up sequence

- The Dutch brand PDF to send to interested creators

- The tracker template

- A 60 minute onboarding call, then a short weekly check-in

 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 

- Strong written English. You and I communicate in English every day.

- Careful and detail-oriented. The checklist and the log are the job. I would much rather have 120 real messages than 200 fake ones.

- Genuinely interested in food and cooking. You will be looking at food content for hours. If that sounds enjoyable rather than boring, this is a good fit.

- Self-managing. You set your own hours. Nobody watches your screen.

- Reliable internet and a working laptop or desktop.

 

Instagram outreach or influencer marketing experience is a plus, not a requirement. We train you.

 

WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

 

- Anyone planning to copy-paste one message to hundreds of accounts. We audit for it and it does not get paid.

- Anyone who needs a guaranteed fixed salary from day one. This role pays for output.

- Anyone uncomfortable using a VPN or a shared spreadsheet.

 

 

HARD RULES

 

- Never open Instagram without the Dutch VPN on.

- Never contact an account that fails any checklist point.

- Never send the brand PDF in a first cold message. Only after they reply with interest.

- Never make health claims. We sell a better cutting board. We do not cure anything.

- Never promise a specific commission amount in the first message. That is what the brand PDF is for.

- Never contact the same account twice, and never send the exact same wording twice in a row.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

Send a message with the subject line: NOLAYER - [your first name]

 

Include:

 

1. A short intro. Who you are, and whether you cook.

 

2. THE TEST TASK. Go to Instagram and find TWO Dutch food or cooking accounts that pass all six checklist points. For each one, send me:

   - 
 and their follower count

   - one sentence in English describing the specific detail you would build the opening line around

   - one sentence on why they pass the checklist

 

3. Your realistic daily capacity and the hours you would work.

 

4. Whether you can receive payment through Wise or PayPal.

 

Applications without the test task will not be read. It takes about 15 minutes and it is the only thing I actually score.

 

I reply to every applicant who completes it, within 3 working days.

title: US Tax Preparer (Drake Tax) for Cross-Border CPA Firm | $9-$13/hr USD | As-Needed Now, Steady Hours from January, Full-Time Path
description:
We're a fast-growing US/Canadian cross-border CPA firm hiring a tax preparer to join our new delivery team. You'd be one of the first three hires, working directly with the founder, a dual-licensed US/Canadian CPA.



What makes this seat different:



1. Top-of-market pay, stated up front: $9-$13 USD per hour depending on experience, paid twice monthly via Wise, always on time. Hours are as needed to start: some weeks a file or two, some weeks none, while you learn our files. From January, steady part-time hours through tax season, and a full-time path for the right person. At full time, 13th month kicks in.



2. Most of the number-crunching is done before a file reaches you. You'll get completed workpapers and calculations to enter into Drake, fix entries that didn't come through cleanly, or pick up a return that's halfway entered and finish it. Your job is the part that needs a brain: organizing source documents, building workpapers, finishing the return, and catching what's wrong before the reviewer does.



3. You'll work with AI tools all day. Most of the firm's drafting, checklists, and workpapers are prepared by AI tools inside documented workflows. Full access to the same tools the founder uses.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Prepare US individual returns (1040 + common cross-border forms) in Drake Tax from organized workpapers

- Build clean workpaper files from client source documents

- Enter completed calculations into Drake, finish partially entered returns, and fix entries that don't tie to the workpapers

- Assemble e-file packages and track acceptances

- Learn our cross-border forms over time (1116, 2555, FBAR, 8938, 3520); we train, you grow into the specialty



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU HAVE

- 2+ years preparing US returns (firm experience preferred; volume matters more than complexity)

- Drake Tax experience strongly preferred (TaxDome familiarity a plus; both together puts you at the top of the list and the top of the band)

- Careful, accurate, checklist-driven working style; you verify rather than assume

- Good written English

- Reliable fiber internet and a quiet workspace



SCHEDULE: as needed through December, steady hours from January. At least 3 hours of overlap with US Eastern business hours on the days you work.



GROWTH: cross-border US/Canada tax is a specialty most preparers never get access to. We train you into it. The seat grows into senior preparer, and for the right person the firm will sponsor the IRS Enrolled Agent credential.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully; applications that skip a step aren't reviewed):

1. Put "DRAKE + your full name" in the first line of your application.

2. Attach your resume.

3. Answer in writing: (a) returns you've prepared per season and the software used, (b) years with Drake specifically (0 is an acceptable answer, say so), (c) your expected monthly salary, (d) your internet speed (screenshot).

4. Record a 2-minute Loom: who you are, the trickiest return you've prepared, and how you make sure your work is right before someone reviews it.



Shortlisted candidates get a paid test task ($25 for ~2 hours), then a video interview with the founder.

title: B2B Sales and Account Manager
description:
We have a premium headwear brand based in New York City. We make unbranded, better-fitting caps in three real sizes and sell them direct to consumers and to businesses that want custom embroidered caps for their teams, events, and merch. More than 500 companies have ordered from us, including Google, Shopify, The Ritz-Carlton, and Stanford University.



Our wholesale side is growing fast. We now handle around 125 wholesale and custom orders every month, and we need someone whose full-time job is making sure those customers feel looked after and come back.



## The role



This is a customer relationship role with two halves.



1. Wholesale customer success

- Reach out to every new wholesale customer after their order ships to make sure it arrived and they are happy with it

- Check in with existing accounts on a regular schedule (30, 60, 90 days and beyond) to see how the caps are being used, whether they need a reorder, and whether anything went wrong that we should fix

- Keep our CRM accurate and up to date for every wholesale account, including contact details, order history, notes from each conversation, and next follow-up dates

- Spot reorder opportunities (events coming up, new hires, seasonal needs) and bring them to the team

- Flag any issue, complaint, or at-risk account to the founders right away

- Work closely with the Lift Down team to learn our communication style and upsell tactics, and build a deep understanding of who our clients are and what they need



### 2. Instagram B2B outreach: Many businesses follow our Instagram after seeing one of our B2B ads. They are interested but not ready to order yet, or they mean to come back to our custom cap configurator and forget. Your job is to catch them before they go cold.



- Monitor new followers, likes, comments, saves, and DMs every day and identify which ones are business accounts, brands, agencies, or companies

- Assess whether an account is a legitimate business worth pursuing (real website, real team, real activity) versus a fake, spam, or irrelevant account

- Reach out to qualified accounts by DM or
, introduce Lift Down, and offer a blank sample cap so they can feel the quality

- Point them to our self-serve custom cap configurator and help them get started

- Log every lead in the CRM with a status and a follow-up date, and follow up on schedule until they order or clearly decline

- Report weekly on how many accounts you reached out to, how many replied, how many requested samples, and how many placed an order



## What we are looking for



- At least 2 to 3 years of experience in customer success, account management, or B2B sales, ideally for an ecommerce or product brand

- Sales experience is important. A big part of this role is turning interested followers into customers and existing customers into repeat customers, so you need to be comfortable asking for the order

- Excellent written English. You will be writing to US business owners, marketing managers, and procurement teams every day, and your messages need to read as clear, warm, and professional

- Able to write without relying on AI. Our customers should never feel like they are talking to a bot, so you need to be able to write messages in your own voice and style, without running everything through ChatGPT first. AI tools are welcome for working through complex problems or tightening up a sentence now and then, but your English has to be strong enough to stand on its own

- Hands-on experience keeping a CRM organized (any CRM is fine as long as you are disciplined about it)

- Comfortable doing outreach on Instagram and by
, and comfortable with polite persistence

- Good judgment about people. You can tell the difference between a real company and a time-waster, and you know when to push and when to back off

- Organized and self-directed. You will own your own follow-up calendar and nobody will chase you on it

- A real understanding of how different kinds of businesses work and buy. A 10-person startup, a marketing agency ordering for a client, a hotel, a university, and a Fortune 500 procurement team all have different needs, timelines, and decision makers, and you should be able to adjust how you talk to each one

- Comfortable dealing with large companies. Some of our customers are S&P 500 companies, and you need to be able to hold a professional conversation with them without being intimidated or overly casual

- Familiarity with Shopify is a plus

- Full alignment with the US Eastern schedule. You need to be online and available from at least 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



## Who you are



- Communication is the most important trait for this role. You write clearly, you listen well, and people enjoy hearing from you

- You understand how business relationships actually work. Trust is built over time, not in one message, and a customer who feels remembered is a customer who reorders

- Adaptable and a quick learner. We are a fast-growing company and things change often. You pick up new tools and processes quickly and you are not thrown off when priorities shift

- Comfortable with ambiguity. You will not always have a script, and you are fine figuring things out and asking good questions



## What you get



- A long-term, full-time role with a small team where your work is visible and directly affects the business

- Direct access to the founders. No layers of management

- A clear playbook for the customer journey, plus the freedom to improve it



## How to apply



We would rather read a few strong applications than a hundred generic ones, so please do the following.



(1) Put the words CLASSIC CAP at the start of your application subject line so we know you read this far.



Then, in your application, answer this question in a few sentences. Do not send a template or a copied cover letter.



(1) Tell us about a time you re-engaged a customer or client who had gone quiet. What did you say and what happened?



Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.

title: Transportation Tracker – Local Operations

Your primary focus is to ensure drivers are continuously moving, scheduled tasks are completed efficiently, operational issues are communicated to the appropriate teams, and all required documentation is completed before drivers leave pickup or delivery locations. You will work closely with U.S. Operations Leads to coordinate local executions, prioritize assignments, and handle ad-hoc operational needs throughout the shift. Because local volume may fluctuate, you should also be comfortable supporting OTR tracking and other transportation operations tasks when there are no immediate local executions.

• Support OTR tracking when local activity is limited and maintain organized documentation and complete shift handoffs for pending drivers, loads, and operational issues.



What Success Looks Like

• Local drivers stay productive, receive clear next assignments, and avoid unnecessary downtime.

• Daily local tasks are scheduled, prioritized, and completed efficiently.

• Truck, trailer, paperwork, and service issues are identified early and communicated to the appropriate team.

• Load data, tracking platforms, and delivery paperwork remain accurate, complete, and up to date.

Who We’re Looking For

title: Freight Billing Specialist
description:
GH Logistics is a growing freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. Built on disciplined systems, structured SOPs, and financial accuracy, we operate with a strong focus on execution, accountability, and real-time visibility.



As we scale nationally, we are hiring a Freight Billing Specialist to serve as a critical financial control point across both load validation and carrier invoicing workflows, ensuring loads and invoices are accurate, fully documented, dispute-free, and ready for Finance and factoring.



Role Overview

You will act as the final gatekeeper before loads and invoices move to Finance and factoring, ensuring every load is fully validated first, then properly invoiced and submitted. This role requires flexibility, ownership, and the ability to operate across both functions without compromising accuracy or SOP compliance.



What You’ll Be Doing



Load Validation

• Validate all loads before final status, ensuring correct Completed, Cancelled, or TONU determination.

• Review and correct load statuses in TMS and ensure all required documentation is complete, accurate, and properly uploaded.

• Verify financial accuracy, including rates, FSC, accessorials, fines, TONU logic, and other load-related charges.

• Investigate carrier disputes, maintain clear audit-ready notes, and resolve discrepancies before escalation.

• Ensure only fully documented, financially accurate, and dispute-free loads proceed to Finance, invoicing, and factoring submission.



Carrier Invoicing

• Upload and process carrier invoices accurately in TMS, verifying amounts against rate confirmations and approved charges.

• Ensure all required supporting documents are complete, including POD, BOL, detention, lumper, and other applicable receipts.

• Request and follow up on missing or incomplete invoices and coordinate with carriers or factoring companies as needed.

• Identify invoice discrepancies, resolve Held, Rejected, and Denied items, and escalate issues with proper documentation.

• Maintain audit-ready invoice records and ensure only complete, validated invoices proceed to Finance or factoring submission.



Fuel Surcharge Updates & Fines and Detention Processing

title: Trailer Repair Admin
description:
GH Logistics and AJG Transport operate a high-performance freight brokerage and asset-based transportation network specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, clear communication, and accountability. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup through delivery.



If you have experience coordinating equipment repairs, working with drivers and repair vendors, and keeping trailer operations moving during overnight hours, this role provides an opportunity to take ownership of a critical part of our Trailer Management operation.



Role Overview

You are responsible for maintaining overnight control of trailer repair activity and supporting off-tour Trailer Management operations. Your primary responsibility is to coordinate trailer repairs during the night shift, including high-volume on-road repair activity, while ensuring trailer records, repair statuses, documentation, and operational updates remain accurate in real time. You will work closely with the night repair team, drivers, carriers, repair vendors, facility personnel, and the Trailer Management team to keep equipment issues moving toward resolution.



The night team is also responsible for verifying and completing work handed off by the day team and delivering a fully reconciled and accurate board for the incoming day shift. This is an operations and repair coordination position. You will not physically repair trailers and you will not have authority to approve company spending.



What You’ll Be Doing



Overnight Trailer Repair Coordination

• Serve as the primary Trailer Management point of coordination for overnight and on-road trailer repairs, working with drivers, carriers, facilities, roadside providers, mobile mechanics, and repair vendors.

• Review reported trailer defects, gather photos, inspection details, diagnoses, estimates, parts information, and other documentation needed to determine the appropriate next step.

• Coordinate roadside service, mobile repairs, terminal repairs, inspections, trailer swaps, or equipment repositioning and follow up on vendor status, parts availability, completion timelines, and return-to-service expectations.

• Continue follow-up on repairs handed off by the day team until they are resolved or properly documented and returned to the day team.

• Escalate repair costs, safety concerns, major equipment issues, and matters requiring financial approval to authorized leadership; this role has no authority to approve spending.



Fleetio and Data Integrity

• Maintain Fleetio records overnight in real time and enter all repair, trailer, and operational updates handled during the shift.

• Ensure trailer repair statuses, locations, assignments, conditions, and related records remain accurate and current.

• Conduct overnight data integrity checks and investigate missing, outdated, conflicting, or incomplete information.

• Update and maintain records involving misused trailers, partner carrier trailers, repair activity, vendors, and supporting documentation.

• Identify and resolve discrepancies between operational information and system records before the morning handoff whenever possible.



Off-Tour Trailer Operations

• Run the required overnight trailer classification sweep and identify trailers requiring correction, investigation, or follow-up.

• Close operational gaps and unfinished trailer-related work handed off by the day team.

• Assist carriers requiring trailers and coordinate trailer availability, loading, seating, assignments, and related movements.

• Monitor and address trailer concerns that may affect drivers, facilities, customers, freight movement, or equipment availability.

• Handle additional overnight trailer-related tasks and maintain communication with facility personnel and designated internal operational contacts.



Documentation and Morning Handoff

• Maintain complete and organized trailer repair paperwork and supporting documentation throughout the shift.

• Clearly document completed work, pending repairs, vendor responses, equipment concerns, unresolved issues, and required follow-ups.

• Verify items handed off by the day team and document what was completed, remains pending, or requires escalation.

• Ensure every unresolved item has clear ownership, an accurate current status, documented next steps, and a proper handoff.

• Deliver the 8 AM handoff complete and on time, including a reconciled board accurately reflecting trailer locations, statuses, repairs, outstanding issues, and required follow-ups.



What Success Looks Like

• Overnight and on-road trailer repairs are acknowledged quickly, coordinated effectively, and consistently followed through toward resolution.

• Fleetio, trailer classifications, repair records, and other operational data remain accurate and updated in real time throughout the shift.

• Drivers, carriers, vendors, facilities, and internal teams receive timely and clear communication regarding repair and trailer needs.

• Repair documentation, escalations, and unresolved issues are complete, organized, and properly handed off without unauthorized spending decisions.

• The day team receives a complete 8:00 AM handoff with a fully reconciled trailer board showing completed, pending, and escalated items.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in trailer management, fleet operations, dispatch, transportation, roadside assistance, or maintenance coordination.

• Knowledge of common trailer repairs, components, equipment defects, and maintenance terminology; repair coordination experience preferred.

• Able to review driver reports, photos, inspections, diagnoses, and estimates, ask the right follow-up questions, and determine appropriate next steps.

• Strong communication, attention to detail, problem-solving, prioritization, and follow-through in a fast-paced overnight operation.

• Comfortable working independently and using Fleetio or similar fleet systems; Samsara, LoadStop, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace experience is a plus.

• Minimum 50 WPM typing speed, strong written and verbal English, and a reliable remote setup with backup internet and power.



Schedule and Work Setup

• Long term and full time remote independent contractor role

• Direct engagement with a US company, not an agency or BPO

• Current shift availability: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT

• Consistent availability during the assigned US shift is required

• Zoom presence with camera on is required throughout the scheduled shift.

• Time-tracking software is used for attendance, accountability, and performance support.



What You’ll Get

• Independent contractor setup with a $75 monthly insurance stipend after 30 days.

• Reliable biweekly payments and a stable, long-term opportunity that is not seasonal or project-based.

• Direct exposure to a live U.S. transportation and fleet operation.

• Meaningful responsibility over overnight trailer repair activity and maintenance coordination.

• Growth opportunities across Trailer Management, Fleet Operations, Maintenance Coordination, and broader logistics operations.



This role is built for someone who can keep control of trailer repairs after hours. You will not simply receive repair requests and pass them along. You will coordinate the response, maintain accurate Fleetio records, follow open repairs, support overnight trailer needs, clean up operational discrepancies, document what happened, and make sure the day team receives a reliable and reconciled picture of the operation every morning.

title: Senior AI Performance Video Editor — DTC / MRR Brands
description:
We're a fast-growing DTC health brand running paid social at scale.



We're on track to do $100K+ in revenue in our very first month, and we're building aggressively from here.



We're looking for a highly skilled AI video editor who can turn winning ad concepts into new, native AI videos — not someone who simply re-cuts stock footage or needs to be taught basic editing.



This is not a junior position.



You do not need to figure out our ad strategy yourself. We will train you on exactly how we want our ads built, how we research winning concepts, how we structure creatives, and what makes an ad a winner for our brand.



You'll get clear examples, proven frameworks, feedback, and direction from our team.



You'll be doing:



* Building our video ad engine: recreating proven winning concepts from competitors, indirect competitors, TikTok Shop, and other sources natively — using new B-roll, AI avatars, cloned voices, product integrations, and fresh executions so every ad feels original.



* Reworking competitor videos specifically for our product: we will regularly give you competitor creatives that are already proven winners. Your job is to rebuild/adapt those videos so they become completely relevant to our brand — including replacing the competitor's product with our own product, changing product-in-hand shots, creating new AI B-roll where needed, and making sure the script, visuals, and overall video feel like the ad was originally created for our product.



* Seamlessly integrating our product into existing concepts and scenes, including realistic product swaps, packaging replacements, product-in-hand shots, and AI-generated scenes where our product looks natural and believable.



* Turning our winning long-form static scripts into videos, including talking-head ads, VSL-style creatives, movie-credit ads, and other direct-response formats.



* Fast iteration: producing a high volume of new video creatives and variations every week.



* Following our proven creative frameworks and turning our direction into polished, high-quality finished ads.



* Using AI to create realistic custom B-roll instead of relying purely on existing stock footage.



Must-haves — NON-NEGOTIABLE:



* You must have previously worked with MRR / subscription brands doing at least $250K+ per month in revenue.



* Proven experience editing performance ads for established DTC / e-commerce brands.



* A strong portfolio showing paid-social creatives you've made for real brands.



* Strong hands-on experience with HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Nano Banana, and Veo3.



* Able to create your own AI B-roll, including realistic product-in-hand swaps and product integrations.



* Able to take competitor creatives and rebuild them specifically around a different product/brand, while keeping the winning concept intact.



* Able to recreate winning concepts from scratch without simply copying or re-cutting existing footage.



* Strong understanding of direct-response video editing, pacing, hooks, retention, captions, B-roll, and native social creative.



* Able to take direction, follow creative frameworks, and implement feedback quickly.



* Fast communication and reliable turnaround.



* You must be extremely fast without sacrificing quality. We expect roughly 2–3 finished video ads per hour, depending on the complexity of the creative.



We're looking for someone who is already very skilled at what they do. If you're still learning AI video editing, direct-response editing, or need extensive guidance to produce high-quality creatives, this role is not the right fit.



Nice to have:



* Experience specifically with supplements, health, wellness, or other direct-response products.



* Experience working with brands spending aggressively on Meta.



* Experience producing creatives at high volume for scaling brands.



Pay:



Starts at $10/hr, with a performance bonus from month 2 based on winning ads.



There is significant room to grow with us if you're consistently fast, reliable, and producing winning creatives.



How to apply:



* Send your portfolio, including examples of ads you've edited for other DTC/e-commerce brands.



* Tell us which MRR / subscription brands you've worked with and approximately how much monthly revenue they were doing.



* Tell us which AI tools you use and exactly how you use them in your workflow.



* Tell us approximately how many finished video ads you can realistically produce per hour.



Start your message with the words "A player" so we know you actually read this.

title: Senior SEO & AI Search Strategist (SEO/GEO)
description:
Senior SEO & AI Search Strategist (SEO/GEO)

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines



JAR Consulting Group is a U.S.-based digital marketing and technology company looking for an exceptionally strong SEO and AI Search/GEO professional.



Please read this entire posting before applying.



This is NOT an entry-level or intermediate SEO position.



We are not looking for someone who has simply used SEO tools, optimized WordPress pages, generated AI content, or recently started calling themselves a GEO expert.



We are looking for someone who can prove that their work has produced measurable organic search results and who has a sophisticated understanding of how search is evolving across Google, AI search engines, and large language models.



Our goal for our clients is straightforward:



Get them found, mentioned, cited, and recommended wherever their prospective customers search—including Google and AI platforms.



What Makes This Position Different

JAR is building a new SEO/GEO operating model combining:



Human expertise + first-party expert content + AI agents + automation + measurable search data.



We produce substantial original content through client interviews, podcasts, livestreams, videos, transcripts, articles, FAQs, and short-form content.



We are also building AI agents to automate repetitive SEO/GEO activities, analyze websites and data, identify opportunities, assist with content optimization, monitor performance, and eventually execute approved website changes.



We are not hiring someone to spend 40 hours per week performing repetitive SEO tasks that software and AI can perform.



We need someone capable of thinking, analyzing, developing strategy, validating AI output, identifying opportunities, and determining what needs to happen next.



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS

Please DO NOT APPLY  unless you meet these requirements.



1. Minimum 3 Years of Advanced SEO Experience

You must have at least three years of hands-on responsibility for SEO campaigns where you personally influenced measurable results.



We are not interested solely in years of employment.



We want evidence of results.



2. You Must Provide Proof of Your Work

Your application must include at least three examples of websites or campaigns you personally worked on.



For each example, explain:



Website/business

Your specific responsibilities

Starting situation

Strategy you implemented

Time period

Organic traffic improvement

Ranking/visibility improvement

Leads/conversions when available

Tools/data used to measure the results

What YOU personally did versus what the rest of the team did

Provide supporting evidence wherever possible, including screenshots from Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, BrightLocal, or other legitimate platforms.



If confidentiality prevents you from showing any evidence whatsoever of previous results, you must find a way to prove you have the experience. If you cannot prove real results, do not apply.  **We respect legitimate client confidentiality. You may redact names or sensitive information where necessary. However, you must be able to demonstrate that you have actually produced measurable results.



3. Advanced Ahrefs Experience

You should be highly proficient with Ahrefs, including:



Site Explorer

Site Audit

Rank Tracker

Keywords Explorer

Competitive analysis

Content gaps

Backlink analysis

Organic competitor research

Identifying actionable opportunities from the data

Simply having used Ahrefs does not qualify.



4. Strong Technical SEO Knowledge

You must understand and be able to work in:



Crawling and indexing

Google Search Console

Canonicals

Robots.txt

XML sitemaps

Redirects

404s

Internal linking architecture

Site structure

Core Web Vitals

Duplicate/thin content

Structured data/schema

Entity relationships

Local SEO fundamentals

You should be capable of diagnosing a technical problem and clearly explaining what a developer needs to fix.



5. Strong Local SEO Experience

Many JAR clients are established local and regional businesses.



You must understand:



Google Business Profiles

Local organic search

Local Pack/Maps visibility

Location/service-area strategy

Reviews and reputation signals

Citations/listings

Local competitive analysis

BrightLocal or comparable platforms



6. REAL GEO / AI SEARCH Experience

This is extremely important.



We are not looking for someone who watched several GEO videos, read some articles, or asked ChatGPT how GEO works.



We want someone actively working on AI search visibility.



Experience with platforms such as Scrunch, Profound, Peec AI, Otterly, Ahrefs Brand Radar, or comparable AI visibility platforms is strongly preferred.



You should understand concepts including:



AI mentions

AI citations

AI recommendations

Prompt tracking

AI share of voice

Citation/source analysis

Entity authority

Topic authority

Brand/entity signals

Content extraction and answerability

How traditional SEO intersects with AI discovery

How to determine WHY one business is being cited/recommended while another is not

You must be able to discuss strategies you have actually implemented, not simply explain GEO theory.



TECHNICAL & AUTOMATION CAPABILITY

You do not need to be a software developer.



However, our ideal candidate is technically comfortable.



Strong candidates will have experience with some combination of:



APIs

Webhooks

JSON

JSON-LD

HTML/CSS

Basic JavaScript

WordPress

GoHighLevel

Zapier

Make

n8n

AI APIs

LLM workflows

AI agents

Automated reporting/data pipelines

Python or other programming experience is a significant plus but is not required.



We have dedicated web development and AI automation resources. Your job is not necessarily to build everything yourself.



Your job is to be sophisticated enough to work alongside technical resources and help determine what should be built.



AI EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED

You must already be using AI professionally.



We expect familiarity with platforms such as:



ChatGPT

Claude

Gemini

You should understand how to use AI for research, analysis, content optimization, data interpretation, workflow improvement, and quality assurance.



We are specifically interested in candidates who think:



"How can we automate this?"



rather than:



"This is how I've always done SEO."



At the same time, we do NOT want someone blindly trusting AI output.



You must know how to validate it.



WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO AT JAR

Your role would increasingly focus on strategy, analysis, QA, and opportunity identification, while our automation systems handle more repetitive execution.



Responsibilities will include:



Analyze traditional SEO and AI-search performance

Determine why clients are winning or losing visibility

Analyze Ahrefs, Scrunch, BrightLocal, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and other data

Identify organic and AI-search opportunities

Conduct sophisticated competitive analysis

Develop keyword, topic, entity and prompt strategies

Analyze AI citations and sources

Determine why competitors are being recommended by AI

Identify content gaps

Recommend podcast/interview topics based on search opportunities

Review client transcripts and expert content for SEO/GEO opportunities

Determine which existing website pages should be strengthened

Develop internal-linking strategies

Recommend appropriate structured data

Monitor technical SEO health

QA AI-agent recommendations

Help improve SEO/GEO agents and automation workflows

Coordinate technical implementations

Work with content resources to turn client expertise into authoritative content

Help improve our internal SEO/GEO methodology as search continues evolving

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

This is a full-time, long-term position with JAR Consulting Group.



Starting compensation: $10–$20 USD per hour, based on demonstrated experience, technical ability, and proven results. Eligible for pay raises at 6 months and 1 year after employment based on performance.



We are willing to pay toward the top of that range for someone who can demonstrate that they truly have the experience and capabilities described in this posting.



Benefits include:



Paid time off

Paid local Philippine holidays

Company year-end bonus eligibility

Weekly Pay

Full-time, stable employment

Long-term opportunity for advancement

Direct access to company leadership

Opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals

Significant opportunity to learn and work with AI agents, automation, GEO, and emerging search technologies

We are building this position for the future. As your capabilities and responsibilities grow, there will be opportunities to grow with the company.



WHY WORK WITH JAR?

We understand that choosing the right company matters just as much as choosing the right employee.



JAR is a U.S.-based company, but we have worked successfully with talented professionals in the Philippines and South America for years. Our Filipino team members are a vital part of our company—not simply outsourced 'VA' workers completing tasks. Regardless of where you live in this world, if you are on the JAR Team, you are a full and equal team member. 



We want talented people who are looking for a place where they can contribute ideas, develop professionally, learn new technologies, and build something long-term.



We are investing heavily in AI, automation, SEO, GEO, website technology, content production, and our own internal systems. The person who joins us in this position will have an opportunity to help shape how those systems are built rather than simply being handed a checklist every day.



We also want candidates to have the opportunity to evaluate us.



For candidates who advance through our interview process, we will arrange an opportunity for you to speak directly with members of our existing Filipino team without company leadership on the call.



You can ask them about:



What it's actually like working at JAR

How our U.S. leadership works with the Philippine team

Company culture

Communication

Expectations

Workload

Growth opportunities

Anything else you want to know before d
 whether JAR is the right place for you

We want you to hear about the company directly from people in the Philippines who already work here.



APPLICATION TEST

We assume strong applicants know how to use AI.



Therefore, polished writing alone will not impress us.



We care about your thinking and your evidence.



Answer the following questions in your application:



Question 1 — Proven Results

Provide your three strongest SEO case studies.



Give us numbers.



Show us evidence.



Tell us exactly what you personally did.



Question 2 — GEO Proof

Describe a specific project where you attempted to increase a company's visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI results, Copilot, or another AI search experience.



What did you do?



What did you measure?



What changed?



If you have not actually done this yet, say so. Do not manufacture an answer.



Question 3 — GEO Strategy

A well-established roofing company ranks reasonably well on Google but is rarely mentioned when consumers ask AI:



"Who are the best roofing contractors in [City]?"



Walk us through exactly how you would investigate the problem and what you would do during the next 90 days.



Be specific.



Question 4 — AI Citation Analysis

A client's competitor is repeatedly recommended and cited by AI systems while our client is not.



How would you determine WHY?



What data and sources would you examine?



Question 5 — Automation

Name three SEO/GEO tasks you believe should be automated with AI agents and three tasks you believe should remain human-led.



Explain why.



Question 6 — Technical SEO

Give us the most difficult technical SEO problem you personally diagnosed.



What was happening?



How did you identify it?



How was it fixed?



What happened afterward?



Question 7 — Your Tools

Rate yourself 1–10 and state your years of hands-on experience with:



Ahrefs

Google Search Console

GA4

BrightLocal

Scrunch

WordPress

Schema/JSON-LD

ChatGPT

Claude

Gemini

APIs/automation

Python/programming



Do not give yourself a 10 unless you can defend it in a technical interview.



REQUIRED APPLICATION MATERIALS

Your application must include:



Resume/CV

LinkedIn profile, if available

Three SEO case studies with measurable results

Supporting screenshots/data

Answers to all seven questions above

Examples of websites you've personally worked on

Your expected hourly compensation in USD

Your preferred working hours in Philippine Time

IMPORTANT

Applications that do not include case studies and measurable proof of previous SEO results will not be considered.



Generic cover letters will not help you.



Copying this job description into ChatGPT and submitting a perfect AI-generated response will not help you.



We are going to ask you to demonstrate your knowledge live during the interview process.



EDUCATION

A bachelor's degree in marketing, computer science, information technology, communications, business, or a related field is preferred but not required.



Demonstrated ability and measurable results matter more to us than the name of your university.



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

Please don't apply if:



Your SEO experience is primarily writing articles

You primarily install SEO plugins and follow checklists

You've never personally been responsible for measurable SEO results

You cannot provide evidence of previous results

You have no technical SEO knowledge

You have no understanding of AI search/GEO

You believe GEO simply means writing content with ChatGPT

You aren't comfortable analyzing data

You don't understand schema

You cannot communicate clearly in English

You need detailed instructions for every task

You are uncomfortable learning rapidly

You dislike automation because you believe it threatens traditional SEO work

WHO WE WANT

We're looking for the person who reads this job description and thinks:



"Finally. This is where SEO is actually going."



You should be analytical, technically curious, skeptical of easy answers, obsessed with measurable results, comfortable working with AI, and excited about helping build a new operating model rather than inheriting an old one.



We aren't looking to fill a chair.



We're looking for someone capable of helping us build the next generation of JAR's SEO and AI Search operation.

description:
Scheduler / Office Coordinator



SLB In-Home Care — pediatric in-home nursing (Georgia, USA) · Remote (Philippines-based)

Reports to: Owners · works daily with the nurses, recruiter, and families



About the role:

SLB In-Home Care provides skilled nursing and personal-care support to medically fragile children across Georgia. We're

looking for a sharp, dependable Scheduler / Office Coordinator to run our day-to-day scheduling and family/nurse

communication desk.

You'll work alongside our automation — the system prepares the schedules, flags the changes, logs the calls, and builds

the tickets. Your job is the human side: review and confirm what the system prepares, make the calls, keep families and

nurses in the loop, and stay on top of the moving pieces so nothing falls through the cracks.



What you'll do:



* Scheduling: maintain the weekly nurse/caregiver schedules; review and commit schedule changes the system drafts;

keep the calendar accurate.



* Supervisory visits: schedule required nurse supervisory (SV) visits on cadence and send the reminders.



* Calls & texts: handle inbound and outbound calls and texts with families and nurses — return missed calls promptly,

confirm appointments, answer scheduling questions.



* Ticketing: own the request queue — log every family/nurse request, follow up, and close it out.



* Timesheet coordination: chase missing shift notes and timesheets and flag discrepancies (the system helps surface

these).



* Documentation: keep everything organized and up to date in our systems (CareBravo, ClickUp).



!!! Important — this is a phone-heavy, English-first role. You'll be talking to American families and nurses every day. Excellent

spoken and written English is required and will be tested in the interview. Dependability during U.S. Eastern hours is non-

negotiable.



Requirements:



Must have:

*Excellent spoken and written English — clear, warm, professional on the phone

*Strong organization and attention to detail; able to juggle many moving pieces without dropping any

*Reliable and available during U.S. Eastern business hours

*Comfortable working alongside software/AI — reviewing and confirming what the system prepares, not fighting it

*Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset



Preferred:

*Home-care, home-health, or medical scheduling experience

*Experience with scheduling / EVV software (CareBravo, or similar)

*Experience with ClickUp or a similar ticketing / task tool



Bonus:

*Experience working with a U.S. company or in U.S. healthcare / Medicaid

*Customer-service or call-center background





How to apply:

Please send your résumé and a short voice recording or Loom video introducing yourself (so we can hear your English),

plus brief answers to:

1. Describe your scheduling or coordination experience.

2. Do you have any home-care, healthcare, or U.S.-company experience?

3. What tools have you used — scheduling software, EVV, ClickUp, ticketing?

4. Tell us about a time you managed a lot of moving pieces or last-minute changes. How did you stay on top of it?

5. Your available hours in U.S. Eastern time, and your internet speed.





!!!! Only candidates with strong English and real coordination experience will be considered. This is a long-term role with room

to grow into an operations lead.

title: Video Editor For Dental Videos on YouTube
description:
I have 3 YouTube channels, and I need a new editor who uses DaVinci Resolve. I use a cloud-based team editing approach, which means you will need to learn to edit from proxy files and have the storage space to do it. I do about 3 videos a month. Each video pays $100 for videos under 15 minutes, and I offer up to $150 for longer videos; each video can also earn a bonus. Videos are usually about 7 to 14 minutes long.



REQUIREMENTS

1. YOU MUST USE DAVINCI RESOLVE and have a license to edit from the cloud. (You can use free version for trial but need full version after)

2. After the paid trial, you will need 1.3 TB of AVAILABLE STORAGE SPACE for all the proxies.

3. You must deliver videos on time. 



BONUS: 

I also offer bonuses for videos that don't require much follow-up editing and are done on time. For example, if the video pay is $100 and I don't need many revisions, I offer a $30 bonus, for a total of $130 per video. 



TEAM EDITING PROCESS

My projects are based on team editing, so I can make edits and notes myself. So the process is probably different from what you're used to.



My process involves: 1- Downloading the proxies from my server. 2- Chopping up the A-roll. 3- Adding B-roll. 4- Adding graphics, text, Titles, Transitions, and Music. 5- Changing the revisions that I send.



THE KIND OF VIDEOS & PROJECTS: 

The current channel for this job listing is called Baseline Dental on YouTube; you should watch some of the videos already done on that channel. Once you have my process down and edit well, I have 2 other channels, and I will give you more projects for them to earn more. You can expect to make $350 to $400 per month at first, doing 3 videos a month. If you edit fast and on time, I will move you on to other projects, shorts, and possibly other channels. Then you can expect to make about $400 to $600 or possibly more.



Each video will take about 6 to 8 hours once you are used to the process. It may take longer at first. 



My other channels are called The Proposal and Brielle Buck. However, at first we will just be working with the Baseline Dental channel.



PAID TRIAL:

This paid trial and process will take a few days to learn and set up. But after that, everything will get easier.



I have current editors who have been working for me for 5 years. I have been on YouTube for over 8 years. So this can be a reliable long-term job for you. I hope you will be my next editor!



Please apply and respond if you have used DaVinci and can deliver videos reliably and on time. Talk to you soon!

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper – QuickBooks Online
description:
We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented Part-Time Bookkeeper to join our team and support the bookkeeping and accounting needs of U.S.-based businesses.



This is not simply a data-entry position. We are looking for someone who understands bookkeeping and accounting principles, can accurately determine how transactions should be classified, understands how a Chart of Accounts works, and knows when something does not look correct.



The position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position for the right person.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for tasks including:



Maintaining accurate books in QuickBooks Online

Reviewing and categorizing bank and credit card transactions

Understanding and correctly applying the client's Chart of Accounts

Identifying transactions that may be incorrectly classified

Bank and credit card reconciliations

Reviewing accounts for duplicate, missing, unusual, or incorrectly recorded transactions

Accounts payable and accounts receivable support

Understanding and processing payroll

Reviewing payroll reports and payroll-related transactions

Recording payroll entries correctly in QuickBooks

Assisting with month-end bookkeeping and account review

Preparing and reviewing basic financial reports, including:

Profit & Loss

Balance Sheet

General Ledger

Accounts Receivable

Accounts Payable

Maintaining organized financial documentation and supporting records

Communicating questions, discrepancies, or missing information clearly to our team

Following up on unresolved bookkeeping items instead of leaving them incomplete

Required Qualifications



You should have:



Strong experience with QuickBooks Online

A solid understanding of bookkeeping and basic accounting principles

Strong understanding of Charts of Accounts

Experience accurately categorizing and classifying transactions

Experience performing bank and credit card reconciliations

Experience with payroll and an understanding of how payroll affects the books

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses is strongly preferred

Strong attention to detail

Ability to identify when financial information does not make sense

Ability to research an issue before asking for assistance

Ability to work independently and manage recurring deadlines

Strong written English communication skills

Ability to communicate questions clearly and provide enough information for someone else to understand the issue

Technology Skills



Our team primarily works within the Microsoft ecosystem. You should be comfortable using:



Microsoft Teams

Microsoft Outlook

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word

Microsoft OneDrive / SharePoint

PDF documents and PDF editing/organization tools



Strong Excel skills are important. You should be comfortable working with spreadsheets, sorting and filtering information, using formulas, and reviewing financial data.



Schedule



This is a 20-hour-per-week position, Monday through Friday.



You must be able to work during U.S. Central Time.



We are flexible regarding the exact schedule. An earlier Central Time schedule or a later afternoon Central Time schedule can both work. We care more about establishing a consistent schedule, meeting deadlines, and being available to communicate with our team when necessary.



The schedule can be discussed and finalized with the selected candidate.



Compensation



$6–$8 USD per hour depending on experience and qualifications.



Candidates with significant U.S. bookkeeping, QuickBooks Online, and payroll experience may qualify toward the higher end of the range.



There is an opportunity for increased compensation and transition to a full-time position based on performance, reliability, accuracy, and the growth of the role.



What We Are Looking For



Accuracy is extremely important in this role.



We want someone who does more than simply categorize transactions based on what QuickBooks suggests. You should be able to look at the transaction, understand the business activity, understand the Chart of Accounts, and determine whether the accounting treatment makes sense.



If you are unsure, we expect you to ask. We would rather have a clearly documented question than an incorrect assumption.



At the same time, we value people who are resourceful and will investigate an issue before immediately asking someone else for the answer.



To Apply



Please include the following:



A brief introduction about yourself and your bookkeeping experience.

How many years of QuickBooks Online experience you have.

Whether you have worked with U.S.-based businesses.

Your experience processing or reviewing payroll.

Your experience working with Charts of Accounts.

Your current availability in U.S. Central Time.

Your desired hourly rate.

Any QuickBooks, accounting, bookkeeping, or payroll certifications you currently hold.



Please also answer this question in your application:



A business purchases $650 of materials from Costco. What information would you want to know before d
 which QuickBooks account to categorize the transaction to?



There is not necessarily one correct answer. We are interested in understanding how you think through bookkeeping decisions.

title: T-shirt designer for POD
description:
One-Time Project: 20 High-Quality T-Shirt Designs for Print-on-Demand (POD)



About Us



We are 31 Thread Co., a creative, faith-rooted quilting and fabric business based in Tennessee, USA. Alongside our core fabric shop, we are expanding into print-on-demand t-shirts that reflect our love for creativity, quilting, lifestyle, and faith.



We are looking for a skilled designer to create 20 original, high-quality t-shirt designs that are professional, stylish, and ready for POD platforms such as Printful, Printify, or Gelato.



Project Scope

 • Create 20 original t-shirt designs in line with our brand (faith-inspired, quilting/lifestyle, and modern creative themes).

 • Designs must be print-ready: 300 DPI, transparent background, correct dimensions for POD.

 • Provide mockups for each design (on t-shirts for listing purposes).

 • Deliver files in both editable (AI/PSD or Canva/Kittl) and final PNG formats.



Requirements

 • Strong graphic design skills (Illustrator, Photoshop, Canva Pro, or Kittl).

 • Previous experience designing for print-on-demand t-shirts.

 • Ability to create polished, professional designs (not clipart-only or generic Canva text).

 • Must be original work — no stolen or copyrighted images.

 • Attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.



Compensation

 • Flat rate: $400 USD for 20 designs (approx. $20 per design).

 • Payment will be made upon satisfactory completion and delivery of all 20 designs.

 • Opportunity for future part-time work creating additional designs and helping with POD/Etsy/Shopify listings if this project goes well.



How to Apply



Please send:

 1. A short introduction about yourself.

 2. A portfolio or examples of previous t-shirt/POD designs you’ve created.

 3. Your preferred design tools (Illustrator, Photoshop, Canva, Kittl, etc.).

 4. Confirm that you are comfortable with the flat project rate of $400.



This is a great opportunity for a creative designer who loves making shirts that people are excited to wear. We want quality over quantity — bold, professional designs that fit our lifestyle + faith + creative brand.
