title: Real Estate Acquisition & Seller Solutions Closer – Listings, Cash Offers & Online Auctions
description:
REAL ESTATE ACQUISITION & SELLER SOLUTIONS CLOSER  

Listings • Cash Offers • Competitive Online Sales • Auctions



We are building a different kind of real estate seller-conversion platform and looking for an experienced **Real Estate Acquisition / Seller Solutions Closer** who can speak confidently with U.S. property owners and help them determine the best way to sell.



This position is for someone who understands that **not every motivated seller should be forced into a wholesale cash offer.**



Depending on the seller's goals, property, equity, condition, timing, and price expectations, we may be able to offer several different solutions.



Our goal is simple:



**Understand what the seller is trying to accomplish and move them toward the best available solution.**



### OUR PLATFORMS



Our seller and competitive-sale programs include:



**Realty Offers Now**  

Our seller-facing real estate marketplace and seller-solutions platform.



**
**  

Our competitive online bidding platform used for online real estate sales and auction-style transactions.



**Seller Options Now**  

Our motivated-seller platform for direct purchase opportunities and alternative seller solutions.



Our business combines traditional real estate, investor acquisitions, seller lead conversion, and competitive online bidding.



### SELLER SOLUTIONS MAY INCLUDE



Depending upon the seller and property:



- Direct cash / investor purchase

- Traditional real estate listing

- Competitive online bidding

- Real estate auction

- Offer-to-Sold competitive-sale strategy

- Accelerated sale

- Other structured seller solutions

- Continued follow-up and nurture when the seller is not ready today



We are looking for someone who can recognize the difference between these opportunities and confidently explain the appropriate solution to the seller.



### THIS IS A CLOSING POSITION



This is NOT primarily an appointment-setting position.



Our lead-generation team identifies and contacts property owners.



You will work primarily with:



- Interested sellers

- Warm seller leads

- Previously contacted property owners

- Sellers requesting offers

- Aged leads requiring re-engagement

- Property owners considering a Realtor

- Sellers whose price does not fit a traditional investor acquisition

- Sellers who may benefit from an accelerated or competitive-sale strategy

- Real estate agents who may have properties appropriate for our online bidding platform



Your responsibility is to **advance the opportunity.**



### YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Speak with warm U.S. property-owner leads

- Build rapport and trust quickly

- Determine the seller's true motivation

- Understand timing and urgency

- Discuss property condition

- Determine price expectations

- Discuss mortgage/equity information when appropriate

- Identify decision-makers

- Present and discuss potential selling solutions

- Handle seller objections

- Negotiate purchase opportunities

- Discuss realistic property values and expectations

- Recognize when a cash acquisition is NOT the right solution

- Transition qualified sellers toward a traditional listing when appropriate

- Explain competitive online sale and auction options

- Follow up persistently with sellers who are not ready immediately

- Ask for clear commitments and next steps

- Maintain detailed CRM records

- Coordinate qualified opportunities with management and licensed real estate professionals

- Help move seller opportunities toward signed agreements and completed transactions



### THE PERSON WE WANT



We are especially interested in candidates who have previously worked as:



- Acquisition Manager

- Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist

- Seller Lead Manager

- Real Estate Sales Closer

- Disposition Manager

- Wholesale Acquisition Manager

- Inside Sales Agent

- Listing Conversion Specialist

- Real Estate Investor VA with closing responsibilities

- Real Estate Sales Manager

- Lead Conversion Manager



Experience working with **U.S. motivated property sellers is strongly preferred.**



### DIRECT REAL ESTATE CLOSING EXPERIENCE IS HIGHLY VALUED



We want to hear from candidates who have personally:



- Presented offers to homeowners

- Discussed purchase prices

- Negotiated with sellers

- Handled price objections

- Followed sellers over multiple conversations

- Obtained purchase agreements

- Helped obtain listing agreements

- Worked transactions from lead through contract

- Coordinated closings

- Worked acquisitions and/or dispositions



If your only real estate experience is reading a cold-calling script and scheduling appointments, this is probably not the right position.



### MULTIPLE-SOLUTION SELLING



One of the most important parts of this role is recognizing that not every seller belongs in the same box.



For example:



A seller who needs immediate certainty and has a property requiring major repairs may be appropriate for a direct purchase.



A seller who wants closer to full market value may be better suited for a traditional listing.



A property where competitive buyer demand may produce a better result could be appropriate for a competitive online sale through RealtyBidNow.



A seller who wants market exposure but also wants a defined selling timeline may be appropriate for our Offer-to-Sold strategy.



Your job is to ask enough questions to determine the appropriate direction.



### REALTOR / AGENT OPPORTUNITIES



This position may also involve conversations with real estate agents.



RealtyBidNow can be used as an additional selling tool for agents who have clients or properties that may benefit from a competitive online sale or accelerated-sale strategy.



We cooperate with real estate professionals rather than attempting to remove them from the transaction.



Depending upon the opportunity and written agreement:



- The referring/listing agent may remain involved with their seller

- The agent remains informed and included

- Property marketing is coordinated collaboratively

- Photography and property presentation remain important

- Agent participation and referrals may be compensated according to the specific written agreement

- Our online bidding platform can become an additional tool for the agent and their client



You must be comfortable speaking professionally with both homeowners and real estate professionals.



### CRM EXPERIENCE



Experience with real estate CRM systems is important.



**Follow Up Boss experience is strongly preferred, but it is NOT mandatory for an otherwise exceptional acquisition closer.**



Experience with any of the following is valuable:



- Follow Up Boss

- Podio

- GoHighLevel

- InvestorFuse

- REISimpli

- REI BlackBook

- REI Reply

- Salesforce

- HubSpot

- Pipedrive

- LionDesk



You must be comfortable managing:



- Lead stages

- Notes

- Tasks

- Follow-up

- Pipelines

- Calls

- Text messages

-
 communication

- Long-term nurture

- Detailed seller histories



### TYPES OF SELLERS YOU MAY SPEAK WITH



- Inherited / estate property owners

- Tired landlords

- Absentee owners

- Vacant-property owners

- Properties needing significant repairs

- Pre-foreclosure owners

- Owners experiencing financial pressure

- Sellers relocating

- Investors

- Owners of rental property

- Commercial property owners

- Landowners

- Sellers with unrealistic price expectations

- Sellers considering traditional Realtors

- Sellers who already received investor offers

- Sellers who need weeks or months of follow-up before d



### COMMUNICATION STYLE



We do NOT want a robotic script reader.



You should be:



- Confident

- Professional

- Conversational

- Curious

- Persistent

- Comfortable discussing money

- Comfortable asking difficult questions

- Able to listen

- Able to challenge assumptions respectfully

- Able to control a sales conversation without being aggressive



Excellent spoken English is required.



### COMPENSATION



Expected base compensation:



**$1,000–$2,500 USD per month depending on experience**



We are especially interested in creating a compensation structure that rewards results.



Qualified candidates may receive:



- Base compensation

- Performance bonuses

- Signed-agreement bonuses

- Transaction bonuses

- Closing incentives

- Other performance-based compensation



The exact structure will depend upon the candidate's experience and role.



Exceptional performance may lead to increased responsibility in seller conversion, acquisition management, sales operations, or team leadership.



### WORKING HOURS



Approximately **30–40 hours per week**.



You must have meaningful overlap with **U.S. Eastern Time**, including normal daytime seller-contact hours.



This is intended to become a long-term position.



### REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



- Reliable computer

- High-speed internet

- Quiet professional workspace

- Quality microphone/headset

- Ability to participate in video meetings

- Reliable availability during agreed U.S. hours

- Backup internet or power solution strongly preferred



### HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with:



**“I ADVANCE REAL ESTATE DEALS”**



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed.



Then answer the following questions.



1. How many years have you worked in U.S. real estate?



2. Describe your experience personally speaking with motivated property sellers.



3. What was your most recent real estate position?



4. Were you personally responsible for negotiating with sellers and obtaining contracts, or did you primarily set appointments for someone else?



5. Walk us through one actual seller transaction you personally helped move from initial conversation through offer, negotiation, contract, and closing.



6. Approximately how many seller leads did you personally handle each week or month?



7. Approximately how many purchase agreements, listings, or other signed seller opportunities did you personally generate in an average month?



8. Describe your experience running comps, calculating ARV, estimating repairs, or determining offer prices.



9. Describe your experience with acquisitions and dispositions.



10. Which CRM systems have you personally used?



11. Have you used Follow Up Boss? If yes, explain exactly how you used it. If not, tell us which real estate CRM you know best.



12. A seller wants $275,000. Your direct purchase number is approximately $200,000. The seller is not distressed and says they would rather list the property than accept $200,000. What would you do next?



13. Have you ever worked with traditional listings, auctions, competitive online sales, novations, seller financing, or other alternative real estate sale methods? Explain.



14. Are you comfortable speaking with Realtors and real estate brokers about referring or cooperating on seller opportunities?



15. What hours can you consistently work in U.S. Eastern Time?



16. What base hourly or monthly compensation are you requesting?



17. Would you consider a base compensation plus performance bonuses or commissions?



### VOICE OR VIDEO SAMPLE REQUIRED



Please include a 60–90 second voice or video introduction.



Tell us:



- Your name

- Your real estate background

- Your acquisitions/closing experience

- The types of sellers you have worked with

- Why you believe you can advance seller opportunities rather than simply schedule appointments



We are looking for an experienced real estate professional who understands one important principle:



**The goal is not to force every seller into one offer. The goal is to find the right path to a transaction.**

title: CLNR Studios | Script Writer
description:
Short-Form Video Scriptwriter & Content Strategist



Company: CLNR Studios  

Position: Remote, freelance or part-time  

Compensation: Competitive and based on experience  

Potential: Long-term, ongoing work



About CLNR Studios



CLNR Studios is a creative production company helping brands, founders, and professionals produce high-quality short-form video content.



We’re looking for a skilled scriptwriter and content strategist who can transform our clients’ expertise, experiences, and ideas into compelling videos that position them as credible subject-matter experts.



This role goes beyond writing dialogue. You should understand storytelling, music, pacing, audience retention, visual direction, production, and the complete creative process behind winning short-form content.



Responsibilities



- Research each client, their industry, target audience, competitors, and content opportunities

- Turn complex topics into clear, engaging, easy-to-understand scripts

- Write educational, informational, storytelling, promotional, and authority-building content

- Create powerful hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds

- Structure scripts to build curiosity and retain viewers

- Help clients sound knowledgeable, confident, natural, and authentic

- Adapt each script to the client’s unique voice, personality, and audience

- Write scripts around music, including specific songs, instrumentals, beats, or audio trends

- Structure dialogue, visuals, cuts, and transitions to match a track’s rhythm, tempo, mood, and beat changes

- Identify musical moments for emotional shifts, reveals, transitions, pauses, and visual payoffs

- Create detailed shot lists and visual directions

- Recommend B-roll, camera angles, demonstrations, props, graphics, and on-screen text

- Provide editor notes for captions, sound effects, transitions, pacing, animations, and pattern interrupts

- Generate content ideas based on client goals, audience questions, current conversations, and industry topics

- Rewrite and improve scripts based on internal feedback, client feedback, and performance data

- Collaborate with producers, directors, editors, and account managers

- Maintain organized content calendars, scripts, and approval workflows



Writing to Music



The ideal candidate understands how music influences the structure and emotion of a video. You should be able to:



- Select or recommend music that supports the intended tone

- Write concepts inspired by the mood and progression of a track

- Time dialogue, actions, and visuals around musical cues

- Mark timestamps, beats, drops, transitions, and emotional changes

- Build anticipation before a musical payoff

- Plan montage sequences that cut naturally to the beat

- Use silence and pauses intentionally

- Communicate music timing clearly to production and editing teams

- Create alternative versions when music licensing or platform restrictions require different tracks



What Every Script Should Include



- Content objective

- Target audience

- Recommended video length and platform

- Multiple hook options

- Spoken dialogue or voiceover

- Story or information structure

- Visual hook

- Shot-by-shot breakdown

- A-roll and B-roll directions

- Camera angles and framing suggestions

- On-screen text and caption emphasis

- Graphics, screenshots, props, or demonstrations

- Editing and pacing notes

- Music recommendation or creative direction

- Musical timestamps and beat cues when applicable

- Sound-design opportunities

- Pattern interrupts

- Call to action

- Alternative ending or CTA when appropriate



Requirements



- Proven experience writing scripts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or similar platforms

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, hooks, retention, and audience psychology

- A strong sense of rhythm, timing, musicality, and emotional pacing

- Experience writing scripts or visual sequences around music

- Ability to establish authority without making clients sound stiff or overly promotional

- Ability to capture different voices rather than making every client sound the same

- Strong research and fact-checking skills

- Ability to write natural dialogue that sounds good when spoken aloud

- Experience creating shot lists and visual concepts

- Understanding of video production and post-production

- Awareness of captions, B-roll, motion graphics, music licensing, sound design, and editing

- Ability to accept feedback and revise work quickly

- Excellent organization, communication, and deadline management

- Ability to manage multiple clients and projects



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with founders, executives, coaches, consultants, or personal brands

- Experience writing both story-driven and educational content

- Knowledge of direct-response copywriting and calls to action

- Experience conducting client interviews or extracting content from long-form recordings

- Familiarity with social media analytics and performance-based iteration

- Basic knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, music editing, Notion, and Google Docs

- Experience working with a creative agency, production company, or music-driven content team



To Apply



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your short-form scriptwriting experience  

2. Your portfolio or writing samples  

3. Three short-form scripts you’ve written  

4. Examples of shot lists or visual directions you’ve created  

5. An example of a script or video that was structured around music  

6. Links to published videos based on your scripts, if available  

7. Your availability and time zone  

8. Your rate and typical turnaround time  

9. A brief description of your research and writing process  



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief paid test assignment based on a client profile, creative brief, and selected music track.



We’re looking for a hardworking, thoughtful, and highly creative writer who understands how to combine expertise, storytelling, visuals, and music into content people genuinely want to watch. For the right person, this can become a consistent, long-term opportunity with CLNR Studios.

* Competitive offer or accelerated-sale strategy

* Traditional real estate listing

* Competitive online sale / Offer-to-Sold strategy

* Continued nurture and follow-up when the seller is not ready today



The successful candidate must listen to the seller, understand what they're trying to accomplish, and guide the conversation toward the right solution.



### YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

* Call warm and qualified seller leads

* Follow up consistently with previously contacted property owners

* Build rapport quickly with U.S. homeowners

* Determine seller motivation, timing, property condition, price expectations, and decision-making factors

* Ask strong discovery questions instead of simply reading a script

* Handle pricing objections professionally

* Discuss unrealistic seller expectations without losing rapport

* Negotiate with motivated property sellers

* Explain multiple selling options clearly and confidently

* Maintain control and direction of telephone conversations

* Ask for commitments and establish definite next steps

* Recognize when a seller should move toward a direct purchase, listing, competitive-sale solution, or continued nurture

* Maintain persistent follow-up with sellers who are not ready immediately

* Keep complete and accurate CRM notes after every conversation

* Create and manage follow-up tasks

* Maintain correct stages, tags, and pipeline status

* Communicate important opportunities to management

* Help move qualified seller opportunities from initial interest toward signed agreements and completed transactions



You should have hands-on experience using Follow Up Boss for:

* Contacts

* Notes

* Tasks

* Calling

* Text messaging

*

* Stages

* Tags

* Smart Lists

* Action Plans

* Follow-up

* Pipeline management



Please do not apply if you have never personally used Follow Up Boss.



### EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Strong candidates will have previous experience with one or more of the following:

* Real estate acquisitions

* Motivated seller leads

* U.S. real estate investing

* Acquisition management

* Wholesale real estate

* Residential real estate sales

* Real estate ISA / inside sales

* Listing conversion

* Seller lead management

* High-ticket telephone sales

* Negotiation and objection handling



Experience speaking directly with U.S. property owners is strongly preferred.



You should be comfortable speaking with sellers in situations involving:

* Inherited properties

* Vacant properties

* Landlords

* Properties needing repairs

* Distressed properties

* Relocation

* Financial pressure

* Foreclosure situations

* Sellers considering a Realtor

* Sellers comparing cash offers

* Sellers with unrealistic price expectations

* Sellers who need repeated follow-up before making a decision



### THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT POSITION IF YOU:

* Mainly schedule appointments

* Only have cold-calling experience

* Depend completely on a script

* Are uncomfortable discussing money

* Are afraid to challenge a seller's price expectations

* Give up after receiving an objection

* Do not follow up consistently

* Need someone to tell you every day who to call

* Fail to maintain detailed CRM records

* Have never worked with motivated property sellers



We want someone who understands the difference between **having a conversation and advancing a deal.**



### COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENTS



Excellent spoken and written English is required.



Because you will speak directly with U.S. homeowners, your telephone communication must be professional, natural, confident, conversational, and easy to understand.



We care much more about your ability to communicate, listen, negotiate, and close than we do about having a perfect résumé.



### WORKING HOURS



You must be available during **U.S. Eastern Time business and early-evening seller contact hours**.



The position is expected to begin at approximately **30 hours per week**, with the opportunity to expand based upon performance and lead volume.



### COMPENSATION

Base compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated ability.



Expected range:

**$800–$2,000 USD per month**



Exceptional candidates may qualify for additional **performance-based bonuses and transaction incentives**.



We are looking for a long-term team member. Strong performance can lead to increased responsibility, compensation, and the opportunity to play a larger role in our seller-conversion operation.



### REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS



You must have:

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer

* Professional headset with microphone

* Quiet and professional calling environment

* Backup internet or power solution preferred

* Ability to participate in video meetings

* Ability to work reliably during agreed U.S. hours



### HOW TO APPLY



**Generic applications will not be considered.**



Your application must include the information requested below.



Start your application with the words:



**“I CLOSE SELLER LEADS”**



This shows you read the entire job posting carefully.



Then answer each of the following questions:



1. Describe your experience speaking directly with motivated U.S. property sellers.



2. What real estate companies or investors have you previously worked with, and what exactly were you responsible for?



3. Were you primarily a cold caller/appointment setter, or were you personally responsible for converting and closing seller opportunities? Explain.



4. Approximately how many seller leads did you personally handle each week?



5. Approximately how many resulted in contracts, listings, appointments, or other committed opportunities?



6. Describe your experience with **Follow Up Boss**. Tell us specifically which Follow Up Boss features you have personally used.



7. A homeowner tells you: “Zillow says my house is worth $250,000, so I'm not taking $190,000.”



Write exactly what you would say next as if you were actually speaking with the seller. Do not explain your sales strategy.



8. A homeowner says: “I'm not in a hurry. I'll just list it with a Realtor if I don't get my price.”



Write exactly how you would continue the conversation.



9. Tell us about one difficult seller objection you successfully overcame. What was the objection, what did you say or do, and what happened?



10. Have you ever worked for a company that could offer sellers multiple solutions, such as cash purchase, traditional listing, novation, auction/competitive sale, seller financing, or another sale strategy? Explain.



11. What hours can you consistently work in U.S. Eastern Time?



12. What monthly base compensation are you seeking?



### REQUIRED VOICE SAMPLE



Include a link to a **60–90 second voice or video introduction**.



Tell us:

* Your name

* Your real estate sales experience

* How long you have worked with U.S. property sellers

* Your Follow Up Boss experience

* Why you believe you can close motivated seller leads



We may not consider applications without the requested voice/video introduction.



We are specifically looking for someone who has already spoken with **motivated property sellers and moved those conversations toward contracts, listings, or another definitive commitment.**



If you are an experienced seller closer looking for a long-term position where your ability to convert opportunities will be recognized and rewarded, we want to hear from you.

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Content Assistant
description:
I’m looking for a creative, reliable video editor to help me turn raw video footage into engaging short-form content for multiple social media accounts and platforms.



I create content in more than one niche, including travel/lifestyle content and quilting/fabric content. I am comfortable filming and talking on camera, but I need someone who is good at looking through raw footage, identifying the story or interesting moments, and turning those pieces into polished content for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



This is more than simply cutting clips together. I’m looking for someone who understands short-form storytelling, hooks, pacing, captions, music, B-roll, and what makes people continue watching.



Some videos will come with very specific instructions. Other times, I may send you a collection of footage along with a voice note or short explanation of what I was doing, and I’d like you to be able to suggest or create several pieces of content from it.



For example, I may send footage from a trip and want you to identify several possible videos: a travel experience/story, things I learned, a hotel or destination review, a funny observation, or useful tips. On the quilting side, footage might include new fabric arrivals, products, behind-the-scenes clips, demonstrations, or me talking about a particular collection.



Responsibilities include:



* Edit short-form vertical videos from raw footage

* Find strong hooks and remove unnecessary footage

* Add captions/on-screen text, B-roll, music and simple graphics when appropriate

* Create multiple pieces of content from longer filming sessions when possible

* Format/adapt videos for TikTok, Instagram,
 and YouTube Shorts

* Help identify good content within the footage I provide

* Organize edited content so it is ready for consistent/daily posting

* Follow the different style and audience of each account

* Communicate clearly and meet agreed-upon deadlines



I would especially like someone who can eventually learn my voice and editing preferences so that I can film the content, provide context, and trust you to help turn it into finished posts without needing detailed instructions for every video.



You do NOT need experience with quilting. You do need to be curious enough to learn what matters to the audience and understand that the different accounts will have different styles.



I value creativity and judgment more than flashy editing. The goal is content that feels natural, personable and interesting — not overly produced or generic.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a great fit if you:



* Have experience editing TikTok/Reels/Shorts

* Understand hooks, retention and short-form storytelling

* Have a good sense of pacing and what should be cut

* Can work independently instead of needing frame-by-frame instructions

* Are comfortable receiving raw footage and figuring out how to use it

* Have excellent written English for captions and on-screen text

* Are organized and dependable

* Are interested in a long-term position and growing with the accounts



Experience with travel, lifestyle, UGC, creator or e-commerce content is a plus.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience.

2. Links to 3–5 short-form videos you personally edited.

3. Tell me which parts of those videos you were responsible for.

4. Tell me what editing software you use.

5. Tell me approximately how many short-form videos you can realistically edit per week.

6. Tell me your hourly rate or preferred monthly rate.

7. Start your application with the word SUNSHINE so I know you read the entire job post.



I may ask shortlisted applicants to complete a small paid editing test using the same raw footage so I can compare editing style, storytelling and creative judgment.

title: Transportation Tracker - OTR Operations
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its route operations division and seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to help support and streamline our daily transportation duties. We are looking for a Transportation Tracker to support real time fleet movement, manage load data accuracy, and ensure smooth coordination between drivers, customers, and internal teams.



Role Overview

You will serve as a real time control point within route operations. Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor lanes, driver movement, load progress, ETAs, and service requirements using GPS and TMS.

• Assign and dispatch loads based on driver availability, Hours of Service, customer requirements, and operational priorities.

• Maintain accurate real-time load data, check calls, timestamps, delivery milestones, and documentation in TMS and Google Sheets.

• Communicate with drivers, brokers, and customers while proactively addressing delays, route conflicts, detention risks, and other service issues.

• Follow established dispatch and escalation SOPs, provide clear shift reports and handoffs, and escalate operational risks to leadership as needed.



What Success Looks Like

• Monitor lanes and critical loads with urgency, accuracy, and consistency from start to finish.

• Maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date information across TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms.

• Provide scheduled updates on time with clear, concise, and actionable communication.

• Identify and escalate operational risks early, bringing solutions and next steps whenever possible.

• Maintain smooth and well-documented shift handoffs, and demonstrate reliability during high-pressure situations.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in logistics, freight brokerage, dispatch, transportation tracking, or similar operations, with an understanding of fleet coordination, load planning, and Hours of Service.

• Ability to monitor multiple loads and drivers simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, urgency, and proper prioritization in a live dispatch environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills across Zoom, chat, and
, with a minimum typing speed of 45 WPM.

• Highly detail-oriented with sound judgment, strong follow-through, and the ability to operate effectively in high-volume communication environments.

• Team oriented, coachable, and dependable, with a willingness to follow established processes, accept feedback, and collaborate without resistance or ego.



Why Join AJG Transport?

• Permanent remote opportunity with a stable, long-term setup.

• Structured systems, clear expectations, and defined performance KPIs.

• Hands-on leadership with direct feedback, coaching, and support.

• Measurable growth opportunities within a scaling freight brokerage.

• Performance recognition with advancement potential for strong contributors.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct hire, full time position with a US based company, and permanent work from home setup.

• Available shift: Monday - Saturday 7 PM - 5 AM CDT & Friday - Tuesday 10 PM - 8 AM CDT

• Zoom presence with camera on and audio unmuted is required throughout the scheduled shift.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance support.



If you thrive in fast moving transportation operations, understand the importance of real-time coordination, and can execute lanes with precision under pressure, we want to hear from you.

description:
We're a fast-growing cross-border CPA firm (US + Canadian clients) hiring the person who does the client work day to day, so the founder, a dual-licensed US/Canadian CPA, can step back to reviewing it. Not a data-entry seat and not a pure admin seat. You take each client file from the first document to the filed return, and you handle the client conversation along the way.



Why this posting is worth your attention:



1. Top-of-market pay, stated up front: $2,200-$3,000 USD per month depending on experience, plus 13th month, a health (HMO) allowance after your first 3 months, and paid leave. You're being hired to run files through it, well, every day.



3. You're the first hire on delivery, and the firm is growing fast. Do this seat well and the people hired after you will learn it from you. We'd rather promote from inside than hire over you.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Each client file end to end: organize the source documents, build or check the workpapers, prepare or finish the return in Drake, get it review-ready, get it filed

- The client thread in TaxDome: document requests, follow-ups, questions, status updates, in plain, clear English

YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU HAVE

- Output: you finish files. You don't polish one forever while five others wait

SCHEDULE: US Eastern business hours (roughly 9am to 5pm ET). This seat is who clients and the founder reach during the day, so it runs on the US clock. Night shift by Philippine time, and the pay reflects it.



ONE EMPLOYER: This is a full-time job with us, not a client engagement. We're not looking for a freelancer who runs several clients at once. A small side job in your off-hours is fine if you tell us about it; a second full-time client is not.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully; applications that skip a step aren't reviewed):

1. Put "CLOUD + your full name" in the first line of your application.

2. Attach your resume, and make sure your OnlineJobs profile shows your IQ and English test results (take them if you haven't; they matter for this seat).

3. Answer in writing: (a) returns you've prepared per season and the software used, (b) the messiest client file you took from start to finish and how you kept it moving, (c) a time you caught an error in a return before it was filed, and how, (d) your current work commitments, if any, and confirmation you're available for this seat full time, (e) your expected monthly salary, (f) your internet speed (screenshot).

title: AI Video Generation Operator (Full Time, Long Term, Training Provided)
description:
We produce AI generated video ads for international brands. Demand has grown past what one person can produce, so we are hiring one person to train as our AI video generation operator.



This is not a button pushing role. You will be trained directly by the founder to do the real creative generation work.



What the job actually is:



You will be given a reference video. Your job is to study it, work out how it was built, write the prompts, generate the clips, and pick the best output from everything you generate.



Most of the work is reference based, which means you are not inventing from nothing. You are looking at something that already works and rebuilding it. That is a skill that can be taught, and we will teach it.



The most important part of the job is judgment. When you generate clips, you need to know which three are actually good and why the other seventeen failed. That is the skill we care about most and it is the one we will build in you.



Who this is for:

-You have played with AI video tools and you have an eye for what looks right and what looks fake or off

-You are willing to generate twenty versions to get three good ones without getting frustrated

-You notice small details. Hands, faces, lighting, motion, timing

-You want a stable long term role, not a series of short gigs

-You are coachable and you want to get genuinely good at something



You do not need years of experience. You do not need a long list of tools on your resume. If you have the eye and the patience, we will train the rest.



Who this is not for:

-You are planning to start your own agency soon and want a stepping stone

-You want to be handed a template and repeat it without thinking

-You juggle several clients and would treat this as one of many side gigs



What you get:

-Direct training, including recorded walkthroughs of real jobs

-Paid access to the tools. You will never be asked to burn your own credits

-A clear standard and real feedback, not vague direction

-Salary that grows as your quality grows

-Long term stability. We are building a team, not filling a gap





Hours:



Full time, 40 hours per week, Philippine timezone.



Requirements:



-Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video work

-Good written English

-Video editing is a strong bonus. Not required, but if you can cut, caption, and assemble simple videos in CapCut, say so. -There will be editing work during quieter periods, especially early on

-Willing to sign a simple confidentiality agreement. Our client work is private





How to apply:



Read this carefully. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.



1. Start your application with the word LOCKED so I know you read the whole post.

2. Send two or three complete AI generated videos you have made. Full finished videos, not single clips or raw generations. They do not need to be client work. Personal projects are fine.

3. Tell me which tools you have used and what your setup is. Include any editing tools you know.

4. Tell me when you can start.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short paid test on real work. You will be paid for that test whether or not you are hired.

title: Hiring: Full Time Virtual Assistant

The primary focus of this role will be managing incoming leads, communicating with potential sellers and customers, and identifying worthwhile purchasing opportunities through
 Marketplace and other online platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Management & Communication

• Respond to and manage incoming leads from
 Marketplace related to diabetic supply reselling.

• Communicate with potential customers and sellers through
 Messenger and other communication channels.

• Follow provided SOPs and scripts while keeping conversations natural, professional, and engaging.

Deal Sourcing & Marketplace Research

Coordination & Scheduling

General Business Support

Requirements

title: Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager
description:
# Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager



## About Us



We’re an AI-first marketing agency based in Australia, focused on performance, systems, innovation, and building things properly.



We work across paid media, primarily Google Ads and Meta Ads, alongside SEO, automation, AI tools, reporting systems, Shopify, lead generation, and custom internal apps.



We move fast, solve problems quickly, and constantly improve the systems inside the business.



We are not looking for someone who simply follows SOPs.



We are looking for someone who can think independently, identify problems, improve systems, take ownership, and help us scale.



This is not a junior role.



This is a long-term role for somebody who wants to grow with the company and become a core part of the team.



---



## The Role



We are hiring a full-time Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager.



Your role will involve managing campaigns, improving systems, building reporting processes, working with AI tools, solving operational problems, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients.



You will work directly with the founder and become heavily involved in the operational side of the agency.



This is a dynamic role, not a repetitive VA role.



Some weeks you may be:



* launching Meta campaigns

* optimising Google Ads campaigns

* improving reporting systems

* troubleshooting tracking issues

* improving attribution accuracy

* helping build AI workflows

* auditing landing pages

* improving internal systems

* managing Shopify marketing tasks

* identifying inefficiencies before anybody else notices them



We value initiative very highly.



You should already be comfortable independently launching and managing campaigns.



If you wait to be told every small step, this role is not for you.



---



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



* Setting up and managing Google Ads campaigns

* Setting up and managing Meta Ads campaigns

* Monitoring performance and improving campaign results

* Creating and improving reporting systems

* Building dashboards and client reporting workflows

* Setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking

* Managing Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel, and Events Manager setups

* Diagnosing tracking issues and ensuring accurate attribution

* Working with AI tools to improve efficiency

* Assisting with SEO-related tasks and strategy

* Helping improve agency systems and operations

* Identifying problems proactively and solving them independently

* Supporting onboarding workflows for new clients

* Working with Shopify stores where required

* Providing weekly campaign updates and operational updates



Potential future client-facing opportunities are available for candidates with exceptional communication skills and presentation ability.



---



## What We’re Looking For



### Required Skills



* Strong Google Ads experience

* Strong Meta Ads experience

* Good understanding of performance marketing

* Understanding of marketing reporting and analytics

* Comfortable using AI tools daily

* Ability to think independently and solve problems

* Strong written English communication

* Organised and systems-oriented

* High attention to detail



### Highly Valued



* Experience with Shopify

* Experience with GoHighLevel

* Strong understanding of Google Tag Manager

* Strong understanding of GA4

* Experience setting up and troubleshooting Meta Pixel and Events Manager

* Experience with attribution and conversion tracking

* Experience with automation tools like Zapier or Make

* Experience using AI builders/tools such as Lovable

* Basic SEO understanding

* Design eye and understanding of good creative



---



## Growth Opportunity



We are building this role for the long term.



As the company grows, this position will continue to grow and evolve with it.



For the right person, there is significant opportunity for:



* increased responsibility

* leadership opportunities

* involvement in higher-level strategy

* direct collaboration with the founder

* long-term career growth inside the company



This is a remote-first role, however for exceptional long-term tea
mbers, there may also be opportunities over the next 12 to 24 months to become more directly involved with the Australian side of the business if desired.



We are looking for somebody who wants to build something long-term, not somebody looking for a short-term freelance position.



---



## The Type of Person That Will Succeed Here



You:



* take initiative without being asked

* enjoy solving problems

* improve systems naturally

* think critically

* learn quickly

* communicate clearly

* care about results

* want long-term growth

* are comfortable in a fast-moving environment

* use AI to work smarter and faster



You probably will NOT enjoy this role if:



* you need constant supervision

* you wait for instructions for every task

* you avoid ownership

* you struggle with communication

* you prefer repetitive admin-only work



---



## Hours



* Full-time role

* Flexible scheduling where needed

* Must have overlap with Melbourne business hours



---



## To Apply



Please answer the following carefully.



We are not looking for perfect answers. We are looking for your thinking process, problem-solving ability, and how you approach challenges.



### Question 1



Tell us about a marketing or operational problem you noticed before anybody else did.



How did you identify it?

What did you do to solve it?

What was the result?

* what you would check first

* how you would investigate the issue

* what data you would look at

* what actions you would take

### Question 3

What was inefficient?

What changes did you make?

What impact did it have?

What AI tools do you currently use in your workflow, and how do they make you more effective?



---



## Final Notes



We are building a high-performance, AI-first agency with strong systems and strong people.



If you are ambitious, proactive, accountable, and want a long-term opportunity where you can grow into a major role inside the company, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Social Media Marketing + Graphic Design Associate
description:
We're building the in-house creative function for a Japan-based fintech platform, and we're looking for someone we can grow from the ground up — not just a designer who fills briefs, but someone who takes genuine pride in how our brand shows up in public. This role blends design with judgment: you won't just produce assets; you'll read what's actually landing with our audience and adjust.



This is not a template-filling role. You'll be shaping how a financial product presents itself to real users — where a sloppy asset or a careless caption costs us trust, not just engagement. Our audience is discerning, and much of it is Japanese. Quality is the only standard. We train every associate to think critically and reach the right creative call on their own, using AI as a support tool rather than a substitute for taste. Once you've proven you can consistently get it right, you'll be trusted to move fast — real speed is earned through skill, not shortcuts.



We're a growing team, and we mean that literally — the brand guidelines, content calendar, and asset library you'll work with are still being shaped, and we actively want someone who takes initiative to help build them. The culture here is built on mutual trust, shared accountability, and a genuine respect for doing things well. If that resonates with you, keep reading.



Responsibilities:



• Design static creative for social, community channels, and campaigns — posts, banners, announcement cards, event graphics, presentation assets

• Own the content calendar: plan it, keep it filled, and keep it shipping on schedule

• Publish and monitor posts across our channels, and track how each one actually performs

• Recognize what's working and bring that back into the next round of creative — not just produce volume

• Report on performance in numbers, not impressions of impressions — you should be comfortable saying which post did what, and why

• Maintain and extend our brand system — colors, type, templates, asset library — so the whole team can move faster

• Use AI tools to sharpen your own well-considered concepts, not to generate work you haven't thought through

• Keep organized, accessible files — versioned, named properly, findable by someone who isn't you

• Escalate anything involving financial claims, promotions, or numbers to your Lead before it goes out — nothing about money publishes unreviewed

• Follow team rules, protocols, and brand guidelines diligently — structure exists for a reason and will be respected

• We believe every public post is a first impression for someone, and deserves your full presence and care



What We're Looking For:



Non-negotiables — read these carefully:



• Real graphic design experience. Not "I've used Canva." You should have designed for a brand or client with an actual audience, and be able to walk us through your choices.

• A social account you personally ran, with the numbers to show for it. This is the core of your portfolio. We want to see accounts you managed — the graphics you made for them, and the performance behind those posts: impressions, likes, retweets/shares, follower growth over a stated period. Screenshots of your analytics are exactly what we're asking for. A portfolio of pretty graphics with no audience data attached will not get you through this stage.

• Japanese market experience is highly preferred. If you've designed or run social for a Japanese brand, a Japan-facing account, or a JP audience — say so early and show it. This is the single biggest differentiator in this search.



Also required:



• Strong with Figma, Canva, or Adobe — whichever you use, you should be genuinely fluent in it

• A body of work that shows range and taste — we care far more about what you've actually made than where you studied

• High energy and quick on your feet — comfortable with fast, informal communication (voice notes, memes, Slack chaos included) and unfazed by a startup's rough edges

• Confident — you can explain why you made a design choice, and defend it or drop it without going quiet

• Understands hierarchy — you know what you can ship yourself and what needs your Lead's eyes, and you act without being told

• Conscientious — deadlines hold, files are clean, nothing gets published with a typo in it

• Audience-minded — you can tell the difference between a post that looks nice and a post that works

• Follows rules diligently — brand guidelines aren't suggestions

• Strong written English — clear, warm, and professional, and able to write a caption that doesn't sound like a press release

• Sharp critical thinking — you can reason through a brief yourself, not just execute the literal request

• Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, or similar) as an aid, not a crutch

• High discretion — you'll see campaign plans and product information before they're public

• Startup mindset — adaptable, steady, and not easily rattled



Bonus Points (not required, but we will prioritize you):



• JLPT N2/N1 or business-level Japanese — especially if you can review Japanese-language creative for tone, not just accuracy

• Short-form video or motion graphics ability (Reels, TikTok, CapCut, After Effects)

• Experience running paid social or reading analytics beyond surface-level metrics

• Familiar with crypto, DeFi, or fintech products — and the visual language that comes with them

• Google AI Essentials or equivalent AI literacy certificate

• Meta Blueprint, HubSpot Marketing, or similar certification

• Has grown an account from zero to a real audience

• Illustration, 3D, or photography skills



Reporting to: Growth Operations Lead and CMO



Setup:



• 100% WFH from day one

• Flexible hours, output-based — you'll need meaningful overlap with Philippine business hours (JST business hours) for team syncs and reviews, but we're not counting the hours you spend at your desk

• No time tracker

• Deadlines are firm; how you get there is yours to manage

• Team communication via Slack

• BYOD — your own machine capable of running your design tools, plus stable fiber internet

• Confidentiality/NDA agreement required before you see any campaign or product information

• Paid training and evaluation period — Part-Time status running through the 30th of the month you're hired (this lines up with our salary reporting cycle)

• Promotion to Full-Time is based on your evaluation — if your work is clearly solid early on, that promotion can happen before the 30th too

• Initiative is welcomed — stepping up when it's needed is part of the culture here

• Internal growth and promotions for top performers



To Apply:



Start your message with the subject line:

[Social + Design] – [Your Name] – [City]



Then send the following. We read every response personally — take your time with these.



1. Your portfolio, which must include:



The social account(s) you personally ran — handle or link, and what your actual role was (you ran it solo, you handled design only, you shared it with a team — just be honest)

The numbers. Impressions, likes, retweets/shares, follower growth, over a period you state clearly. Analytics screenshots are ideal. If an account was small, show it anyway — we'd rather see 3,000 real followers you grew than a vague claim about a big one.

The graphics you made for those accounts — so we can connect the design work to the results it produced

Any Japanese-market work, called out specifically



If your best work is under NDA or on an account you no longer have access to, tell us what you can and show what you have. We're reasonable about this — we're not reasonable about people who skip the numbers entirely.



2. Answer all three questions:



Pick your best-performing post and your worst-performing post from the same account. What was different about them? (Numbers, then your read on why.)

If we give you a chance at this role, what is the one thing you can promise us?

Think of a time you were part of a startup, org, or company — what's one initiative you personally established that's still in use today (or was used before you left), and became part of how that company actually operates?



A note on AI: using it to help you write or ideate is fine — we use it ourselves. But we can tell when an answer wasn't reviewed by the person sending it, and we can tell when a portfolio piece was generated rather than made. Edit before you submit.



Important: Do not use any of the following words anywhere in your application — passionate, dedicated, hardworking, committed, team player, fast learner, creative, or go-getter. Applications containing these words will not be reviewed. We want your real voice, not resume language.



Applications without the correct subject line, a portfolio with performance numbers, and all three answers will not be reviewed.

title: AI Implementation Specialist
description:
About Tara Zaluski (
)

Tara Zaluski is a Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania (USA) real estate investing business built and run under Tara's own personal brand at 
. We buy and renovate flips, hold a growing portfolio of multi-unit rental properties, and are actively pursuing the acquisition of an established trade business (HVAC) from a retiring owner. We run lean, and we believe AI should be doing far more of the repetitive, systems-level work across our business than it currently is.



The Opportunity

We're hiring a part-time, fully remote AI Implementation Specialist to find and build the AI-driven systems our business needs, across marketing, sales follow-up, bookkeeping, property management, and day-to-day operations, without waiting to be told what to build. You will be given context about how the business runs, and it will be on you to identify where AI and automation can save time and money, propose it, and implement it. This is not a task-execution role; it's an ownership role.



If you need a detailed brief before you can act, or you wait for direction on what to build next, this is not the right role for you. If you naturally notice inefficiency and can't help but go build a fix for it, it is.



What You'll Do

• Scout and implement. Continuously identify new AI tools, agents, and workflows relevant to a real estate investing business, and bring working solutions, not just suggestions.

• Lead generation & cold calling. Build and manage AI-assisted cold calling, texting, and lead follow-up systems that integrate with our 



CRM (Follow Up Boss).

• Social media & marketing. Stand up AI-supported content creation, scheduling, and posting systems for our social platforms under our personal brand.

• Bookkeeping & bill pay. Implement AI/automation for expense categorization, invoice handling, and bill-pay workflows, working alongside our bookkeeper rather than replacing her judgment.

• Property management support. Build AI tools for tenant communication, maintenance triage, and reporting that make our property manager's job faster.

• Deal evaluation. Support AI-assisted analysis for flip deals (targeting ~$100k profit), multi-unit acquisitions, and due diligence on a trade-company (HVAC) acquisition.

• Systems & documentation. Document every workflow you build in clear SOPs so the team can use and maintain it without you.

• Team enablement. Train and support existing team members (VA, bookkeeper, transaction coordinator, property manager) on new AI tools as you roll them out.

• Reporting. Track and report the time, cost, or error savings each implementation produces.



What We're Looking For

• A track record of actually building AI/automation solutions in a business, not just using ChatGPT casually. You should be able to show us 2–3 concrete examples.

• Strong self-direction, comfortable identifying opportunities and acting on them with minimal oversight.

• Working knowledge of automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n), AI agent/GPT builders, and prompting for business use cases.

• Comfortable learning CRM (Follow Up Boss), bookkeeping (Buildium), and social scheduling tools well enough to automate around them.

• Excellent written English — this role is fully async and remote, so clear written communication matters as much as technical skill.

• Based in the Philippines, able to overlap for live check-ins with a U.S. Eastern Time business.



Nice to Have

• Experience in or with U.S. real estate investing, property management, or a related trade/services business.

• Experience building custom GPTs, AI agents, or multi-step automations end-to-end.

• Background in cold-calling/lead-gen or digital marketing automation specifically.



How to Apply Send: 

(1) your resume,

(2) 2–3 specific examples of AI tools, agents, or automations you've built and the result they produced, and 

(3) a short note (200 words or less) describing one AI opportunity you'd tackle first if hired and why. 

Applications without concrete examples will not be considered.

title: Event Sales & Business Development Assistant
description:
ABOUT SIGNIFICANT AFFAIR

Significant Affair is a wedding and event planning, design, coordination, and event services company serving Central Florida and beyond.



We specialize in weddings, quinceañeras, Sweet 16s, birthdays, corporate events, fairs & festivals, multicultural celebrations, and more.



Our services include event planning and coordination, event design, décor, florals, rentals, custom installations, 360° photo booths, uplighting, dancing on the clouds, projections, catering, bar services, and entertainment.



We are looking for a proactive, organized, motivated, and sales-minded VA who can help generate clients, build venue and business relationships, manage leads, and support daily operations.



This is more than an administrative role. We want someone who actively looks for opportunities, builds connections, follows up, and helps turn opportunities into booked events.



RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Client Acquisition & Lead Management

- Find potential wedding and event clients actively seeking our services.

- Post services on appropriate platforms and monitor
 groups, wedding communities, portals, and other lead sources.

- Respond to approved inquiries and follow up with leads and past prospects.

- Schedule discovery calls and consultations for Jasmin.

- Maintain the CRM, client portal, and lead tracker.

- Track leads from inquiry through consultation, proposal, booking, or lost lead.

- Send approved packets, questionnaires, and follow-ups.

- Ensure qualified leads are properly tracked and followed up.



2. Venue Relationships

- Research wedding and event venues throughout Central Florida.

- Identify venue managers and appropriate contacts.

- Introduce Significant Affair and schedule meetings for Jasmin.

- Research preferred/approved vendor programs and requirements.

- Identify opportunities to become a preferred vendor.

- Maintain the venue database and track partnership opportunities.



3. Business Development

- Research corporate event opportunities, bridal shows, expos, networking events, and industry opportunities.

- Identify referral and partnership opportunities.

- Research hotels, venues, photographers, caterers, DJs, florists, bridal boutiques, and other event professionals.

- Help develop a preferred vendor and referral network.

- Research new platforms and opportunities for promoting Significant Affair.



4. Client & Event Support

- Send questionnaires, forms, contracts, and approved reminders.

- Organize client folders and documentation.

- Track deposits, payments, deadlines, and unpaid invoices.

- Assist with timelines, vendor contact sheets, setup/teardown checklists, and event-day documents.

- Confirm final details with vendors before events.

- Track RSVPs when applicable.

- Send final documents to vendors and venues 2 weeks before each event.



5. Marketing & Social Media

- Schedule approved social media content.

- Organize and repurpose event photos/videos.

- Create simple Canva graphics using company branding.

- Post approved services and rental inventory.

- Assist with promoting packages and services.

- Research marketing opportunities.

- Request client testimonials and reviews using approved messaging.



6. Support for Jasmin

- Manage consultations, meetings, appointments, and calendar organization.

- Prepare research and information for meetings.

- Follow up after meetings.

- Keep CRM, lead, and business-development records updated.

- Provide a weekly report covering leads, follow-ups, consultations, venue contacts, and business opportunities.



COMPENSATION

Hourly Pay

$6 USD/hour — 20 hours per week (4 days × 5 hours)



Commission

Earn 2% commission on eligible Significant Affair service revenue from new clients you directly generate.



Examples:

$3,000 booking → $60

$5,000 booking → $100

$8,000 booking → $160

$10,000 booking → $200



VA-Generated Lead Requirements

A lead qualifies when the VA:



- Personally identifies the opportunity.

- Initiates / facilitates the initial connection.

- Documents the lead in the lead tracker.

- Helps move the lead to a consultation.

- The client signs a contract and pays Significant Affair.



Commission is paid only after the event is successfully completed and there is no cancellation, refund, or qualifying adjustment.

Commission applies only to eligible Significant Affair service revenue and does not include third-party/vendor costs or rental revenue.



Preferred Vendor Exception

Bookings resulting from Significant Affair being listed, recommended, approved, or designated as a preferred vendor by a venue or organization are not commissionable, even if the VA helped establish the relationship.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 



- Proactive, self-motivated, and dependable

- Highly organized and detail-oriented

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Comfortable communicating with U.S. clients and businesses

- Strong online research and professional outreach skills

- Sales-minded without being pushy

- Able to work independently

- Creative, resourceful, and eager to learn



Experience is a plus in:

Virtual assistance, sales, lead generation, business development, customer service, event/wedding planning, hospitality, appointment setting, social media, Canva, or CRM systems.



INITIATIVE IS ESSENTIAL

We don't want someone who waits for instructions for every task.



We want someone who can say:



"I found an opportunity. Here's what I found, here's what I recommend, and here's what I think we should do next." 

"I have an Idea to move the business to the next level"



You'll receive training, direction, and the tools you need, but we expect you to eventually work independently and actively contribute to the growth of Significant Affair. 



We Grow & You Will Grow Too!

title: Business Credit Reporting & Compliance Coordinator
description:
Corpire Capital is a business credit and funding-readiness company helping entrepreneurs build fundable businesses. We're looking for a detail-driven Reporting & Compliance Coordinator to own our monthly tradeline reporting cycle across three bureaus — Experian, CreditSafe, and Equifax.

This is a small, contained role by hours, but it carries real weight: what you report each month becomes part of our audit trail, so accuracy and consistency matter more than speed.

What your monthly cycle actually looks like:



Using Ai based software 

1. Pull the current member account list (currently 12 active accounts) from our internal tracking sheet.

2. For each account, review the payment history and current utilization to d
 whether a balance should be reported that cycle — this requires real judgment, not a fixed rule.

3. Prepare the CSV report formatted correctly for each bureau (Experian, CreditSafe, and Equifax each have their own format).

4. Upload each CSV to its bureau portal.

5. For any account with a reported balance change, generate a matching invoice in our invoicing system so our records stay audit-ready.

6. Log what was reported, to which bureau, and why, in our monthly compliance log.

7. Flag anything unusual — a missed payment, an unexpected utilization spike — to Dee before it's reported.

You'll be a strong fit if you:

• Are genuinely comfortable with numbers — you can look at a balance and payment history and reason through a judgment call, not just follow a checklist.

• Have basic bookkeeping or invoicing experience (QuickBooks, Wave, or similar).

• Are reliable on a monthly deadline — this role has few hours, but they can't slip.

• Can be trusted with sensitive financial data.

• Bonus: any prior exposure to business credit bureaus or tradeline reporting.



Pay: , part-time, 2 hours/week. Will increase as members subscribe to product.This role is replacing a departing team member, so a short training handoff will be provided.

title: Remote Operations & Client Coordinator
description:
Job Title:

Remote Operations & Client Coordinator | Part-Time to Full-Time



Job Description:



NuePrint is a commercial printing, signage, apparel, and branded-products company based in the Chicago area. We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Operations & Client Coordinator to help keep customer requests, quotes, orders, production, purchasing, follow-ups, and day-to-day communication moving.



This is not a role where you will simply wait for someone to assign your next task.



We have internal systems, an ERP, documented training materials, and automated workflows. We do not expect you to memorize every product, material, vendor, or process. We do expect you to know how to find answers, verify information, solve routine problems, and take ownership of work without continuous management supervision.



Responsibilities:



- Monitor and follow up on open customer requests.



- Make sure customer questions, approvals, artwork, payments, and other pending items do not get forgotten.



- Prepare and review quotes, orders, and invoices in our ERP.



- Follow up on outstanding quotes, deposits, and invoices.



- If you are unsure about a quote, invoice, or next step, follow up with the person who created it or the account owner before letting it sit.



- Monitor customer deadlines and identify problems before they become urgent.



- Keep Jira project and production statuses accurate.



- Verify actual production status before reporting that a job is current, complete, or ready.



- Source apparel, materials, and outsourced products from approved vendors.



- When an item is unavailable, check other warehouses, backup suppliers, and reasonable alternatives before escalating.



- Review vendor pricing and help keep ERP product and material costs current.



- During slower periods, review stale pricing, open orders, unpaid invoices, customer follow-ups, Jira statuses, purchasing needs, and training materials.



- Maintain accurate customer and order information.



- Research products and vendor information using spreadsheets, vendor websites, internal systems, and company documentation.



- Answer inbound customer and prospect phone calls through our company phone system.



- Make outbound calls to customers, vendors, prospects, and account contacts when follow-up is needed.



- Assist with sales follow-up and, over time, help with outbound prospecting and cold calling.



- Communicate professionally and confidently by phone,
, and internal messaging.



- Communicate clearly with customers, vendors, production staff, sales staff, and management.



What Matters Most:



Printing experience can be learned. What matters most is how you approach the work.



We need someone who consistently:



- Looks for the answer before asking.



- Follows a customer issue through until it is resolved or clearly handed off.



- Verifies information before saying something is complete, accurate, or current.



- Checks alternatives when the first solution does not work.



- Notices and manages deadlines without needing reminders.



- Uses available downtime productively.



Before escalating a routine issue, we expect you to check the available training materials, ERP, previous orders, vendor information, Jira, and other company resources first.



When bringing a problem to management, you should be prepared to explain:



- What is the problem?



- What have you already checked?



- What options did you find?



- What do you recommend?



Requirements:



- Excellent written and spoken English.



- Clear, professional phone communication skills.



- Comfortable answering calls from U.S.-based customers and prospects.



- Comfortable making outbound customer follow-up calls.



- Willing and able to assist with cold calling and sales prospecting as the role develops.



- Strong attention to detail.



- Strong organizational and follow-up skills.



- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



- Comfortable researching answers and learning new systems.



- Experience in operations, customer service, order management, purchasing, project coordination, sales support, or a similar role.



- Comfortable using Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Teams,
, PDFs, and web-based business software.



- Comfortable working with ERP, CRM, project-management, and vendor-ordering systems.



- Reliable computer capable of handling multiple browser tabs, Microsoft applications, ERP systems, and VoIP phone software.



- Reliable high-speed internet connection suitable for clear VoIP phone calls and regular online work.



- Reliable headset or microphone setup for professional phone calls.



- Ability to work consistently during agreed hours with overlap during U.S. Central Time business hours.



Experience with ERP systems, Jira, printing, signage, apparel, promotional products, purchasing, cold calling, sales support, or U.S.-based customers is helpful but not required.



Schedule:



- This position begins part-time at approximately 20 hours per week.



- The first 60 days are a training and evaluation period.



- During this time, you will learn NuePrint's systems, procedures, products, vendors, workflow, and communication standards.



- After successfully completing the training period and demonstrating that you can independently handle the responsibilities of the position, the role is expected to transition to full-time at approximately 40 hours per week.



- The full-time transition is based on performance and is not automatic.
