title: Bookkeeper
description:
About the Role

Our client is a compliance consulting and internal audit firm. They implement international management system standards and run internal audits for companies in electronics recycling, IT asset disposition, and manufacturing across North America. Their clients use that work to prepare for and hold third-party certifications. The team is small and senior, and they hold their own operations to the same standard they hold their clients to: documented, repeatable, and not dependent on one person's memory. They are looking for a Bookkeeper to own the day to day accuracy of their financial records — transaction processing, coding, reconciliation, and the disciplined execution of the payables, receivables, and payroll cycles.



This role carries more weight than the title usually implies. Most bookkeeping roles are volume roles. This one is a judgment role with volume attached. Multi-phase engagements bill on milestones, subcontractor invoices have to be matched against agreed rates before anything moves, and expense submissions get checked against policy rather than waved through. The hard part is not entering the transaction, it is knowing where it belongs and saying so when you are not sure.



Expect 25 to 30 hours a week during onboarding and training, settling to around 20 once you are running the cycle independently. Hours grow from there: transaction volume is rising, the second company is just launching, and the more of the repetitive work you systematise and take on, the faster the role moves toward full time.



You would support two companies under the same ownership. The second is newly launching as an extension of the services the first provides, which means you will be setting up its finance processes rather than inheriting them, and keeping the records for the two entities cleanly separated as it grows.



Some context on what it is like to work here. The team is small and growing, and there is no finance department behind you. You will report directly to the Managing Director with no layer in between, and the volume of transactions is rising as both companies grow. Priorities move and several things run at once, but the finance cycle still has to close on time and correctly every month. Holding both of those at once is the job.



The business is also part way through replacing a stack of spreadsheets,
 threads, and automations with custom software. A meaningful part of this role is learning how the finance processes work today, documenting them properly, and automating the parts that should not need a person at all. We want someone who reaches for a system before they reach for a repetitive workaround.



What You'll Own



Accounts Payable and Contractor Payment



Process vendor bills daily, coding each to the correct account, customer, class, and billable flag in QuickBooks Online

Match subcontractor invoices against project records, agreed rates, and time tracking before anything is queued for payment

Review contractor expense submissions against the travel and expense policy, and flag exceptions rather than processing them

Prepare the semi-monthly payment run and produce the run summary for approval

Maintain vendor records, W-9s, and the onboarding documentation set



Billing and Accounts Receivable



Run the monthly invoicing cycle from time tracking into QuickBooks, ensuring every completed engagement is billed accurately and completely, including recoverable expenses

Apply milestone and deposit billing terms correctly for multi-phase engagements

Maintain the collections log on a weekly cycle: refresh status, issue past-due notices, and track follow-up dates

Report debtor ageing and escalate anything past the defined threshold rather than carrying it quietly



Reconciliation and Record Integrity



Perform monthly bank, credit card, and inter-system reconciliations on the defined cycle

Investigate and resolve reconciling items rather than carrying them forward

Maintain expense categorization consistency and flag coding that does not fit the existing chart of accounts

Prepare the month-end close file and supporting schedules for review



Payroll and Statutory Support



Own the payroll change cycle: enter approved new hires, approved terminations, and approved rate or salary changes into the payroll system

Verify that every approved change has been entered before the cutoff, and prepare the payroll change summary for review

Prepare the monthly payroll run, ensuring deductions, classifications, and filings are correct and on time. (Approval of the underlying changes, review of the change report, and final approval and submission of payroll all sit with the Managing Director.)

Maintain a clean distinction between payroll and contractor payment per engagement classification

Prepare annual contractor tax forms

Assemble the underlying numbers for state tax filings, workers' compensation premium audits, and annual insurance renewals



You prepare and support these. You do not own the filing decision or the external relationships.



Systems, Documentation and Automation



Run each finance process manually and correctly before proposing to change it

Write and update the procedure for every recurring task you own, flagging what is missing, outdated, or wrong

Build automations and AI-assisted workflows for the repetitive, rules-based work, and store them in a form the company owns rather than locked inside one platform

Quality check automated output on a defined cycle rather than assuming it stays correct

Support the migration of finance data and workflows into the new operating platform, and own the approval steps it routes to a person

Keep a running log of every task you are asked to do and every question you had to ask to complete it

Report monthly on which tasks were automated and how many hours of manual work that removed



What You Bring



Six or more years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, ideally in a professional or technical services environment

Demonstrable QuickBooks Online experience: coding, reconciling, invoicing, and closing. Not familiarity — this has been your actual job.

Accuracy under volume, and the discipline to resolve a reconciling item rather than carry it

The judgment to reason about where a transaction belongs, and the honesty to say "I am not sure about this one" instead of guessing

Real working use of AI tools. You should be able to describe a specific repetitive task you handed to an AI tool, which tool you used, how you set it up, and how you verify the output.

Experience building or maintaining a workflow or automation in any tool, or clear evidence you look for the systemic fix rather than repeating the workaround

Strong written English

Ability to record your screen and narrate what you are doing clearly



Strong advantages



CPA, or an equivalent national professional accountancy qualification

A degree in accounting, finance, or a related field

Experience maintaining books for more than one entity under common ownership

Experience with time tracking systems, relational database tools, expense and card management platforms, payroll providers, or workflow automation platforms

Experience through a finance system migration or accounting software implementation

Exposure to a regulated, audited, or ISO-certified environment

Experience supporting a US-based firm



How Success Is Measured



100% of completed engagements invoiced within the defined period

Debtor days within agreed target

100% of reconciliations completed on cycle, with no unresolved items carried forward

Month-end close file delivered within the agreed timetable

Zero payments released against unmatched or unverified documentation

Coding accuracy verified on review sample

A written procedure exists for every recurring task in the role, and each one is reviewed and updated on a defined cycle rather than written once and left

Procedures updated promptly as processes change, including the full rewrite required when the new platform replaces a manual workflow

Both entities closed cleanly and separately, with no cross-coding between them

Documented reduction in manual hours through automation, reported monthly



How to Apply

Complete our application form here: 



It takes about ten minutes. To confirm you have read this posting in full, include the code BK-2026-READ where the application asks for it. We will respond to every applicant who completes the form.

title: PERSONAL BRAND & EDUCATION CONTENT MANAGER
description:
PERSONAL BRAND & EDUCATION CONTENT MANAGER



Social Media Marketing | Reels | TikTok | Content Strategy -



HAIR INDUSTRY 



Remote | Philippines

Part-Time Initially | Long-Term Growth Opportunity



I’m an Australian hairloss educator , hairloss clinic and salon owner and founder looking for a creative, experienced Content Manager to take ownership of my personal brand and professional education content.



I already have someone managing the regular social media content for my hair salon this is for my personal Instagram + TikTok 



This role is specifically focused on my personal brand and professional hair education.



I create a LOT of content.



I need someone to help me create my course sales and gain my clients this isn’t about followers. 



Videos, photos, client transformations, education, training days, behind-the-scenes footage, business content, voice notes, ideas and everyday moments.



My problem isn’t having things to talk about.



My problem is consistently turning everything I have into great content and actually getting it posted.



That’s where you come in.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU



I want us to work together initially to create a clear content strategy.



We’ll establish:



* What we’re trying to achieve

* Who we’re speaking to

* What we want to grow

* What we want to promote

* The different areas of my personal brand

* My professional education goals

* How frequently we should be posting

* What types of content we need



You don’t need to magically understand my voice on day one.



You’ll learn that by working with me.



But once we’ve established the direction together, I need you to take charge of making it happen every single week.



I don’t want consistency to rely on whether I’ve had time to sit down and create a Reel.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY



TAKE WHAT I GIVE YOU AND TURN IT INTO CONTENT.



I will provide the raw material (you will create what raw material is needed) 



You will:



* Organise it

* D
 how we can use it

* Find the strongest angles

* Create the hooks

* Edit the videos

* Turn them into Reels and TikToks

* Create carousels/posts where appropriate

* Write captions

* Create supporting Stories

* Repurpose content

* Schedule it

* Post it

* Keep everything organised

* Make sure we’re consistently showing up every week



You should be able to take one folder of footage and see multiple pieces of content inside it.



If I send you a 10-minute video, you should be thinking about the Reel, TikToks, educational clips, Story content and anything else we can create from it.



INSTAGRAM & TIKTOK



You’ll be responsible for taking the content I provide and turning it into engaging content for both Instagram and TikTok.



I don’t necessarily want the exact same piece blindly posted everywhere.



You should understand how content can be adapted for each platform while still allowing us to work efficiently and repurpose what we create.



You need to be FAST and confident with short-form video editing.



I don’t want footage sitting unused for weeks because nobody has had time to do anything with it.



KEEP ME CONSISTENT



This is a huge part of the role.



I need someone who keeps the content moving.



You’ll maintain the content calendar and know:



What’s being posted this week?

What’s already edited?

What’s waiting for approval?

What content do we have available?

What are we missing?

What do you need me to film next?



I don’t want to have to remember to ask you what content you need.



I want YOU to ask ME.



For example:



“This is what we’re posting next week. I have four pieces ready, but I need you to film these two things for me.”



Or:



“We need more content around this topic. Can you answer these three questions on camera and send them to me?”



That’s the relationship I’m looking for.



PERSONAL BRAND



You’ll work closely with me to understand my personal brand over time.



My content covers areas including:



Hair | Hair Loss | Business | Education | Leadership | Founder Life | Behind the Scenes | Personal/Lifestyle



Some content is fun and fast.



Some is educational.



Some is opinion or founder-led.



Some is very personal.



And some of the work we do with hair-loss clients can be extremely emotional.



I need someone who understands storytelling and human emotion, not just transitions and trending audio.



As we work together, I want you to become increasingly confident at recognising:



“This sounds like her.”



And equally:



“She would never post this.”



PROFESSIONAL HAIR EDUCATION



A major part of the role will also be consistently marketing and growing my professional hair education.



I don’t only want to post when I’m selling training.



We need to consistently nurture the audience so hair professionals:



Discover me → Learn from me → Follow me → Trust me → Engage → Eventually want to train with me.



You’ll help create and publish content around:



* Education

* Training days

* My expertise

* Student results

* Student transformations

* Testimonials

* Behind the scenes

* Industry education

* FAQs

* Common objections

* Case studies

* Success stories

* Upcoming training

* Educational tips

* Content that builds authority

* Content that nurtures potential students



You’ll also help engage with the audience, respond to comments and appropriate DMs, and identify what potential students are asking about so we can create more content around those topics.



I don’t want spammy sales outreach.



I want genuine community building and consistent nurturing.



BRING ME IDEAS



Although I’ll provide lots of the raw content and we’ll set the strategy together, I don’t want to be responsible for thinking of everything forever.



Once you understand the goals, I want you to start bringing ideas to me.



Tell me:



What should we create?

What are we missing?

What should I film?

What should we talk about more?

What performed well?

What should we repeat?

What are people asking us about?



I want someone who becomes another creative brain behind the brand.



HAIR & BEAUTY EXPERIENCE



Experience creating content within the hair or beauty industry is strongly preferred.



Particularly:



Hair salons

Hair extensions

Haircare

Hair loss

Beauty brands

Beauty educators

Hair educators

Beauty/hair personal brands



You need a strong visual eye and an understanding of what makes hair and beauty content engaging.



YOU NEED MORE THAN EDITING SKILLS



Yes, you need to be excellent and FAST with CapCut, Canva, Instagram, TikTok or similar tools.



But I’m looking for someone with real marketing knowledge, not simply a video editor.



You should understand:



* Social media marketing

* Content strategy

* Personal branding

* Short-form video

* Storytelling

* Hooks

* Viewer retention

* Audience nurturing

* Community engagement

* Organic growth

* Calls to action

* Analytics

* Lead generation

* Content that converts



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR



You’re creative, proactive and organised.



You’re a strong short-form video editor.



You have a great eye for hair/beauty content.



You understand marketing, not just design.



You can take a lot of raw footage and turn it into organised content.



You can manage a content calendar and keep us consistently posting.



You don’t need constant instructions.



You ask for what you need.



You bring ideas.



And you’re interested in becoming genuinely invested in growing the brand.



THE OPPORTUNITY



This role will initially be part-time.



However, I own multiple businesses and brands, so there is significant potential for growth.



If you nail this role, there is potential for more hours, more responsibility and long-term work with me.



I’m looking for someone who can eventually take full ownership of keeping my content organised, created and consistently published, while we continue developing the strategy together.



How to use MANYCHAT is a bonus! 



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about your marketing and social media experience.



2. Your portfolio, including Reels and TikToks you have personally edited.



3. Links to social media accounts you have worked on, explaining exactly what you were responsible for.



4. Hair & beauty experience. Tell me about any hair, beauty, salon, clinic, education or personal-brand accounts you’ve worked with.



5. Marketing results. Show me any examples where your content helped increase reach, engagement, followers, enquiries or sales.



6. Tell me about a brand where you were responsible for keeping the content consistently moving. How did you plan it, organise the raw content and make sure posts actually went out every week?



7. Tell me which editing/design tools you’re strongest in and approximately how quickly you can turn raw footage into a finished Reel or TikTok.



8. Tell me your availability and hourly rate in AUD.



IMPORTANT



Please begin your application with the words:



CONTENT FIRST



This is simply so I know you’ve actually read the full job description.



Applications that don’t begin with CONTENT FIRST will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short paid editing task before final interviews.

title: AI Video Editor for Ads (Higgsfield) - Part-Time

Your main responsibility is production: creating the AI footage, editing it, adding voiceover, and delivering a polished final ad. You will not be expected to develop the ad strategy or write scripts from scratch.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

title: Senior Creative Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator
description:
Senior Creative Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator Custom Artwork /

Sports Apparel / Illustration / Seamless Patterns



$12–$20 USD/hour | Long-Term | Approximately 15–25 Hours/Week



We are looking for an exceptionally creative, senior-level graphic

designer and illustrator to join our team on an ongoing freelance basis.



CREATIVITY IS THE #1 REQUIREMENT FOR THIS ROLE.



This is not primarily a production design position. We are not looking

for someone who simply places logos on templates, follows detailed

instructions, or waits to be told exactly what to create.



We need an outstanding visual designer who can be given very limited

creative direction and develop the idea themselves.



Your primary responsibility will be creating custom artwork and product

graphics based on customer logos, brands, themes, and design requests.



A typical project may begin with nothing more than:



A customer’s logo + a few colors + a short sentence describing what they

want.



From there, you are the creative.



You will be expected to determine the visual direction and create the

patterns, illustrations, icons, typography, supporting graphics,

layouts, and other artwork necessary to turn that limited information

into an exceptional finished collection.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



-   Interpret customer requests with very little creative direction

-   Develop original visual concepts independently

-   Create original graphics and artwork for apparel and other products

-   Design cohesive collections across multiple products

-   Determine how artwork should merchandise across different products

    rather than simply repeating the same design

-   Create original vector illustrations, icons, badges, logos,

    typography, and supporting artwork

-   Create sophisticated seamless repeating patterns

-   Work with customer logos and existing brand assets

-   Recreate low-resolution customer logos as clean vector artwork when

    necessary

-   Develop artwork specifically for sublimated sports/performance

    apparel

-   Adapt creative concepts across apparel, accessories, and other

    products

-   Use AI intelligently to accelerate portions of the creative process

    when appropriate

-   Take feedback well and quickly develop revised creative solutions



CREATIVITY IS ESSENTIAL



We cannot emphasize this enough.



We are looking for someone with excellent taste, strong visual

instincts, and the ability to generate ideas independently.



If you require detailed creative briefs, sketches, or step-by-step

instructions before you can begin designing, this will not be the right

position for you.



We want someone who can look at a customer’s brand, understand its

personality, and think:



“Here are five interesting directions we could take this.”



Not:



“What exactly would you like me to make?”



You should be comfortable making creative decisions yourself and

presenting strong solutions rather than waiting for someone else to

solve the creative problem for you.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Adobe Illustrator — EXPERT LEVEL



You must be an exceptional Adobe Illustrator user.



You should be able to work quickly and confidently with complex vector

artwork without assistance.



You must have your own licensed access to Adobe Illustrator.



We will train you on our internal processes. We will not train you on

design software.



Illustration — STRONG/EXPERT



You must actually be able to illustrate.



This includes creating:



-   Original vector graphics

-   Icons

-   Logos and badges

-   Custom typography

-   Mascots/characters when needed

-   Graphic elements

-   Pattern assets

-   Supporting collection artwork



We are not looking for someone whose primary skill is arranging stock

assets.



Seamless Patterns — ABSOLUTELY REQUIRED



You must know how to professionally create seamless repeating patterns

in:



Adobe Illustrator AND Adobe Photoshop.



This is a core requirement of the position.



Sports / Sublimated Apparel Experience



You should have professional experience designing for sports,

performance, or sublimated apparel.



Experience with categories such as golf, cycling, running, outdoor, team

sports, or similar products is highly desirable.



You must understand how artwork interacts with garment panels and how to

design a collection that works across multiple product types.



AI EXPERIENCE



We actively use AI as a creative accelerator, and you should be

comfortable doing the same.



You should understand how to use modern AI creative tools to help:



-   Explore concepts

-   Generate reference material

-   Develop supporting assets

-   Accelerate illustration

-   Explore compositions

-   Generate ideas faster



However, the finished work cannot look AI-generated.



AI is a tool—not a substitute for design ability.



You must have the taste and technical ability to recognize poor AI

output, refine/rebuild assets when necessary, and turn generated ideas

into polished, professional artwork.



A great designer using AI should become faster and more capable, not

produce generic AI artwork.



THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



-   Extremely creative

-   A genuinely strong visual problem solver

-   A senior-level designer, not someone still learning their craft

-   An excellent illustrator

-   Highly self-sufficient

-   Fast in Adobe Illustrator

-   Comfortable starting with very limited direction

-   Able to take constructive feedback without becoming dependent on

    direction

-   Capable of switching between completely different visual styles

-   Excellent at color, typography, composition, and pattern

-   Able to understand a brand quickly

-   Organized and reliable

-   Comfortable managing multiple custom projects

-   Excited about making genuinely cool artwork



Creativity and portfolio quality matter more to us than years of

experience or formal education.



HOURS & COMPENSATION



This is intended to become a consistent, long-term working relationship.



Our target is approximately 25 hours per week at $12–$15 USD/hour,

depending on experience, speed, and portfolio quality.



However:



We are willing to pay up to $20 USD/hour for an exceptional designer,

even if that means fewer guaranteed weekly hours.



We would rather have 15–20 hours from an incredible designer than 25

hours from an average one.



During busy periods, there may also be opportunities to take on

additional projects/hours for additional compensation or performance

bonuses, based on availability.



PORTFOLIO REQUIRED — NO EXCEPTIONS



Do not apply without a portfolio.



Your portfolio is the most important part of your application.



We especially want to see:



-   Your most creative work

-   Sports/performance apparel graphics

-   Sublimated apparel

-   Complete coordinated collections

-   Seamless patterns

-   Original vector illustration

-   Logos, badges, and icons you personally created

-   Projects where you developed the creative direction yourself



We are not particularly interested in portfolios dominated by social

media graphics, corporate presentations, UI/UX, Canva templates, or

generic branding projects.



We want to see ARTWORK.



TO APPLY



Please include:



1.  Portfolio link — REQUIRED

2.  Show us the 3 projects that best demonstrate how creative you are.

3.  Show us a sports/apparel collection you personally designed.

4.  Show us at least 2 seamless patterns you personally built and tell

    us what software you used to create them.

5.  Show us examples of your original vector illustration work.

6.  Describe your experience with sublimated apparel.

7.  Tell us which AI creative tools you currently use and how they fit

    into your design process.

8.  Confirm that you have your own licensed access to Adobe Illustrator.

9.  Confirm your weekly availability and desired hourly rate.



FINAL CREATIVE QUESTION:



Imagine a customer gives you only their logo, brand colors, and the

words “retro tropical golf.” They want a collection but provide no

additional creative direction.



Briefly describe the first 3 visual concepts you would explore.



Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.

title: Book Review Outreach and Promotion Specialist
description:
Job Type: Part-Time / Freelance

Work Location: Remote



Industry: Book Publishing / Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP)

Position Overview



I am seeking a dependable and organized Book Review Outreach and Promotion Specialist to help increase the visibility of books published through Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing.

The ideal candidate will understand ethical book promotion, Amazon’s review policies, and the rules of third-party websites. This person will identify legitimate opportunities for book reviews, submit or place books on appropriate websites, track results, and provide a detailed monthly report.

This position is focused on building long-term visibility and reader engagement. It does not involve purchasing reviews, creating fake accounts, writing reviews for readers, or guaranteeing positive ratings.



Key Responsibilities

Book Review Outreach

Research legitimate book review websites, book blogs, newsletters, podcasts, reading groups, and reviewer communities.

Identify reviewers whose interests match each book’s genre and target audience.

Submit books to reviewers according to each reviewer’s submission requirements.

Prepare professional and personalized outreach messages.

Maintain a record of every reviewer contacted.

Follow up professionally when permitted.

Track accepted, declined, pending, and completed review requests.

Provide reviewers with approved digital or print copies when authorized.

Never request, pressure, or guarantee a positive review.

Third-Party Book Placement

Find reputable websites where books can be listed, featured, promoted, reviewed, or submitted.

Place books on free and paid promotional websites after receiving approval.

Review each site’s rules before submitting a book.

Ensure book descriptions, author information, categories, pricing, links, and cover images are accurate.

Track submission dates, publication dates, fees, results, and expiration dates.

Recommend new promotional opportunities based on genre, audience, price, and expected value.

Avoid websites that use fake traffic, automated reviews, review exchanges, or misleading promises.



KDP and Policy Compliance

Understand and follow Amazon KDP and customer-review policies.

Keep up with policy changes that may affect book reviews and promotions.

Avoid compensated reviews, review manipulation, fake reviews, and prohibited review exchanges.

Do not ask friends, relatives, employees, or individuals with a close personal or financial relationship to post reviews.

Follow the rules of Goodreads, BookBub, social media platforms, review websites, and promotional services.

Immediately report any questionable opportunity before submitting a book or making a payment.



Tracking and Monthly Reports

Provide a monthly report that includes:

Books promoted during the month.

Reviewers and websites contacted.

Dates of all submissions.

Free and paid placements completed.

Amount spent on each placement.

Pending, accepted, declined, and completed review requests.

Links to published reviews and promotional listings.

New Amazon reviews received during the reporting period.

Changes in each book’s average rating and total review count.

Website traffic, clicks, downloads, sales, or other available results.

Problems, policy concerns, or negative feedback discovered.

Recommendations and priorities for the following month.

The specialist must maintain an organized spreadsheet or tracking system that can be reviewed at any time.



Required Qualifications

Experience with book marketing, publishing, blogging, or review outreach.

Familiarity with Amazon KDP and Amazon’s customer-review policies.

Strong online research and written communication skills.

Ability to evaluate whether a promotional website is legitimate.

Excellent organization and attention to detail.

Ability to manage several books and submission deadlines.

Experience using spreadsheets and preparing performance reports.

Ability to work independently and communicate consistently.

Strong commitment to ethical and policy-compliant promotion.



Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience promoting nonfiction, personal finance, investing, business, credit, retirement, or expatriate books.

Existing relationships with book bloggers, reviewers, podcasts, newsletters, or promotional websites.

Experience with BookBub, Goodreads, Booksprout, NetGalley, BookSirens, or similar platforms.

Basic knowledge of SEO, keywords, metadata, and Amazon book listings.

Experience tracking promotional expenses and calculating results.



Performance Expectations

Success will be measured by:

Number and quality of legitimate review opportunities identified.

Number of accurate book submissions and placements completed.

Growth in honest reader reviews and book visibility.

Compliance with Amazon and third-party platform policies.

Accuracy and completeness of monthly reports.

Ability to meet deadlines and stay within the approved budget.

Quality of communication and recommendations.

Reviews, ratings, rankings, and sales cannot be guaranteed. The specialist will be evaluated on the quality and consistency of the work—not on promises of positive reviews.



Important Restrictions

The selected candidate must not:

Purchase fake or guaranteed reviews.

Write reviews on behalf of readers.

Create or use fake reviewer accounts.

Offer payment in exchange for a positive review.

Require a reviewer to leave a specific rating.

Participate in review-for-review arrangements.

Use automated or bot-generated reviews.

Violate Amazon KDP policies or the rules of another platform.

Pay for any service without prior approval.

Any activity that could place an author’s Amazon account, books, or reputation at risk must be reported immediately.



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

A short introduction describing your book-promotion experience.

Examples of books or authors you have previously supported.

A list of book-review or promotional platforms you have used.

An explanation of how you ensure compliance with Amazon’s review policies.

A sample monthly report or tracking spreadsheet, if available.

Your requested hourly rate or monthly fee.

Your weekly availability.

A brief explanation of how you would promote a newly published KDP book during its first 30 days.



Please begin your application with the words “Ethical Book Promotion” so I know you read the entire job posting.

title: PayPal Dispute & Chargeback Manager (E-commerce)
description:
We are Leichtkraut, a growing health and wellness brand from Germany.

We sell a natural herbal supplement. Every day, a few of our customers open

a PayPal case instead of writing to us first. Your job is to win those cases

back and to keep our dispute rate low.



***!!!IMPORTANT: This position is for women only!!!***

Male applicants will not be considered. Please do not apply.



THE ROLE

- Work our PayPal Resolution Center every single day

- Sort every new case by deadline. A case with no answer is a case we lost

- Upload the tracking proof. Most of our cases are won exactly there, and they are won fast

- Build the evidence when a case needs more: order confirmation, proof of delivery, full
 history

- Write the response inside the case. Short, factual, backed by proof

- Communicate with our supplier whenever tracking or proof of delivery is missing or unclear

- Log every single case in our backend sheet: date, order number, case type, amount, deadline, status, outcome

- D
 when we defend and when we refund. You get clear rules from us

- Send one short report every week: cases, won, lost, refunded, dispute rate

- Part-time to start, long-term, with more hours as volume grows



PAY AND GROWTH

- You start at $50 per week

- Right now our claim and chargeback volume is low, so the workload is small and the pay reflects that

- In Q4 the volume goes up a lot. More orders means more claims and more chargebacks. As that happens, this role can grow to several hundred dollars per week

- This is real, not a line on paper. We would rather pay one excellent person properly than three average ones cheaply. If you win cases, you will move up.



HOW TO APPLY

Send us a DM here with exactly TWO things:



1. The link to your video (Loom or Google Drive)

2. Your WhatsApp number



Nothing else. No long message.

If your video convinces us, we will contact you on WhatsApp.

No video means no reply.



YOUR VIDEO (5 to 10 minutes) - please cover all of this:

- Your name, your age, where you are based

- Exactly how long you have handled PayPal disputes or chargebacks (years and months)

- Which companies or brands, and what they sold

- Which payment providers you have worked with (PayPal, Stripe, Klarna, Shopify Payments)

- Which tools you have used (PayPal Resolution Center, Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, Google Sheets)

- How many disputes you handled per week, and roughly what share of them you won

- Tell us about one case you LOST, and what you would do differently today

- How you handle a case where tracking says delivered but the customer says nothing arrived

- Any experience working with suppliers or fulfilment partners to get proof of delivery

- How you keep track of many open cases at once. Show us your system if you have one

- Any experience with health, beauty or supplement brands

- Your English level, and any experience with German or translation tools

- Your available hours in your local time, and your earliest start date

- Your internet speed and your work setup



Speak freely and take your time. The more we see of you in this video,

the faster we can move you forward.

title: US Senior Assistant Accountant
description:
>>>> APPLY HEREEEE: 



About TruthScan

TruthScan helps organizations combat fraud by identifying AI-generated and digitally edited content. Our core products detect manipulated and synthetic images and PDF documentation.

We work across a variety of industry verticals that deal with high volumes of user-submitted images, where AI generation or digital editing is a direct fraud signal, as well as KYC, insurance, and other documentation-heavy businesses, where we serve as a first layer of fraud prevention.



Role Overview:

We are seeking an ambitious Assistant Senior Accountant with 2+ years of US GAAP experience who is ready to step up and grow. In this role, you will initially assist with end-to-end accounting processes while learning our business operations inside and out. With dedicated support and mentorship, your clear trajectory is to fully transition into and take over the Senior Accountant position as you master the role.



This role offers a flexible work schedule, though you must be available during US business hours to attend key meetings, sync with the leadership team, and deliver critical reports.



Key Responsibilities

- Initial Phase (Support & Shadow): Assist with month-end and year-end close activities, journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and daily AR/AP operational oversight under US GAAP.

- Transition Phase (Ownership): Gradually take complete ownership of full-cycle monthly financial statement preparation, variance analysis, and internal reporting.

- Compliance & Audit: Prepare supporting schedules for US federal/state tax compliance, sales tax, and external audit requests.

- Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks in current financial workflows and recommend automated solutions.

- Cross-Timezone Syncs: Participate in live meetings, finance reviews, and reporting syncs scheduled during US business hours.



Qualifications & Requirements

- Experience: 2+ years of general accounting experience working with US-based companies or US accounting standards.

- US tax experience - preparations and support

- Growth Mindset: High ambition and eagerness to rapidly step into a full Senior Accountant capacity.

- Schedule Flexibility: Adaptable working hours with required availability during US business hours (EST/PST) for meetings, deadlines, and reports.

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (CPA track/eligible is a major plus).



Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, complex functions) and familiarity with accounting platforms like QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero.



Communication: Excellent English verbal and written communication skills to articulate financial results to US stakeholders.



What We Offer

title: Senior Creative Strategist & Video Editor – DTC E-commerce / Meta Ads
description:
Senior Creative Strategist & Video Editor – DTC / Meta Ads



We are looking for a Creative Strategist & Video Editor to become a key part of our DTC e-commerce operation.



We are currently doing 5 figures in daily revenue and our goal is to scale toward $100,000+ per day.



Creative is one of the most important parts of our growth, and we are looking for someone who can eventually take significant ownership of the creative side of the brand.



This is NOT just a video editing position.



We need someone who understands Meta Ads, direct-response marketing, creative strategy, customer psychology and performance creative — while also being able to execute and edit high-quality video ads.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your job will be to help us produce, analyze and continuously improve performance creatives for Meta.



You will:



Develop and execute new Meta ad creatives

Study our winning ads and understand why they are working

Build new iterations and executions from proven winning concepts

Develop new hooks, openings, scripts and variations

Edit high-performing direct-response video ads

Create UGC-style ads, VSLs, advertorial-style ads and other performance formats

Research competitors and the market to identify new opportunities

Understand our customer, their problems, desires and buying motivations

Analyze creative performance and use the data to d
 what should be created next

Identify creative fatigue and produce new iterations before winners stop performing

Work with Meta Ads performance data rather than creating based purely on personal preference

Continuously test new ideas while scaling what already works



As you prove yourself, the goal is for you to take more and more ownership of the brand's creative strategy and production.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have a strong understanding of:



Meta Ads

DTC e-commerce

Direct-response marketing

Creative strategy

Video editing

Hooks and angles

Customer psychology

UGC advertising

VSLs

Creative testing

Creative iteration

Competitor and market research

Performance metrics

Scaling creatives as ad spend increases



You should understand that a good-looking video is not necessarily a good ad.



We care about performance.



You should be able to look at an existing winning ad, understand the underlying message, angle, psychology and structure, and use those learnings to create new ads that can potentially outperform it.



IMPORTANT – 2 TEST VIDEO ADS REQUIRED



Please read this before applying.



The first step of our hiring process is creating 2 test video ads for our brand.



We are NOT asking you to figure everything out from zero.



We will give you our winning ads and show you the concepts, messaging and angles that are currently working for us.



From there, we want you to study the winners, understand why they work, and show us what you can create from that information.



Your task will be to create 2 complete video ads that you believe could perform on Meta.



You can use our winning ads as inspiration and direction, but we do not want simple copies.



We want to see whether you can take something that is already proven and create new hooks, iterations, executions and ideas around the winning message.



We will evaluate:



Your understanding of our winning ads

Your creative strategy

Your hooks

Your ability to build on proven concepts

Your direct-response thinking

Your video editing

Your pacing and storytelling

Your understanding of Meta advertising

Your ability to create something that could realistically become another winning ad

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU WON'T DO THE TEST



We want to be very clear about this.



If you are not willing to create the 2 test video ads, please do not apply.



If you only send us a CV, generic cover letter or portfolio and are unwilling to complete the test, we will not move forward with your application.



We are looking for serious candidates who are willing to show us what they can actually do.



WHAT HAPPENS AFTER THE TEST?



If we like your 2 test ads, we will invite you to an interview.



During the interview, we will discuss:



Your decisions behind the test creatives

Why you chose your hooks and structure

Your previous DTC experience

Your Meta Ads knowledge

How you analyze winners and losers

How you would approach creative testing at higher spend

How you could help us build and improve our creative operation



The strongest candidate will have the opportunity to join us full-time and long-term.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are not looking for someone to edit a few videos and disappear.



We want someone who can become an important part of the company as we scale from 5 figures/day toward $100,000+ in daily revenue.



If you're good, there will be room for more responsibility, higher compensation and eventually significant ownership over the creative operation.



We move fast, test aggressively and care about results.



If you're a Creative Strategist who can also execute and edit, understand Meta performance marketing, and want to build alongside a rapidly growing DTC operation, we'd like to see what you can do.



INVESTMENT IN YOUR GROWTH



If you get accepted and join our team, we will pay for Evolve for you — a premium training program worth $2,000/month.



We want you to continuously improve as a Creative Strategist and stay at the highest level of performance creative, Meta Ads and DTC marketing.



We invest in people who perform. If you grow, we grow.

title: Airbnb Operations Lead
description:
We are a premier short-term rental management company that excels at delivering a luxury-grade experience for our guests. Because we hold our operations to hotel-standard cleanliness and rapid, high-touch communication, we are looking for a highly proactive, meticulous, and persistent Virtual Assistant to join our team.



In this role, you aren’t just answering messages; you are the operational heartbeat of our properties. We do not micro-manage. Instead, we empower diligent professionals who take total ownership of their shifts. Our ideal candidate possesses an "owner's mindset" and is relentlessly persistent - you do not let tasks slide, and you proactively follow up on every open item until it is 100% resolved.



Key Responsibilities



Rapid, High-Standard Responses: Manage the guest inbox across all platforms (Airbnb, Vrbo, Direct Booking), responding to inquiries within 5 minutes with a warm, professional, and on-brand tone.



Anticipatory Guest Support: Don't just answer questions - anticipate what the guest will need next. (e.g., If a guest asks about check-in, proactively provide parking details, local recommendations, and check-in steps before they have to ask).



Persistent Problem Resolution: Act as the first point of contact for guest issues (access codes, Wi-Fi, troubleshooting smart home tech). Own the problem from start to finish. If a local contact doesn't respond immediately, you don't wait—you follow up persistently until the guest's issue is fully resolved and confirmed.



Review Maximization & Management: Actively monitor guest sentiment mid-stay to resolve minor issues early. Respond to post-stay reviews and diligently build cases to dispute unfair reviews according to platform policies.



Flawless Turnover Scheduling: Coordinate and schedule cleaning crews daily. Double-check calendar synchronizations across all platforms to guarantee zero missed cleanings.



Quality Control Oversight: Review turnover photos and checklists submitted by cleaners with an eagle eye. Diligently flag and address any missed details (e.g., uneven bed tucks, low inventory, or missed dust) before the next guest arrives.



Relentless Maintenance Coordination: Proactively coordinate with local handymen and providers. Track ongoing maintenance tickets and persistently follow up with vendors until you have physical or photographic proof that the job is completed to our standards.



Aggressive Claims Management: Diligently document and track any guest damages. Gather photographic evidence, cleaner statements, and repair estimates. Follow up relentlessly on pending AirCover or insurance claims until reimbursement is fully approved and paid.



Listing Maintenance: Assist with administrative tasks such as updating calendars, managing listings, and refreshing local guidebooks to keep our digital presence competitive.



Qualifications & Requirements



Experience: 5+ years of direct experience in Airbnb/short-term rental property management and hospitality is strictly required.



Proactive & Persistent Follow-Through: You have a natural drive to close open loops. You do not let tasks sit on "pending" without active, continuous follow-up. You are comfortably persistent when dealing with unresponsive guests, cleaners, vendors, or support platforms.



Extreme Attention to Detail: You are someone who spots a typo from a mile away and notices when a cleaner's photo doesn’t match our standard property layout.



Superb Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English skills. You can write polished, empathetic, and grammatically perfect messages under pressure, while still maintaining a firm and professional stance when chasing down resolutions.



Software Proficiency: Highly comfortable navigating Property Management Systems (PMS) like Guesty or Hospitable, alongside turnover platforms (e.g., Breezeway) and dynamic pricing tools.



Workspace & Schedule: A reliable, high-speed internet connection with a backup power/internet solution, a quiet workspace, and the ability to work shifts aligned with US time zones.



Why Join Us?



Professional Growth: We value talent and reward proactive, high-performing team members who drive results with increased responsibility, growth opportunities, and performance-based bonuses.



Collaborative Environment: We provide documented SOPs and training, but we welcome your ideas on how to optimize and improve them.



Empowered Autonomy: We trust you to do your job. If you are diligent, persistent, and proactive, you will find a highly supportive, collaborative, and rewarding environment here.



How to Apply (Our First Attention-to-Detail & Follow-Through Test)



To prove you are the diligent and persistent professional we are looking for, please reply with:



A copy of your resume highlighting your experience managing short-term rentals.

The name of the Property Management Software (PMS) you are most comfortable using.

An example of a time you had to be highly persistent to resolve a difficult property management or guest issue.



Include the word "Detail-Oriented" in the 1st sentence of your response to us (Note: Applications that do not follow these two instructions precisely will be automatically disqualified).

title: Copywriter / Copy Editor — Direct Response Health Funnels
description:
Rate: €10/hour

Schedule: Part-time, flexible hours

Employment type: Long-term, direct hire (no agency)

Location: 100% remote





About the Company



We own and operate multiple direct-to-consumer health & wellness brands selling in the UK, Ireland, Poland, Mexico, French Canada, and Switzerland. We run all advertising in-house on Meta and Google Ads. Our team already includes strategists, video editors, graphic editors, and funnel builders — and we are growing.



We are looking for one sharp Copywriter / Copy Editor to join us long-term.





About the Job



We build advertorials (long-form editorial-style landing pages) and sales pages for our health brands. The first draft is generated using AI with detailed strategy briefs and style guides. Your job is to take that AI output and make it sound like a real person wrote it — tightening the language, fixing awkward phrasing, strengthening emotional beats, and making sure the copy actually sells.



You are not writing from scratch. You are reviewing, rewriting, and polishing.



Your tasks:

- Review AI-generated advertorials and sales pages against our internal style guide

- Rewrite sections that sound robotic, generic, or flat — make them persuasive and natural

- Strengthen patient stories, testimonials, and emotional copy so they feel real and specific

- Ensure mechanism explanations are clear, simple, and compelling — not overly technical

- Check that headlines, subheadlines, and CTAs are sharp and direct

- Verify consistency across the full funnel (advertorial claims match the sales page, stats are identical everywhere, guarantee language is consistent)

- Flag anything that feels off — weak sections, missing proof, unclear logic, or claims that don't land

- Deliver clean, ready-to-publish copy back to us



You do not need to know how to use AI tools or write prompts — that is handled by someone else. You just receive the output and make it better with your copywriting skills.



We have complete style guides, frameworks, and examples ready. You will be trained on our exact process and standards.





Requirements

- At least 2 years of experience writing or editing direct response copy (advertorials, long-form landing pages, sales pages, or VSLs)

- You understand what makes copy sell — emotional hooks, identification, objection handling, urgency, proof stacking — not just what makes it grammatically correct

- Strong feel for natural, conversational English — you can spot when a sentence sounds like a machine wrote it

- Reliable internet, own computer, and available for consistent part-time hours

- Honest, detail-oriented, and able to work independently

- This role cannot be combined with another full-time job



Big advantages (not required, but will put you ahead):

- Experience in health, beauty, or skincare copy

- Experience with gadget or device marketing

- Familiarity with the advertorial format (editorial-style pre-sell pages)

- Understanding of awareness stages and funnel structure





Benefits

- €10/hour — paid reliably, on time, every month

- Paid leave — real paid days off, not just unpaid vacation

- Long-term security — many of our team members have been with us for years; we invest in training and promote from within

- Flexible part-time schedule (no fixed shift — we care about output, not clock-watching)

- Work with an experienced international team across multiple markets

- Clear style guides and SOPs — you always know what is expected





How to Apply



To make sure you read this post carefully, start your application with the word WATERMELON in the subject line or first line.



Then include:

1. A sample of your best direct response copy — an advertorial, sales page, or long-form landing page where YOU wrote or rewrote the copy (link or PDF)

2. Answer this question: pick one section from your sample and explain what makes it persuasive — what is it doing to the reader and why does it work?

3. Your availability (hours per week) and earliest start date



Applications without the word WATERMELON or without a writing sample will not be considered.



We personally read every application and reply to all qualified candidates within 5 business days.

title: (Harriet) Social Media Content Strategist & Manager - Financial Education Brand
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

• Location: Remote

• Contract Type: Independent Contractor

• Position: Part-Time

• Hours: 20 hours per week

• Pay: $250 per month

• Brand: Financial Education / Personal Finance

• Time Zone: Availability to overlap with UK working hours



ABOUT THE ROLE

I’m looking for a hands-on Content Strategist & Social Media Manager to help grow a personal financial education brand.

This is not simply a role where you will be given a list of posts to create each week. I need someone who can think strategically, understand an audience, research competitors, analyse content and performance, identify opportunities and take ownership of the process from research → strategy → content creation → scheduling → analytics → optimisation.



You should be comfortable working independently, bringing ideas to the table and explaining why you believe certain content will work.



THE MAIN GOAL

Growth is important, but going viral for the sake of going viral isn’t the goal.

The priority is attracting the right audience and turning that attention into genuine interest and qualified leads for the brand’s online masterclass and educational offers.

I want someone who understands the difference between vanity metrics and meaningful results.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Strategy & Research

• Research the target audience, including their questions, problems, fears, objections and interests.

• Research competitors and successful creators in the financial education/personal finance space.

• Analyse existing content and identify what is working, what isn’t and why.

• Develop and maintain content pillars, themes and a platform-specific strategy.

• Identify content gaps, trends and opportunities.

• Use analytics to continually improve the strategy.



Content Creation

• Develop content ideas, angles and hooks.

• Write short-form and long-form video scripts, captions, titles and descriptions.

• Adapt content to the brand’s voice and different platforms.

• Edit short-form and long-form video.

• Create social media graphics and YouTube thumbnails.

• Repurpose existing content into new formats.

AI can be used to support your workflow, but the final content must have genuine human judgement, creativity and personality.



Planning & Publishing

• Build and manage the content calendar.

• Schedule and publish content across relevant platforms.

• Ensure content, captions, CTAs, links and formatting are correct.

• Keep the content workflow organised and ahead of schedule.

• Set up, manage and optimise ManyChat automations and workflows, including connecting relevant content CTAs to automated conversations and lead-generation sequences.



Analytics & Growth

• Monitor views, watch time, retention, engagement, saves, shares, comments and other relevant metrics.

• Identify patterns and use the data to recommend what to create more of, change or stop.

• Look beyond follower growth and views to assess whether we’re attracting the right people.

• Identify high-performing content and develop new angles and repurposing opportunities.

• Support testing of hooks, titles, thumbnails and CTAs.



Community

• Monitor and respond to comments and basic messages.

• Identify audience questions and conversations that could become future content.

• Escalate anything requiring my input.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR

• Experience in content strategy and social media management, preferably for a personal brand, creator, coach, educator or similar business.

• Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.

• Strong copywriting and scripting ability.

• Excellent understanding of audience and competitor research.

• Ability to analyse content performance and turn data into action.

• Strong video editing skills.

• Strong graphic design skills, including creating social media graphics and YouTube thumbnails.

• Understanding of SEO/keyword research for social media and YouTube.

• Experience with ManyChat, or the ability to learn and set up automations independently.

• Able to work independently and take ownership.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.



AI & ORIGINALITY

**Please read this carefully before applying**



AI tools can be used to support your workflow, but the final content must demonstrate your own creativity, judgement and understanding of the audience and brand.



I’m looking for someone who can take an idea, develop it, add their own perspective and create content that feels natural, engaging and authentic, rather than generic or formulaic.



If you rely heavily on AI to produce your content without adding meaningful human input, this role will not be the right fit for you.



APPLICATION & SELECTION PROCESS

Please note that shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a practical trial before a hiring decision is made.

The trial will give you the opportunity to demonstrate your ability to think strategically, understand an audience, develop content ideas, write scripts and create content.



HOW TO APPLY

Please answer these 4 questions in your application:

1. Please share social media accounts that you’ve personally worked on or managed and briefly explain your role and what you were responsible for.



2. Please share links to examples of content you have personally created, particularly scripts, hooks, captions, videos or other social media content.



3. Imagine you are taking over the social media for a personal brand you’ve never worked with before. What would you want to understand first before creating or recommending content?



4. What tools do you currently use for content creation, scheduling, analytics, SEO/keyword research, video editing and ManyChat?



Please make sure your answers are your own and give us a genuine understanding of your experience and approach.

title: Producer / Delivery Manager for AI Video Agency (Full Time, Long Term)

This is not a virtual assistant role. You will own whether work ships on time and to standard.



What the job actually is



I hand you a brief. You take it from there.



That means breaking it into tasks, assigning to the right person on the team, chasing whatever assets we are missing, checking the work before it comes back to me, and tracking deadlines across several clients at once.



The part that matters most is quality control. When a video comes back, you need to spot that the character changed between scenes, or the product name is mispronounced, or it does not match the brief. If you cannot tell good work from mediocre work, this role will not suit you.



Who this is for

-You have coordinated creative or production work before, agency side ideally

-You are comfortable chasing people and holding a deadline without being unpleasant about it

-You notice detail. Small errors bother you

-You can look at a piece of video and say specifically what is wrong with it

-You communicate clearly and quickly, and you follow up without being reminded

-You want a long term role where you own something



Who this is not for

-You want to be told exactly what to do each day

-You avoid difficult conversations

-You are looking for a stepping stone into your own agency

-You juggle several clients and would treat this as one of many



What you get

-Direct training from me on our standards and process

-Real ownership. You run delivery, not a task list

-A business that is growing quickly, with international clients, and a role that grows with it

-Salary reviewed on performance, not on time served
